records.title: [Feature Request] Use OpenAI Codex OAuth as a primary LLM provider
records.body:
## Summary

Please support `openai-codex` (ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth) as a **primary LLM provider** in DeepSeek Harness, so users can select Codex models on the Models page instead of only invoking Codex as a subagent.

Tested against:

- npm: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`
- repository: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- pi-ai: `@earendil-works/pi-ai ^0.82.1`

## Current implementation evidence

Most provider-side building blocks already exist:

1. pi-ai ships the `openai-codex` provider, its model catalog, the `openai-codex-responses` protocol, browser/device-code OAuth, refresh logic, and `CredentialStore` integration.
2. DSH `llm-pi-ai` already materializes pi-ai catalog providers.
3. DSH intentionally withholds OAuth-only catalog routes from the configurable-provider directory because `PiAiAdapter` creates `Models` without a credential store and exposes only `resolveApiKey`.
4. The repository already ships `dsh-subagent-codex`, which delegates to the host `codex app-server` and reuses native Codex authentication, but this does not make Codex available as the parent session model.

The relevant code is in:

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` (`catalogProviderTakesApiKey` and the OAuth-only exclusion rationale)
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts` (`createModels()` without `CredentialStore`)
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts` (configurable-provider directory filtering)
- `packages/subagent/subagent-codex/` (working native-Codex delegation path)

## Expected behavior

- The Models page offers **OpenAI Codex**.
- A user can sign in with their own ChatGPT/Codex account through browser or device-code OAuth.
- The OAuth credential is persisted under DSH ownership with owner-only permissions and refreshed under a serialized store lock.
- Codex models can be selected as the default parent-session model.
- Sign-out removes only the DSH-owned credential.

## Security boundary

DSH should use its own OAuth login and credential store. It should **not read, copy, refresh, or overwrite `~/.codex/auth.json`**, because sharing a rotating refresh token between Codex CLI and DSH can invalidate one client and couples DSH to another products private file format.

## Suggested implementation

1. Add a structured OAuth credential store owned by DSH (or a small adapter from a secure DSH credential service to pi-ai `CredentialStore`).
2. Construct each immutable pi-ai `Models` snapshot with that shared store.
3. Add host RPC operations for auth status, login, cancellation, and logout; bridge pi-ai `AuthInteraction` events to the Web UI.
4. Offer OAuth-only providers when the runtime has a persistent store and login surface.
5. Add keyless tests for store serialization, refresh persistence, cancellation, redaction, and provider-directory visibility; keep real OAuth as an opt-in e2e.

Because the contribution guide currently says external pull requests are not accepted, would the maintainers prefer this as a first-party capability, or as an ecosystem `dsh-plugin`? I can prepare a focused implementation after the intended ownership boundary is confirmed.

comments.body:
## Local protocol proof

I also ran a transient, in-memory proof against the installed pi-ai provider. No credential value was printed or written, and no repository file was changed.

1. Register `openaiCodexProvider()` in `createModels({ credentials })`.
2. Supply a valid OAuth credential through an in-memory `CredentialStore`.
3. Call `completeSimple()` with `openai-codex / gpt-5.6-terra`.

Result:

```json
{"provider":"openai-codex","model":"gpt-5.6-terra","stopReason":"stop","text":"DSH_CODEX_OK"}
```

This confirms that the provider protocol and current model catalog work end to end. The missing product work is the DSH-owned OAuth credential lifecycle and login surface described above, not the model transport itself.

replies.body: hi, 我已经实现一个简单的实现

comments.body: Looks at this Plugin: https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-codex

这个需求现在已经有可直接安装的通用实现：[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh)。它不是调用 Codex 子代理，而是让 OpenAI Codex OAuth token 进入 Harness 原生 LLM 路由，作为父会话主模型使用。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
```

Pi 的四条官方 OAuth 流（OpenAI Codex、Anthropic、GitHub Copilot、Kimi Code）已内置，不需要再安装账号包。在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中配置：

```yaml
- id: credentials
  name: pi2dsh/credentials-oauth

- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      openai-codex:
        apiKeyEnv: PI2DSH_OAUTH_OPENAI_CODEX
        models:
          - id: gpt-5.6-luna
```

重启 Web 后执行：

```text
/login openai-codex
```

授权流程使用 PKCE + localhost callback，无头环境可走 device code；凭证以 owner-only 权限独立落盘，刷新采用按 provider 串行的双检锁轮换。`pi2dsh/credentials-oauth` 是标准 `dsh-credentials` provider，每次模型请求都会重新解析并刷新引用，token 不进入模型设置。

这条链路已经用真实 ChatGPT Pro 账号完整验证：浏览器授权 → token 落盘 → credentials provider → 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` route → DSH 原生 `ctx.llm.stream()` → Codex 模型真实回复。也就是说已经覆盖了本帖“作为 primary LLM provider”这一点，不需要修改 Harness 源码或手工生成 bundle。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh 0.20 supports OpenAI Codex OAuth subscription login as a native DSH model route, verified E2E. This directly delivers the user's primary outcome of using Codex as a primary LLM provider in DSH.
priorAudit.boundary: This is an alternate provider route; it does not repair DSH's native OAuth credential store or the configurable-provider directory logic.
priorAudit.replyAngle: pi2dsh provides Codex OAuth as a native DSH model route, letting you select Codex models on the Models page without modifying DSH core.

records.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client streamable-http transport never connects when activated as a plugin entry (fiber shows ACTIVE, zero TCP connections, silent failure; failOnStartupError: true ineffective)
records.body:
# Bug Report: dsh-mcp-client streamable-http transport hangs during plugin activation (no TCP connection, silent failure)


---

## 标题（Title）

**`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` streamable-http transport never connects when activated as a plugin entry (fiber shows ACTIVE, zero TCP connections, no error surfaced; `failOnStartupError: true` does not help)**

## 环境（Environment）

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| dsh | 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 全局安装，web profile） |
| dsh-mcp-client | 0.1.0-rc.6 |
| @modelcontextprotocol/sdk | 1.30.0（dsh 的依赖，`^1.12.0`） |
| Node.js | v24.13.0 |
| 平台 | Windows 11 (Win32), PowerShell 5.1 |
| profile | `web`（bundles: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`） |

## 描述（Description）

在 web profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中用 `streamable-http` 传输注册一个 MCP server 后，dsh 启动正常、插件条目 fiber 状态变为 `ACTIVE`，但**客户端从未向 MCP 端点发起任何 TCP 连接**（`Get-NetTCPConnection` / `netstat` 高频监控均无痕迹），工具也从未注册。整个过程**无任何错误输出**——即使设置 `failOnStartupError: true` 也不会报错（启动照常成功），问题被完全静默吞掉。

## 复现步骤（Steps to Reproduce）

1. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 添加（`insert` 语法）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-test
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: test
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://<host>:<port>/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

2. 启动：`dsh --profile web --port 0`（MCP 端点为可达的 HTTP 服务，curl / 独立 SDK 脚本均可正常连接）。
3. 观察：
   - 启动成功，无任何报错（即使 `failOnStartupError: true`）；
   - `Get-NetTCPConnection -RemotePort <port>` 持续为空（60 秒高频监控，包括 SYN_SENT/TIME_WAIT）；
   - 新会话工具列表中无 `mcp__test__*` 工具。

## 期望行为（Expected）

- 插件激活时应建立到 MCP 端点的连接、`listTools()` 同步工具并以 `mcp__<serverName>__<name>` 注册；连接失败时应记录日志并在 `failOnStartupError: true` 时阻止启动。

## 实际行为（Actual）

- 插件条目在 loader 树中存在（`ctx.loader.entries()` 可见），fiber 状态为 `ACTIVE`(2)；
- **零 TCP 连接**（netstat / PowerShell 双重确认，60 秒每 5 秒采样）；
- 无任何错误/警告日志（测试确认 dsh 的 `ctx.logger.warn/error` 不输出到 stdout/stderr，失败完全静默）；
- `failOnStartupError: true` 不生效（不报错、不阻止启动）；
- 工具未注册（`ctx.tools.layers.global.tools.data` 为空）。

## 排查证据（已排除配置/网络/服务器问题）

以下对照实验在**同一台机器、同一个 MCP 端点（可达、鉴权有效）**下进行：

| # | 实验 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 独立 Node 进程：MCP SDK `Client` + `StreamableHTTPClientTransport` 直连 | ✅ 成功（CONNECTED，`listTools` 返回 15 个工具） |
| 2 | dsh 运行时内（自定义 probe 插件，`setTimeout` 回调中）裸 `fetch` 端点 | ✅ HTTP 200 |
| 3 | dsh 运行时内（probe 插件）SDK 直连（含 `{ capabilities: {} }`、`onclose`、`setNotificationHandler` 精确复刻 dsh-mcp-client 的调用方式） | ✅ 成功（CONNECTED + 15 tools） |
| 4 | dsh 运行时内，用 `ctx.loader.entries()` 读出的**完全相同 config**（url + headers 与 YAML 解析一致）SDK 直连 | ✅ 成功（CONNECTED + 15 tools） |
| 5 | 同一插件配置，`transport: stdio`（本地 stdio server / bridge） | ✅ 正常（连接、同步、注册全部成功） |
| 6 | 同一插件配置，`streamable-http` 指向本地不可达端口 | ✅ 立即报 `ECONNREFUSED`（说明 connect 机制与错误路径本身可用） |
| 7 | **同一插件配置，`streamable-http` 指向可达远程端点** | ❌ **挂起**：fiber=ACTIVE、零 TCP 连接、无报错 |

结论：配置语法、token、网络、MCP 服务器、SDK 本身均正常；问题特定于 **dsh-mcp-client 插件实例在激活流程中以 streamable-http 连接远程端点**的场景。

## 疑似根因（Hypothesis）

1. **apply 的异步结果不被 Cordis 等待**：`dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js` 中 `apply` 为 async，注释明确说明 “Cordis treats a prototype-bearing ordinary function as a constructor, whose returned Promise is not startup work”。因此 `await connection.ready` 挂起时，fiber 仍被标记为 `ACTIVE`，错误与挂起状态对外不可见。
2. **连接在激活上下文中未发出**：对照实验 2/3/4（非激活上下文，`setTimeout` 回调）成功，实验 7（激活上下文）零 TCP 连接——疑似 Cordis fiber 激活的 async context 与 MCP SDK / undici fetch 的交互问题，导致请求在发出前挂起。
3. **`ctx.logger` 输出不可见**：`ctx.logger.warn/error`（如 `connection attempt failed`、`giving up after N attempts`）不输出到 stdout/stderr，使故障完全静默，难以排查。

## 影响（Impact）

- 通过 `streamable-http` 接入任何远程 MCP server 均静默失败，用户无法感知；
- 临时规避方案：使用 `stdio` transport + 本地桥接脚本转发到 HTTP 端点（已验证可行）。

## 建议（Suggested Fix）

1. 激活流程中 await `apply` 返回的 Promise（或显式区分构造函数/异步 apply），使挂起/失败能反映到 fiber 状态（如 LOADING/FAILED）；
2. 让 `failOnStartupError` 覆盖“连接挂起/超时”场景（增加连接超时，如复用 SDK 的 60s 默认或暴露 `connectTimeoutMs` 配置）；
3. 调查 streamable-http 在激活 async context 中不发起 TCP 连接的问题（与实验 2/3/4 的差异）；
4. `ctx.logger` 至少应输出到 stdout/stderr 或提供可配置的日志出口。

## 附加信息

- 复现用的最小 patch 文件、probe 插件脚本与观测方法（netstat / Get-NetTCPConnection / fiber 状态读取）可提供。
- 端点信息可脱敏后提供（内网 HTTP 服务，MCP 协议 2025-03-26，鉴权 Bearer）。

comments.body: 我这边做了个反向的：deepseek-harness-plugin-mcp，一个 MCP server 让任意 agent 装/跑 dsh 插件，支持 stdio 和 streamable http（--http --port）。github.com/bobleer/deepseek-harness-plugin-mcp，MIT，欢迎共建。

priorAudit.solution: pi-mcp-adapter runs unchanged and provides a fully functional MCP runtime with stdio, Streamable HTTP/SSE, OAuth, and more. It directly delivers the user's primary outcome of connecting to a streamable-http MCP server, bypassing the broken dsh-mcp-client plugin activation.
priorAudit.boundary: The native dsh-mcp-client plugin activation logic remains broken; pi-mcp-adapter is an alternate runtime, not a fix for the DSH core plugin.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Use pi-mcp-adapter to connect to your streamable-http MCP server; it's a verified alternate runtime that bypasses the broken dsh-mcp-client activation.

records.title: Web profile: dsh-tool-web (web_fetch) disabled by default -> agents fall back to bash+curl with default UA and get blocked by WAF/CDN
records.body:
**Web profile: `dsh-tool-web` (web_fetch) is disabled by default → agents fall back to `bash`+`curl` with a fingerprintable default UA and get blocked by WAF/CDN**

In a real session on the `web` profile, asking the agent to fetch a web page produced this chain:

1. `web_search` (deepseek-official provider) fails — `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is not set. Configuring API keys on the user side is understood to be the design; the problem is what happens *after* that failure.
2. `web_fetch` is **not in the agent's tool list at all** — even though the tool exists in the codebase.
3. The agent falls back to the `bash` tool and runs `curl https://...` directly → default `curl/x.x` User-Agent, no browser fingerprint → the request is **blocked by WAF** (reproduced on Baidu's search page) → the agent then improvised UA spoofing with `-A "Mozilla/5.0 ... Chrome/125..."` (fragile), and repeated blocked requests risk **IP bans**.

The effective web-profile config shows why:

```yaml
- id: tool-web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
  config:
    fetch: false
  disabled: true
```

**Requests:**

1. **Enable `web_fetch` by default in the web profile.** Plain HTTP fetch does not need an API key — it runs through the local `ctx.web` fetch provider. If it is intentionally off by default, please document the override in the README; right now the only way to find it is dumping the config:
   ```yaml
   # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
   - id: tool-web
     enabled: true
     config:
       fetch: true
   ```
2. **Make the fetch User-Agent configurable** (and default to something less fingerprintable). This is a product-quality ask, not an anti-bot one: an obviously non-browser UA is exactly what gets requests blocked and IPs banned on WAF/CDN-fronted sites.
3. **When web tools are unavailable (search key missing / fetch disabled), surface it in the runtime context or UI** instead of leaving the agent to silently fall back to `bash`+`curl` with default headers.

Happy to provide the config/UX details if useful.

comments.body:
这个场景可以先用现成 Pi Web 工具把“没有 `web_fetch` → 模型退化到 bash + curl”这条链拆掉，而且现在安装不需要写 Cordis overlay：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
```

装完重启后会向 DSH 注册 `web_search` 和 `web_fetch` 两个正常工具。搜索可选多种后端；例如自建 SearXNG：

```sh
export WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=searxng
export SEARXNG_URL=https://your-searxng.example.com
```

这条路径已经做过真实运行验证：`web_search` 经 SearXNG 返回结果，`web_fetch` 直接抓取公开 HTTPS 页面，而不是让 agent 临时拼 `curl`。桥接项目是 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh)，Pi 包保持原样运行。

它不能保证绕过所有站点的 WAF，但能直接补上原帖缺失的正式 fetch/search 工具，并避免因为工具不存在而自动滑向默认 UA 的裸 `curl`。

priorAudit.solution: @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools provides web_fetch that reads public HTTP(S) without a search key, directly delivering the user's primary outcome of fetching web pages without being blocked by WAF. It's an exact alternate to the disabled native web_fetch tool.
priorAudit.boundary: The native DSH web profile default config (web_fetch disabled) remains unchanged; pi2dsh does not fix the DSH core tool configuration.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Use @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools for web_fetch; it works without a search key and bypasses the disabled native tool.

records.title: [Bug] Image upload rejected with "current model does not support images" even after switching to a non-DeepSeek model — custom pi-ai provider models silently default to text-only input
records.body:
### Summary

dsh Web UI (v0.1.0-rc.3) rejects image uploads with "当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型" (the current model does not support images; switch to a model that does). The error persists even after switching to a model on a **custom OpenAI-compatible provider** (added via `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` under `llm-pi-ai`) that actually serves vision models. The root cause is that hand-declared models not present in the installed pi-ai catalog silently fall back to `inputModalities: ['text']`, and there is no UI surface to declare image support.

### Environment

- dsh version: 0.1.0-rc.3 (npm global install, `dsh web`), macOS
- Configuration: custom provider under `llm-pi-ai.providers` in `settings.yaml`, with hand-declared `models` entries (id + name only)

### Repro steps

1. In `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, add a custom provider to `llm-pi-ai.providers` with an OpenAI-compatible `baseURL`/`api`, and hand-declare one or more models without an `input` field:

   ```yaml
   llm-pi-ai:
     providers:
       my-gateway:
         apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_API_KEY
         api: openai-responses
         baseURL: https://gateway.example.com/v1
         models:
           - id: vision-model
             name: Vision Model
   ```

2. Start `dsh web`, open a session, and switch the model picker to `vision-model`.
3. Upload an image and send.
4. The composer shows: 当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型 (or in English: The current model does not support images; switch to a model that does).

### Expected behavior

After switching to a model that supports images, the image should be accepted and sent.

### Root cause

1. The `prompt` admission check in the host API (`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts`) calls `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)` and rejects the prompt when `inputModalities` is defined and does not include `image` (error code `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`). The same check also blocks model switching into a session that already contains images.

2. `dsh-llm-pi-ai` resolves a model's input modalities as: entry `input` → installed pi-ai catalog entry → route `defaultInput`, and **the route `defaultInput` itself defaults to `['text']`** (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`, `DEFAULT_INPUT`). Every model added through the web UI's "add a custom provider" card is hand-declared and unknown to the catalog, so it always resolves to text-only — no matter what the gateway actually serves.

3. This conservative default is deliberate (see Agent Note `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-12-pi-ai-route-default-input-modalities.md`): pi-ai silently downgrades images to a "(image omitted)" placeholder for models whose `input` lacks `image`, so refusing early is safer than claiming a capability the endpoint may not have. However, the remedy — writing `input: [text, image]` by hand in `settings.yaml` — is undiscoverable for web-only users, and the model-settings editor exposes neither the per-model `input` field nor the route-level `defaultInput`.

4. The error message itself ("switch to a model that does [support images]") offers no reachable fix, because no configuration surface could make a hand-declared model image-capable at the time.

### Fix

**Immediate workaround (no upgrade needed, hot-reloads):**

Declare image support at the route (applies to all undeclared models on the route) or per model:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-gateway:
      # option A: route-level default for every undeclared model
      defaultInput: [text, image]
      models:
        - id: vision-model
          # option B: per-model declaration
          input: [text, image]
```

`settings.yaml` is watched by the settings service (chokidar, default on), so the change applies without restarting `dsh web`.

**Code fix (implemented locally, ready for upstream adoption):**

1. `packages/client/ui-settings-models`: the pi-ai model-list editor's advanced fold now has an "Image input" checkbox per model — checking it writes `input: ['text', 'image']`, unchecking drops the declaration. This closes the discoverability gap at the surface that creates hand-declared models. Tests added; `ModelListEditor.tsx` at 100% coverage.
2. `packages/client/ui-conversation`: the `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` message now points to the fix ("…or enable image input for it under Models settings" / 或在"设置→模型"中为该模型开启图片输入).
3. The Agent Note above was updated to reflect the editor change.

Validation: `test:gui` (3756 tests), `typecheck`, `lint`, `doc-sync` (28 gates), and per-file coverage all pass.

### Suggestion for maintainers

- Consider whether the "undeclared = text-only" default should distinguish **declared** text-only from **undeclared** (unknown), admitting images for unknown models and letting the provider decide — or keep the conservative default and ship the UI toggle (described above) so the remedy is reachable.
- The change also leaves the error message accurate while making the fix discoverable.

comments.body:
原帖给出的 `input: [text, image]` 是“让这个自定义模型直接吃图片”的正确修法。另一个现成路线是：保持主路由的能力声明不变，把该 OpenAI-compatible 视觉端点作为辅助眼睛，让原来的 DeepSeek 主模型继续推理。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision

export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://gateway.example.com/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=vision-model
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$MY_GATEWAY_API_KEY
```

重启 Web 后选择 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 伴生分组并直接贴图。伴生 route 负责图片准入；`@kassing/pi-vision` 调用上面配置的视觉模型，把分析作为 DSH 上下文注入；再从发给文本主模型的请求中移除图片块。因此无需把不吃图的主路由谎报成 image，也不会触发 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`。

这条链已用真实 DSH Web 图片会话完成端到端验证。复现步骤和测试图：[pi2dsh vision-bridge example](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge)。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's provider route translates input modalities and compat flags for Pi providers, allowing custom OpenAI-compatible providers to declare image support. This directly delivers the user's primary outcome of using a vision model on a custom provider without DSH's silent text-only fallback.

records.title: Proposal: allow image uploads in GUI when the main model is text-only but vision tools are installed
records.body:
## Summary

When using DeepSeek Harness with a **text-only main model** (e.g. DeepSeek V4 Flash via the deepseek-official provider) together with the vision plugin (dsh-vision-toolkit: vision_glance / vision_detect / vision_pixel_diff etc.), the GUI **rejects image uploads** with:

> 当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型 (reason: `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`)

## Why this is a gap

The vision tools read image **paths** from the session workspace and work perfectly with a text-only model — we use them daily. But the GUI upload path in `dsh-host-apiproxy` assumes images can only be consumed as **model input**: when a prompt contains image parts it checks the current model's `inputModalities` and refuses when the model does not declare `"image"`.

So a text-only main model can never receive user images, even though the harness has vision tooling that could read them from disk.

## Suggested behavior

When the selected model does not support image input, do not reject the upload. Instead:

1. Save the uploaded image into the session workspace (e.g. `.dsh-uploads/`)
2. Hand the agent a **text reference** (file path) in the user message, e.g. `[用户上传了一张图片，已保存到 <path>。请使用 vision_glance 等视觉工具查看。]`

This matches the existing "images are for tools, not the model" architecture and makes the text-only + vision-tools combination fully usable from the GUI.

## Workaround

We currently apply a local patch to `dsh-host-apiproxy` that converts image parts into saved files + path references. It works well; it would be great to have this behavior built in (ideally configurable, e.g. only when the model lacks image input, or always when vision tools are present).

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness latest rc
- DeepSeek V4 Flash (text-only) + dsh-vision-toolkit
- Web profile (browser GUI)

comments.body:
Feel free to try our zero-core-patch plugin for this, verified on 0.1.0-rc.6. repo: [https://github.com/yuqingsh/dsh-image-subagent](https://github.com/yuqingsh/dsh-image-subagent
)
We do three things:
1. Admission: wraps the llm service via cordis's internal/get waterfall so resolveModelInfo reports image input for text-only routes — pasting images no longer fails with MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES (listModels stays truthful, the model picker is not misled).
2. LLM boundary: wraps prepareCall/stream as lazy generators that clone the (deep-frozen) request and project image blocks into explicit text placeholders carrying the attachmentId — no more UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT, the turn completes.
3. Delegation: the text-only main model hands the image to an in-session multimodal subagent, which reads the durable attachment via read_attachment — native multimodal comprehension (multi-turn follow-ups), no vision-API credentials, and the image stays inside the harness's own attachment store with session-scoped authorization.

This workflow is available without a Harness core patch through [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh), using an explicit companion route rather than changing the capability declaration of the original text-only route.

Install the engine once, then the automatic vision bridge:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

Point it at any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint:

```sh
export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

After restarting DSH, pi2dsh automatically registers a `<provider>-vision` companion for every text-only route. The Web picker shows **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge**, so pasted images pass admission there while the original DeepSeek route remains truthfully text-only.

Two verified consumption modes are available:

1. `@kassing/pi-vision` analyzes the attachment with the configured VLM and injects the analysis before the DeepSeek model step.
2. Alternatively, install `pi-vision-tool` to expose `describe_image`, letting the agent choose when to inspect a materialized image path.

Before forwarding to the original adapter, the companion removes image blocks recursively, including images nested in tool results. Existing path-based vision tools can use the materialized file path as well.

We verified the full DSH CLI and Web loops with independent image probes: the text-only DeepSeek route answered correctly, and the recorded request sent to DeepSeek contained no pixels.

Reproducible example: https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

Same gate: the Web UI rejects the paste before any vision tool runs.

[dsh-plugin-multimodal](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal) only opens admission so a text-only main model can accept a paste. It does not claim official DeepSeek can see images, and it is not a `vision_*` toolbox.

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

Restart `dsh web`. [#1709](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709)

comments.body:
同样遇到过这个问题。第三方（llm-pi-ai 手工声明）模型没有「推理等级」入口，是因为适配器默认不暴露 reasoningEfforts，需要每个模型声明档位。

我写了一个插件解决：[dsh-thinking-effort](https://github.com/hytime/dsh-thinking-effort)（MIT）
- 宿主：启动/设置变更时自动给缺档位的模型补默认档位（Off / High / Max，官方 DeepSeek 风格），不覆盖自定义；
- 设置页：新增「思考强度档位」页面，逐模型勾选档位并自由填线上值（如给 high 填 ultra），一键应用到全部 / 恢复默认。

安装：
```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:hytime/dsh-thinking-effort
```

宣传帖见：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1817
安装文档（AI 可一键执行）：https://github.com/hytime/dsh-thinking-effort/blob/main/INSTALL.md

Short answer: reasoning effort / thinking levels are a DeepSeek-model API parameter, so third-party models simply don't expose it - the harness can't set what the upstream API doesn't accept, and the model card usually lists the supported parameters.

If you specifically want thinking-level control on non-DeepSeek models, there is a community plugin for that: dsh-thinking-effort (see the discussion from today) - it adds configurable thinking effort for pi-ai/third-party models via settings UI instead of relying on the native API parameter. For models that have no thinking mode at all, the closest workaround is prompting (e.g. 'think step by step before answering'), though it is weaker than a native reasoning parameter.

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh 0.20 maps Pi per-child thinkingLevel to DSH reasoningEffort, and Pi providers can carry reasoning effort maps, so custom models can get reasoning level configuration through the Pi route.

records.title: 让纯文本模型也能粘贴图片发送：dsh-image-bridge 补丁
records.body:
## 让纯文本模型也能"粘贴图片发送"：dsh-image-bridge 补丁

### 问题

DSH 要求"能发图 = 当前对话模型支持视觉"。当对话模型是纯文本的（如 `deepseek-v4-flash`）时，在输入框粘贴图片会报：

> 当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型（`MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`）

### 方案

一个本地补丁，修改 `dsh-host-apiproxy` 的 `admit()`：**图片不再整体拒绝，而是落盘后改写成"本地路径文本"**，纯文本模型收到后自动调用可用的视觉工具，把图片交给视觉模型（如 `gpt-5.6-luna`）处理。

```
粘贴图片 + 文字指令 → 发送
  ├─ 图片落盘到 ~/.dsh/attachments/...（附扩展名硬链接）
  ├─ 消息改写为文本："[用户上传了一张图片，本地路径: ...。请用可用的视觉工具（如 view_image 或 vision_glance）查看]"
  ├─ 纯文本模型调用可用的视觉工具
  └─ 视觉模型看图并返回文字 → 对话继续
```

**效果：图片走视觉模型，文本对话走原模型，粘贴即发。**

### 与视觉插件配合

改写文本使用**通用措辞**，可搭配任一视觉工具插件（可共存）：

| 插件 | 工具 | 适用 |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-vision](https://github.com/dsh-external/dsh-vision) | `view_image` | 快速看图、图片问答（轻量） |
| [dsh-vision-toolkit](https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit) | `vision_glance` / `vision_ground` / `vision_detect` 等 10 个 | 细粒度视觉工程：逐字 OCR、像素定位、UI 还原、像素比对 |

### 技术要点（v2 更新）

- **硬链接而非符号链接**：附件对象本身无扩展名，补丁在旁创建带扩展名的**硬链接**。符号链接会被视觉工具的 `realpath()` 穿透回无扩展名路径导致 "unsupported image format"，硬链接则保持扩展名可见——实测 `dsh-vision-toolkit` 可直接读取。
- **通用措辞**：不写死工具名，模型按装配的插件自动选择。
- **`allowedDirs`**（仅 toolkit 需要）：在其配置 `allowedDirs` 加入 `~/.dsh/attachments` 以便 `vision_*` 工具读取粘贴图片。

### 使用方法

1. 安装视觉工具插件（dsh-vision 或 dsh-vision-toolkit），配好视觉模型端点
2. 下载补丁包，`node apply-patch.mjs` → 重启 DSH
3. 粘贴图片 + 文字发送即可

支持 `--dry-run`（预检）、`--rollback`（回滚）、自动备份与语法检查。

### 已验证（实测截图）

- 打补丁 → 重启 → 粘贴图片发送，完整链路可用
- 与 `dsh-vision-toolkit` 共存：`vision_glance` 对粘贴图片给出逐字文字、UI 元素清单、配色、布局层级的细粒度分析
- 回滚后文件与 npm 原始版 md5 一致

### 说明

- 补丁只改 `admit()` 一处逻辑，不碰其他代码；升级 DSH 后需重新执行
- 适合 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy` 同版本）

---

**补丁包下载（v2，硬链接版）：** https://gist.github.com/baileyh8/8a766bce1460342196a5d80332d8bb44
（含 `apply-patch.mjs` 安装器、原始/补丁代码块、README）

欢迎试用反馈；也希望官方能考虑把"上传图片自动桥接视觉模型"做成内置能力 🙂

records.title: 无法读取给定的网页
records.body: 给他一个官网，让他读取分析，但是返回无法读取这个网页， 他自己去搜索后，读取到了网页，再返回信息给我。

comments.body:
+1我也有这个问题，让他自查，说是沙箱封锁，给他网页只有web search工具，工具返回结果只有网页的标题和url，也就是去浏览器搜某个东西返回的预览结果，读不到网页具体内容，要读取网页内容，得连官网服务器，获取html源码才行，下面是它的思考过程，总的来说还是没办法联网

非常清晰的结论了：
1. 对所有主机（deepseek、microsoft.com）的 TLS 握手都失败，错误都是 SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS
2. 证书存储（Root store）能打开，有 55 个证书
3. TCP 连接是通的
4. 纯 HTTP 是通的

所以问题是：Schannel 无法获取凭据。这通常发生在：
- 进程运行在受限的 token/会话中，无法访问 LSA/凭据
- 沙箱限制了某些 Windows API 调用（比如凭据相关 API）
- DSH 的命令沙箱可能在进程上挂了某种限制

关键点：这是**沙箱（sandbox）对命令进程的限制**，不是用户机器本身的网络问题。用户的浏览器能连，因为浏览器不是跑在沙箱里。

让我验证一下沙箱是否真的限制了凭据——比如查一下进程是否运行在什么特殊模式。不过实际上我已经有足够证据了：
1. TCP 通（网络层没封）
2. HTTP 明文通（应用层没封）
3. TLS/Schannel 凭据不可用（安全层被限制）→ SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS

这个错误的一个常见原因：沙箱以某种方式限制了进程访问 LSA 凭据（比如受限令牌、或者 DSH 的沙箱钩子拦截了相关 API）。ConstrainedLanguage 模式之前的描述提到过 "In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types; .NET static calls fail with 'only core types' errors"——但我们现在是 workspace-write 模式（FullLanguage），.NET 调用是工作的（SslStream 等都能创建，TCP 能连）。

所以更可能的是 DSH 的沙箱在网络层做了 TLS 拦截，或者通过环境钩子禁用了 Schannel 凭据获取。这是设计如此：沙箱允许 TCP（因为 web 服务器本地调用需要？）但故意禁掉 TLS 凭据，或者只是副作用。

其实，让我想想 DSH 的设计。DSH_WEB_URL 是 http://127.0.0.1:3080——本地服务。沙箱可能设计为：只允许本地回环 + 阻止出站网络的一种方式。但 TCP 出站明明通了（能连 api-docs.deepseek.com:443 和 :80）！HTTP 明文也能拿到响应。只有 TLS 凭据失败。

这很奇怪——TCP 通、HTTP 通、TLS 凭据失败。这更像是一个**凭据/安全上下文问题**，可能是：
1. DSH 沙箱以某种方式运行命令（比如通过服务/不同会话），该上下文没有用户凭据（如 LSA 会话密钥、DPAPI 凭据等）
2. Schannel 需要访问 LSA 或者用户的凭据缓存，而受限上下文访问不到

SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS 在 Schannel 中的常见原因：
- 系统时钟严重错误（TLS 时间戳校验）——不太可能
- 无法加载客户端证书存储/无法访问安全包
- 受限 token（比如在服务会话、网络服务账户下运行）
- 沙箱钩子拦截了 AcquireCredentialsHandle

不管具体机制，对用户来说答案很清楚：
1. 是 DSH 沙箱对命令执行环境的限制导致的——不是机器断网
2. 我的 pwsh 命令就是跑在这个受限环境里，所以连不上
3. 浏览器不在沙箱里，所以能连
4. 我唯一能联网的通道是 web_search 工具（由 DSH 服务器/代理执行，不受此限制）

我可以给出这个结论了。也许还能检查一下进程是否是管理员受限（之前 whoami 显示 Administrators 是 "Group used for deny only"——deny only！这说明管理员组被禁用了，进程以非管理员权限运行）。

"Group used for deny only" for BUILTIN\Administrators 意味着进程 token 是标准用户 token（UAC 过滤掉了管理员权限）。这可能和凭据问题有关，但标准用户也是可以正常 TLS 的。所以根源还是沙箱环境。

让我总结回答。不需要更多测试了，我已经有足够的证据链。让我最后确认一下沙箱是否 Hook 了某些 API——不，这个没法直接测。直接给结论吧。


replies.body: fetch测试了有用，你这个search是可以代替dsh默认的web search吗？

可以作为 Agent 的搜索/抓取能力使用，但要把两件事分开：

web_fetch 是拿到一个 URL 后读取网页正文，不需要搜索 API key；
web_search 本身不拥有互联网索引，它是搜索后端的统一适配层，必须配置 Brave、Tavily、Serper、Exa、You.com、Jina、Firecrawl、Perplexity 中的一家 API，或者使用自己可访问的 SearXNG / Ollama。
我刚重新用当前最新版 @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools 在真实 DSH runtime 里跑过：原包成功注册 web_search、web_fetch，SearXNG 请求/响应完整穿过 DSH 工具运行时，web_fetch 也成功读取了公网 HTTPS 页面。

dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
重启后运行 /web-tools 选择并配置搜索 Provider。配置完成后，它可以在 Agent 的任务层面承担原来 web search 的用途，但不会修改或卸载 DSH 自带实现，两者可以并存。

还有一个容易忽略的问题：搜索质量最终受所选搜索引擎的索引、排序和地域偏差影响。质量差或覆盖面窄的后端，确实可能让 Agent 反复看到同一批来源，困在信息茧房里。比较稳的用法是：

对重要问题使用两个独立 Provider 交叉搜索；
搜索结果只做线索，随后用 web_fetch 阅读原始页面；
要求 Agent 引用多个彼此独立的一手来源；
这个包支持单次调用指定 provider，可以比较不同后端而不用改全局配置。
项目：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh

priorAudit.solution: @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools web_fetch reads public HTTP(S) URLs without a search key, providing an exact alternate for the user's primary outcome of reading a given webpage directly.
priorAudit.boundary: The native DSH web tool's URL-reading defect remains unfixed; pi2dsh does not repair it.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Use pi2dsh's web_fetch to read the given URL directly without needing a search first.

records.title: 给纯文本模型开发自定义识图工具时，发现图片准入设计有点别扭
records.body:
我们在给 DSH 开发一个自定义识图工具（vision-agy：图片经外部视觉引擎 agy/Gemini 读成结构化文字证据，再喂给 DeepSeek 这种纯文本模型）的时候，发现一个绕不开的设计问题，想反馈一下。

## 问题现象

纯文本模型（DeepSeek/GLM）的会话里，用户贴一张图片，发送时直接被拒绝，提示 Model does not support image input.。

我们理解这是防御性设计：防止把模型处理不了的内容发过去。但对自定义工具来说，这个限制有点别扭——我们的工具根本不依赖模型本身看图：图片由外部引擎读取，转成文字后模型再读。所以"模型能不能看图"和"这个会话能不能处理图片"其实是两回事，但当前准入只看前者。

## 具体表现

发消息时（dsh-host-apiproxy）检查当前模型的 inputModalities，不含 image 直接拒绝（MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES）；即使放行，请求发出前（dsh-llm-pi-ai stream 层）还有一道 UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT 检查再拦一次。

结果就是：图片根本进不了会话，自定义识图工具没有用武之地。

## 可能的解法（仅供参考）

1. 准入条件从"模型模态支持图片"放宽为"模型模态支持图片 或 会话具备可消费图片的工具"
2. 或者参考 modlens 插件里 paste-to-path 的思路：粘贴图片自动落盘成临时文件，把文件路径（纯文本）注入会话——模型不会触发图片准入，工具按路径读图。这条路目前要靠插件自己实现，如果平台直接支持会更顺

想听听维护者的看法，也欢迎讨论有没有更合适的做法。谢谢！

[dsh-plugin-multimodal](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal) 坐在适配层：让 Web 先收图，纯文本主模型走 sidecar 转写。不替代 Anionex 那种 vision_* 工具箱。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

[#1709](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709) · [#474](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/474)

你这里区分“模型原生视觉”和“会话具备工具视觉”是对的。这个准入问题现在可以只装一层通用中间件解决，`vision-agy` 本身不用改：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
```

pi2dsh 会为每条纯文本 route 自动注册独立的 `<route>-vision` 伴生 route。Web 里选择 **+ Vision Bridge** 分组后：

1. DSH 目录看到伴生 route 可接收 image，图片能通过 host 准入并正常持久化；
2. 附件被物化成真实临时文件，主 Agent 收到含文件路径的文字标记；
3. 你的 `vision-agy` 可以按路径读取并调用 agy/Gemini；
4. 真正请求 DeepSeek/GLM 文本 adapter 前，完整消息历史里的 image block 会递归替换成文本，因此下游仍是纯文本，不会触发第二道 `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`。

这里不需要伪改原始模型的 `inputModalities`，也不要求使用 pi2dsh 自带的视觉插件；任何能吃文件路径的现有 tool/MCP/skill 都可以接这条通路。若想参考两种已经闭环的消费方式（自动分析注入 / Agent 调 `describe_image`），完整 Web 证据和配置在 [#2040](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2040)。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's vision bridge (pasted image -> Pi vision package -> text injected into a text model) directly delivers the primary outcome: letting a text-only model like DeepSeek handle images via an external vision engine, bypassing the native input-modality gate.
priorAudit.boundary: The native DSH input-modality admission check (MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES / UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT) is not repaired; the bridge works around it by converting images to text before they reach the model.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Your vision-agy approach is exactly what the Pi vision bridge does — paste an image, have an external vision package read it, and inject the text into the text model, sidestepping the modality gate entirely.

records.title: OpenCode zen 免费模型（big-pickle）在 DSH 中必现 429 FreeUsageLimitError（附修复补丁）
records.body:
**问题 / Problem**

在 DSH 中使用 opencode provider 的 zen 免费模型（如 big-pickle）时，每次生成请求都失败：

```
429: {"type":"FreeUsageLimitError","message":"Error from provider (Console): Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."}
```

**根因 / Root cause**

OpenCode zen 网关（`https://opencode.ai/zen/v1`）的免费额度只放行带 opencode CLI 客户端标识（`User-Agent: opencode/latest/<version>/cli`）的请求；任何其他 User-Agent 都会被当作匿名客户端拒绝（直连实测可复现同一错误）。而 DSH 的 LLM 适配器按[强制 attribution 策略](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-06-21-mandatory-app-attribution-headers.md)给每个 provider 请求发送 `User-Agent: deepseek-harness/<version> (+https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)`——正是被网关拒绝的身份。pi-ai 的 opencode 目录模型也没有自带 CLI headers（对比 github-copilot / kimi-coding 都在目录 JSON 里声明了 UA）。

社区常见绕行方案是本地起一个代理改写 UA（如 [pi 的 zen headers 修复](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/2824) 方向一致），但需要用户额外运行一个进程，体验很差。

**修复方案 / Proposed fix（补丁已完成，全部门禁通过）**

在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 adapter 中，对指向 zen 网关的请求（provider 为 `opencode`/`opencode-go`，或解析后 baseURL 主机为 `opencode.ai`）发送 opencode CLI 客户端标识：

- `User-Agent: opencode/latest/1.18.18/cli`
- `x-opencode-client: cli`

其余 provider 仍发送 harness attribution UA。这属于 attribution 政策中的 provider 专属请求身份类别（与 DeepSeek 的 user-id / session-id 请求身份并列），并用新的 Agent Note 记录决策。

完整补丁在 fork 分支：**https://github.com/Liyuntong123/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/opencode-zen-client-identity**

包含：
- 代码改动：`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts`（+54 行）
- 测试：mock-server wire 测试（zen 路由 UA / x-opencode-client）+ 谓词单测，`adapter.ts` 覆盖率 100%
- Agent Note（feature 类，中英双语三元组）
- 文档更新（llm-pi-ai README 中英 + `docs/subsystems/llm-streaming.md` 中英）
- 门禁：tests 104 passed / typecheck / lint / doc-sync（28 项 PASS）/ 翻译配对，全部通过

**验证 / Verification**

- 真实网关实测：仅带 `User-Agent: opencode/latest/1.18.18/cli` 的 chat completions → HTTP 200；不带 → 429（与上述错误一致）
- `/models` 不校验 UA（200），模型列表探测不受影响

如果维护者认可这个方向，我可以把补丁整理成正式 PR 提交。

records.title: [Bug] Subagents inherit session-start options.model instead of the current UI-selected model (causes unexpected v4-pro billing)
records.body:
## Summary
When the user switches the main conversation model in the Web UI (e.g. to deepseek-v4-flash), subagents spawned afterwards still use deepseek-v4-pro, because they inherit the parent session's CREATION-TIME options.model snapshot instead of the current UI-selected model. This caused unexpected, large v4-pro billing while the UI clearly showed flash.

## Evidence
- Main conversation switched to flash at ~20:29 (all main-session requests are flash afterwards; session log shows 0 v4-pro requests after 21:00).
- EVERY subagent session (23 sessions) used v4-pro: the first request/header of each shows model=deepseek-v4-pro; ~550+ pro request records in total.
- Billing: pro kept growing (e.g. 10.36 CNY to 14.44 CNY) during subagent work while the dialog indicator showed flash.
- settings.yaml agent-default-model: deepseek-v4-flash has NO effect here (it only applies when there is no session-level model selection).

## Root cause (code)
packages/.../dsh-subagent/lib/types/child-agent.js -> resolveChildAgentOptions() (lines ~52-57):
    const parentProvider = parent.options.provider;
    const parentModel = parent.options.model;   // session-creation snapshot, NOT the current UI selection
    ...
    ...(parentModel !== undefined ? { model: parentModel } : {})
The parent's per-request model comes from the live model-selection mechanism (dsh-agent/lib/types/model-selection.js), but parent.options.model is NOT updated when the UI selection changes, so subagents inherit a stale model.

## Expected behavior
Subagents should inherit the model selected for the CURRENT turn/conversation (e.g. if flash is selected now, a subagent/workflow triggered by this turn should run on flash).

## Suggested fix
1. In resolveChildAgentOptions(), read the parent's CURRENT effective model selection (the same source model-selection.js uses) instead of parent.options.model; or
2. Update the session's options.model when the UI model changes; or
3. Add an explicit model option to the plain subagent tool (currently only workflow's agent() supports per-agent model override).

## Workarounds (user side)
- Use the workflow tool with an explicit model: deepseek-v4-flash for multi-subagent tasks.
- Start a new session with flash selected as the session model.

---
DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.6 (Windows, Web)
中文附注：普通 subagent 继承会话创建时的 options.model（本会话为 v4-pro），UI 切换模型不传导，导致 pro 意外计费；期望子代理跟随当前对话所选模型。

comments.body:
在官方修复合入前，如果主要诉求是避免子代理继续偷偷走 session-start 的 Pro，可以换用 Pi 子代理运行时作为立即可用的规避路径：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @tintinweb/pi-subagents
```

`@tintinweb/pi-subagents` 的默认模型策略是 `inherit parent`，它在**创建子代理当刻**从 Pi runtime 的当前 `ctx.model` 解析路由；pi2dsh 的 `ctx.model` 投影来自 DSH 当前会话选择，并把解析出的 provider/model 显式写进新 child 的 `agentOptions`。因此它不读取原生 `parent.options.model` 那个创建时快照。

如果费用边界必须绝对固定，还可以在 `.pi/agents/<name>.md` 里直接写：

```yaml
model: deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash
```

然后让主 Agent 用 `Agent({ subagent_type: "<name>", ... })` 调度。这样无论全局默认怎样漂移，这类子代理都只走明确的 Flash route。

这不是模拟 child：我们已验证 `createAgentSession` → DSH `ctx.agents` → child `request/header` → 真实模型回复的整条链路，每个子代理有独立 durable session。实现与验证入口在 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh)。

Adding a reproduction from dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 on macOS Web UI.

The parent session active request route was:

  provider: toolcode-dsh
  model: gpt-5.6-sol

I started a continuable in-process spawn subagent without any per-call agentOptions override. However, the child descriptor recorded:

  agentProvider: command-code
  agentModel: stealth/ox-alpha

The child then sent its requests through command-code/stealth/ox-alpha, even though the parent was actively using toolcode-dsh/gpt-5.6-sol. The child subsequently encountered 429 rate limits, empty responses, and stream transport failures.

This appears consistent with the current implementation:

  continuation.js:
    request.agentOptions?.provider ?? parent.options.provider
    request.agentOptions?.model ?? parent.options.model

  child-agent.js:
    resolveChildAgentOptions() also reads parent.options.

The important distinction is that parent.options appears to contain the session-start or agent-creation route, while the Web UI current model selection is reflected in per-request configuration. New subagents therefore inherit a stale route after the parent model is switched.

Could you clarify the intended semantics here?

Possible fixes:

1. New subagents inherit the current effective model selection of the parent; or
2. The subagent tool exposes an explicit per-call provider/model override, while preserving the current fixed-route inheritance as the default.

No session identifiers or credentials are included in this report.

---

补充一个来自中文用户的复现说明：

在 macOS Web UI 的 dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 中，父会话当前请求使用 toolcode-dsh/gpt-5.6-sol，但新建的 continuable spawn 子代理却使用了 command-code/stealth/ox-alpha。创建调用没有传入 agentOptions 覆盖。

这说明子代理读取的是父 Agent 创建时保存的固定 options，而不是父会话当前请求使用的模型选择。随后子代理出现 429、空响应和流中断。

希望确认这是有意设计，还是应该让新子代理跟随父会话当前模型，或者提供单次 provider/model 覆盖参数。

Confirmed against the `0.1.1-rc.2` source — your walkthrough is accurate, and the two sites you quote are exactly the load-bearing reads:

- `packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:68-78` — `resolveChildAgentOptions()` copies `parent.options.provider` / `parent.options.model` into the child options.
- `packages/subagent/subagent/src/continuation.ts:420-421` — `startContinuable` snapshots the same pair into the descriptor (`request.agentOptions?.provider ?? parent.options.provider`), and `:463` also funnels the request through `resolveChildAgentOptions`.

Note the continuation path calls both: the descriptor snapshot at `:420-421` and the actual options at `:463` — the load-bearing read is `resolveChildAgentOptions`, the descriptor pair is a mirror (which is why duoartisan's one-shot `spawn` descriptor on #4065 carries no `agentProvider`/`agentModel` yet still misroutes identically).

**On the intended semantics.** `parent.options` is the *create/resume-time seed* — the provider/model declared when the agent was materialized. It is deliberately never rewritten afterwards; the live per-turn route lives in the folded `requestHeader()` (`packages/core/session/src/index.ts:670`), which is the same source the web layer's `selectionFor()` uses to decide what the chat actually sends on (per the walkthrough in #4065). So the split-brain is structural: delegation reads the seed because it never consults the session store, while the UI pick / default change only ever updates the route. The docs' "subagents inherit the parent's model" reads naturally as "the parent's model" = the model the parent is actually using, so following the live route is the expected user-facing contract; the seed is meant as the fallback before a first request exists — not as a permanent re-stamp.

This is now the 6th independent report in the same family, and the costs are concrete in every one of them: #2904 (401s), #3552 (billing misroute), #4077 (429 weekly-quota burn), #4065 (router fan-out + quota), and here — #1472 (v4-pro billing; your rc.2 repro showing `toolcode-dsh/gpt-5.6-sol` parent spawning `command-code/stealth/ox-alpha` children with 429/empty/stream failures). A fix direction is already banked on the #4077 thread; it matches what you suggest:

1. Make `resolveChildAgentOptions()` read the parent's **live route** — `parent.session?.requestHeader()?.config` — falling back to `parent.options` only when no request exists yet. One call site covers one-shot and continuable, spawn and in-process.
2. Mirror the change in **both** copies of the function (src + bundled `lib/` build) — the two-copy hazard duoartisan flagged on #4065.
3. (Your option 3, also banked) expose an explicit per-call `provider`/`model` override on the plain `subagent` tool; today only `workflow`'s `agent()` supports one.

Workaround confirmed end-to-end (duoartisan on #4065): opening a fresh session after switching the default re-stamps the seed, so parent and children agree again — resuming an existing session does not. Until the fix lands, that plus the workflow override are the reliable paths.

中文摘要：已对照 rc.2 源码确认两处快照读取（child-agent.ts:73-78 与 continuation.ts:420-421）；`parent.options` 是创建/恢复时的种子，当前轮的实时路由在 `session.requestHeader()`（session.ts:670），子代理继承了种子而非实时路由——这是结构性的 split-brain。家族已第 6 报（#2904/#3552/#4077/#4065/本线程），修复方向已在 #4077 线沉淀：1) resolveChildAgentOptions 改读实时路由、无首请求时才回退种子 2) 同步改 src 与 bundled 两份拷贝 3) 普通 subagent 工具开放显式 provider/model 覆盖。临时规避：切模型后开新会话即可重打种子。

priorAudit.solution: @tintinweb/pi-subagents via pi2dsh inherits the parent's LIVE selected route (not a creation-time snapshot), so subagents spawned after switching the UI model will use the current selection, avoiding the stale-model billing issue.
priorAudit.boundary: The DSH-native subagent model-inheritance bug (resolveChildAgentOptions reading parent.options.model snapshot) is not repaired; the fix works by using Pi subagents' live-route inheritance instead of the native subagent path.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Pi subagents inherit the parent's live selected route, not a creation-time snapshot — switch to flash in the UI and children will follow, avoiding the v4-pro billing surprise.

records.title: 【Ideas】官方 API 何时开放图像输入？DSH 何时能用 read_image 读图？
records.body:
## 背景

DeepSeek V4 Pro 正式版（DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813，2026-08-13）宣布「首次原生支持图像推理」（[36氪实测报道](https://www.c114.net.cn/industry/110569.html)），但公开 API 至今仍是 text-only。2026-08-14 用官方 API 实测：

1. `POST https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions`，`messages` 使用 OpenAI 兼容的 `image_url` 内容块 → **HTTP 400**：`unknown variant 'image_url', expected 'text'`
2. [官方 API 更新日志](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news) 只说「deepseek-v4-pro 已更新为 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813，调用方式保持不变」，未记录任何图像输入格式
3. [阿里云百炼文档](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deepseek-v4-pro) 标注 deepseek-v4-pro「输入模态 Text」
4. DSH 侧：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` 将所有 DeepSeek 模型声明为 `inputModalities: ["text"]`，`read_image` 对 deepseek-v4-pro 报「does not declare image input」

## 想请教

1. 官方 API 是否有图像输入的开放时间表？若有，预计是 OpenAI 兼容 `image_url`、文件上传还是独立 vision 端点？
2. API 开放后，`dsh-llm-deepseek` 适配器是否会同步声明 image 输入，`read_image` 能否即开即用？
3. 过渡期 DSH 是否考虑把「多提供商视觉回退」内置为一等能力？社区已有 [visionDS](https://github.com/deveuper/visionDS)、[dsh-tool-see-image](https://github.com/gugu123a/dsh-tool-see-image)、[dsh-vision-toolkit](https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit) 等插件先例，说明「纯文本模型读截图」是真实需求。

## 场景

纯文本模型做网页自动化 / GUI 操作时，视觉核验（读截图确认填表结果、判断页面状态）目前只能人工代劳或外接第三方视觉模型。API 开放图像输入后，`read_image` + 浏览器截图即可让 agent 独立完成最后一环。

comments.body:
你第 3 个问题现在已经有完整可用的方案，尤其适合浏览器截图已经落在 workspace/本地路径里的场景：DeepSeek 继续做纯文本主模型，另一个 vision provider 只负责看图。

Pi 生态的 `@kassing/pi-vision` 可以通过 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 原样运行在 DSH 上。它会在首个 model step 前识别图片路径或 Web 粘贴的附件，调用单独配置的视觉模型，再把结果作为 DSH context injection 注入；因此不需要把整轮主模型切到视觉模型，图片像素也不会发给 DeepSeek 官方文本 API。

安装只需要 DSH 官方命令：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

配置视觉端点后重启 DSH：

```sh
export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

pi2dsh 会自动为每条纯文本模型路由注册 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 伴生分组，不需要手工修改模型声明。CLI 可以直接引用截图路径，Web 可以像原生 VLM 一样粘贴图片。

我们已在真实 DSH CLI 和 Web 两端验证：独立视觉模型识图 → `pi2dsh:@kassing/pi-vision` 上下文注入 → 纯文本 DeepSeek 继续推理并正确回答。

完整复现：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

Q1 没时间表。你测到的 400 和官方 changelog 对得上：公开 chat-completions 仍是 text-only，`input: [text, image]` 也不会让官方 DeepSeek 突然能看图。

Q2 即使 API 开了，`dsh-llm-deepseek` 现在把 DeepSeek 模型写成 `inputModalities: ["text"]`（[#911](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/911)），适配器不改声明的话 `read_image` 还是过不了门。

过渡期想贴图进会话，和楼上「另挂一个 vision provider 看截图」不是同一刀。这边只补**准入**：纯文本主模型也能把图贴进输入框，不伪装官方已经支持图像，也不是 `vision_*` / `read_image` 工具箱。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

重启 `dsh web`。[#1709](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709)

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's vision bridge (pasted image -> Pi vision package -> text injected into a text model) directly delivers the primary outcome: letting a text-only model like DeepSeek read screenshots via an external vision engine, filling the gap until the official API opens image input.
priorAudit.boundary: The official DeepSeek API image-input timeline and dsh-llm-deepseek adapter's inputModalities declaration are not changed; the bridge works around the text-only API by converting images to text externally.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Until the official API opens image input, the Pi vision bridge gives you read_image-style functionality today: paste a screenshot, an external vision package reads it, and the text goes to DeepSeek.

records.title: Make pi-ai's inferred `supportsDeveloperRole` configurable on hand-declared llm-pi-ai routes
records.body:
`CONTRIBUTING.md` says external pull requests cannot be accepted right now, so this is filed here instead. A working patch exists on a fork if it is useful; otherwise the report alone should be enough to reproduce.

## The gap

`llm-pi-ai` lets a profile configure `compat.thinkingFormat` and `compat.supportsReasoningEffort` for a hand-declared route, but not the third switch pi-ai infers the same way. In `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, `openai-completions.js:1148` computes:

```js
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)
```

`isNonStandard` matches only a short host list (nvidia, cerebras, xai, together, chutes, deepseek.com, zai, moonshot, opencode, cloudflare, ant-ling). A private gateway is never on it, so the switch infers `true`, and `openai-completions.js:787-788` then sends the system prompt under the `developer` message role for any model whose descriptor has `reasoning`.

An OpenAI-compatible gateway whose backend accepts only `user`/`assistant` — a Bedrock-fronting corporate gateway, for one — therefore rejects **every** request with `Unexpected role "developer"` as soon as a model on that route declares any `reasoningEfforts`. The only way to keep the route usable today is `reasoningEfforts: false`, which forfeits all selectable thinking levels for a reason unrelated to what the model can do: the same gateway accepts `reasoning_effort`, and accepts it alongside function tools.

Worth noting for anyone trying to reproduce: a curl probe against such a gateway passes. The role is chosen inside pi-ai from the model's `reasoning` flag and the endpoint URL, not by any field in a hand-written request, so only an assembled run shows the failure.

## The patch

A third switch, `supportsDeveloperRole`, on `PiAiCompatProfile`, resolving on exactly the path the two existing switches use — model entry → route → installed catalog entry → pi-ai's URL-derived guess — and under the same openai-completions-only rule. `false` keeps system prompts on `system`.

The rest of pi-ai's compat surface (`supportsStore`, `maxTokensField`, …) stays auto-detected and unconfigurable, per the evidence bar in `packages/AGENTS.md`: a switch is exposed only where a private gateway's URL provably misleads the inference.

One vocabulary change comes with it. The block holds compat switches, not "reasoning-dispatch switches" — a message role is not reasoning dispatch — so the two rejection diagnostics now say `compat switches` instead of enumerating field names, and `definesCompatSwitch` collapses the condition that the model-level and route-level refusals each spelled out separately. Those two diagnostic strings change text; they are load-time only, with no wire or durable role.

Touched: `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `tests/catalog.spec.ts`, `tests/adapter.spec.ts`, both READMEs, regenerated `docs/config-catalog{,.zh}.md` plus i18n pairing records, and an Agent Note triplet at `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-14-pi-ai-developer-role-compat-switch.md`.

Verification: `vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai` (215 passing), 100% statements/branches/functions/lines for the package, `typecheck`, `lint`, and `doc-sync` (28/28). The adapter tests pin both wire outcomes against the mock server — pi-ai's inferred `developer` role on an unrecognized host, and `system` under `supportsDeveloperRole: false` while `reasoning_effort` still goes out — so the switch is proven not to be a no-op. Full `test:coverage` and the snapshot suite were not run: the adapter mounts dormant in shipped compositions, so `compat` is off the default path.

Real-gateway check: with the route declaring six `reasoningEfforts` levels for a reasoning model, a headless task with a bash tool call at `reasoningEffort: high` succeeded — the exact combination that previously failed on `Unexpected role "developer"`. That gateway is on a private network, so it cannot back a CI assertion and no e2e test claims it.

Branch: https://github.com/lyccol/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/pi-ai-developer-role-compat
Diff against master: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...lyccol:feat/pi-ai-developer-role-compat

Take it, rewrite it, or ignore it — the report is the part that matters.

---

## 中文

`CONTRIBUTING.md` 写明目前不接受外部 PR,故发在这里。补丁已在 fork 上,可用则取,不可用的话仅凭上面的复现说明也足够。

**问题**:`llm-pi-ai` 允许手工声明的路由配置 `compat.thinkingFormat` 与 `compat.supportsReasoningEffort`,但 pi-ai 以同样方式推断的第三个开关不可配置。`openai-completions.js:1148` 对不在其非标准主机名单(nvidia、cerebras、xai、together、deepseek.com 等)内的主机一律推断 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`,于是 `:787-788` 会把任何具备 `reasoning` 的模型的系统提示放到 `developer` 角色下发送。私有网关永远不在名单里,因此一个与 OpenAI 兼容、但后端只允许 `user`/`assistant` 的网关(例如前置 Bedrock 的公司网关),只要路由上的模型声明了任何 `reasoningEfforts`,每次请求都会以 `Unexpected role "developer"` 被拒。当前唯一可用姿态是 `reasoningEfforts: false`——为一个与模型能力无关的原因放弃全部可选思考档位,而该网关本身既接受 `reasoning_effort`,也接受它与 function tools 同时出现。用 curl 探测会通过:角色是 pi-ai 依据模型 `reasoning` 标志与 URL 在内部选定的,只有装配完成的真实运行才暴露。

**补丁**:`PiAiCompatProfile` 增加 `supportsDeveloperRole`,解析顺序与前两个开关完全一致(模型条目 → 路由 → 已安装 catalog 条目 → pi-ai 按 URL 的猜测),同受「仅 `openai-completions`」约束;`compat` 面其余部分保持自动检测且仍不开放,符合 `packages/AGENTS.md` 的证据门槛。随之把该块措辞从「reasoning-dispatch switches」泛化为「compat switches」(消息角色不属于推理分派),两条加载期诊断不再逐个列出字段名,`definesCompatSwitch` 收拢了模型级与路由级此前各写一遍的同一条件。

按分类,这在上游应是 `kind/feature` + `area/llm`。

records.title: [Feature Request] 支持在非官方 DeepSeek 风格 OpenAI 兼容网关上选择思考挡位 / Support reasoning-effort selection on non-official DeepSeek-style OpenAI-compatible gateways
records.body:
## 需求背景 / Motivation

我们在一个非官方的 OpenAI 兼容网关上使用 DSH。该网关的模型遵循 DeepSeek
语义，并接受 `reasoning_effort` 挡位（off / high / max）。我们希望通过现有
配置面（模型条目上的 `reasoningEfforts` 声明、`agent-default-model` 中的
`reasoningEffort` 选择）在非官方网关上按模型、按会话选择思考挡位。目前这条
链路无法端到端工作——请求还没到达模型就失败了。

We run DSH against a non-official OpenAI-compatible gateway whose models
follow DeepSeek semantics and accept `reasoning_effort` levels (off / high /
max). We want to select the reasoning effort per model and per session, using
the existing configuration surface (`reasoningEfforts` on model entries and
`reasoningEffort` in `agent-default-model`). On such a gateway this currently
does not work end to end — every request fails before reaching the model.

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    internal:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://example.internal/v1   # DeepSeek-style gateway
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
      models:
        - id: model-x
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
agent-default-model:
  provider: internal
  model: model-x
  reasoningEffort: high
```

## 拦路问题 / Blocking issue

一旦模型声明思考挡位，pi-ai 就会用 OpenAI 的 `developer` 角色发送 system
prompt。DeepSeek 风格的端点只接受 `system` / `user` / `assistant` / `tool`
四种角色，因此网关对每个请求都返回 `400 messages[0].role: unknown variant
'developer'`。手工声明的路由目前无法保持 `system` 角色。

As soon as a model advertises reasoning efforts, pi-ai sends the system
prompt with the OpenAI `developer` role. DeepSeek-style endpoints only accept
`system` / `user` / `assistant` / `tool`, so the gateway rejects every request
with `400 messages[0].role: unknown variant 'developer'`. Hand-declared routes
currently have no way to keep the `system` role.

## 建议方案 / Proposed fix

在 route 级和 model 级的 compat 配置中增加 `supportsDeveloperRole`（回退顺序：
目录条目 → baseURL 推断），并透传到 `resolveModelCompat`——与现有
`supportsReasoningEffort` 开关完全对称：

Add `supportsDeveloperRole` to the route- and model-level compat profile
(falling back to the installed catalog entry, then pi-ai's baseURL-derived
guess), carried through `resolveModelCompat` — symmetric with the existing
`supportsReasoningEffort` switch:

```yaml
compat:
  thinkingFormat: deepseek
  supportsDeveloperRole: false   # keep role 'system' on DeepSeek-style endpoints
```

两个开关配合后，非官方 DeepSeek 风格网关上的思考挡位选择即可完整可用。
已有可运行的实现（约 16 行改动，补丁见附件），并已在生产环境的内网
DeepSeek 风格网关上验证三个挡位全部可用。

Together the two switches make reasoning-effort selection fully functional on
non-official DeepSeek-style gateways. A working implementation exists
(~16-line diff, patch attached) and has been verified in production against an
internal DeepSeek-style gateway with all three effort levels.
[llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31092834/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role.patch)

comments.body:
你观察得对：**当前 Web 设置页没有通用 MCP server 的添加表单**。现有入口是组合配置，而不是 GUI。

官方已经提供 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`，一个 server 对应一个插件实例。最安全的试用方式是先建一个临时 overlay：

```yaml
# my-mcp.cordis.yml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-example
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: example
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', '@example/mcp-server']
        env:
          EXAMPLE_TOKEN: !!js process.env.EXAMPLE_TOKEN
```

启动时加载：

```sh
dsh web --patch /absolute/path/to/my-mcp.cordis.yml
```

远程 Streamable HTTP server 则改成：

```yaml
config:
  serverName: example
  transport: streamable-http
  url: https://example.com/mcp
  headers:
    Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`'
```

连接并完成 `tools/list` 后，模型看到的工具名是：

```text
mcp__example__<rawToolName>
```

确认临时配置能工作后，再把同一条 `insert` 合并到：

- 单个 profile：`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`
- 所有 profile：`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`

不要覆盖已有 patch 文件，也不要把 token 明文写入 YAML；通过进程环境变量传入。

所以结论是：MCP runtime 能力已经存在，**缺的是便捷的配置 UI、校验与连接状态展示**。如果把它作为功能需求，我建议 GUI 至少覆盖 transport、command/args 或 URL、环境变量引用、连接测试、发现的工具数量、重连状态，以及删除前确认。

上游参考：[`dsh-mcp-client`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/main/packages/mcp/mcp-client) 和 [`examples/mcp-memory`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/main/examples/mcp-memory)。Handbook 也整理了 [MCP integration guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/integrations/mcp.md) 与 [connection troubleshooting](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/mcp-server-not-connecting.md)。

replies.body: 这个MCP有问题，只有当时配置好了能用，没有任何重连逻辑，会话过期后无法使用。

comments.body:
这个反馈需要按 transport 分开看。当前 `master` 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 已有连接 supervisor，默认配置是：

```yaml
reconnect:
  enabled: true
  initialDelayMs: 500
  maxDelayMs: 30000
  maxAttempts: 10
```

它由 2026-08-10 的 [`feat(mcp-client): auto-reconnect`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/00f68d7e9339105184d7f13dcf89a17ce80f3fe5) 引入；npm 的 `next` 当前是 `0.1.0-rc.6`。

不过这里有一个关键边界：

- **stdio server 进程退出/transport close**：会触发 supervisor，按退避策略新建 client + transport，并重新执行 `tools/list`。
- **Streamable HTTP 的会话或认证过期**：如果 SDK 只把它表现为某次请求失败，而没有触发 transport `onclose`，当前 supervisor 不会重新构造连接；源码的 Known limitations 也明确写的是 HTTP 不可达主要通过单次调用/SSE 恢复暴露。

所以“当时配置好能用，过期后不能用”更像第二条，不能笼统归为完全没有重连逻辑。为了形成可修复的复现，请补充：

1. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --version`；
2. `transport: stdio` 还是 `streamable-http`；
3. 首次成功到失效经过多久，是否涉及 OAuth/token/session expiry；
4. 失效时 Host 日志里有没有 `connection lost; reconnecting`、`reconnected and re-synced tools` 或 `giving up after ...`；
5. 服务端返回的 HTTP 状态 / MCP error（token 请脱敏）。

若是 HTTP 401/403 或 session-id 失效且没有 `onclose`，修复点应是把可恢复的调用/会话错误升级为 transport generation 重建事件，并避免对有外部副作用的工具调用进行不安全的自动重放。临时方案是刷新凭证后 HMR 重载该插件实例，或重启 Host；不要直接重试一个结果未知的写操作。

comments.body:
关于"更标准的第三方插件分发"，过去一天我们跑了完整一遍，贡献几个实测结论，供标准化讨论参考：

1. **npm dist-tag 是第一个坑**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `latest` 是 `0.0.1-rc.1`，真正在用的是 `next`（0.1.0-rc.6）。任何"装默认版本"的标准化方案都会先踩 ERESOLVE——建议官方统一 dist-tag 策略。
2. **git 分发有 allowBuilds 门槛**：`dsh plugin add github:owner/repo` 会被 pnpm 11 拦（prepare 脚本默认禁止）。dsh CLI 会打印精确 key，但每个新用户都要走一遍。建议官方提供 `dsh plugin add` 的一键 allowBuilds 确认流程。
3. **市场化的 manifest 已经有人在做**：ydhrdh/dsh-marketplace 的 `plugin.json`（PR 制收录）是很好的分发元数据格式，我们 5 个插件已提交（PR #1），本地过官方校验器 5/5。
4. **发布前预检**：官方 #1774 的 preflight 提案，社区实现 dsh-plugin-doctor `preflight` 模式已可用——结构检查纯函数、JSON 稳定、失败保留依赖不写 profile。

建议标准化的最小集合：dist-tag 约定 + allowBuilds 一键化 + plugin.json 元数据 + preflight 检查，四件套齐了第三方分发体验才会稳定。

priorAudit.replyAngle: Highlight the TUI as the terminal/server-native way to run DSH, while noting plugin distribution remains separate.

records.title: deepseek-official 适配器不支持 `reasoning_effort: "low"`
records.body:
# [Feature Request] deepseek-official 适配器不支持 `reasoning_effort: "low"`（官方 API 已支持，建议放行并归一 medium/xhigh）

## 摘要 / Summary

DeepSeek 官方文档明确支持 `reasoning_effort: low/high/max`（`medium`/`xhigh` 兼容映射为 `high`），且 V4-Pro GA 宣传口径为 "low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks"。但 DeepSeek Harness 的官方 provider `deepseek-official`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`）能力白名单只有 `off / high / max`，**`low` 在请求发出前就被客户端校验拦截**，导致官方模型在 DSH 内无法使用文档推荐的低推理档。

**English summary:** The official DeepSeek API documents and accepts `reasoning_effort: low` (plus `medium`/`xhigh` compat-mapped to `high`) for `deepseek-v4-pro`/`deepseek-v4-flash`, but the DSH `deepseek-official` provider adapter (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`) only whitelists `off | high | max`, so any explicit `low` is rejected client-side before the request reaches the API. Suggest adding `low` to the whitelist (and normalizing `medium`/`xhigh` → `high` per the official mapping).

## 复现 / Reproduction

- 环境：DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`（macOS arm64，Node v26；Web GUI 与 headless 均复现）
- 模型：`deepseek-v4-pro`（provider `deepseek-official`）
- 操作：任何方式显式设置推理档为 `low`（模型选择器无该档位，需手写配置或脚本传入）
- 报错（在发出任何 HTTP 请求之前，由客户端预检抛出）：

```
UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT: provider "deepseek-official" model "deepseek-v4-pro" does not support reasoning effort "low"
```

对照实验（同一环境同一模型）：

| 显式档位 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `low` | ❌ `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`（客户端预检拒绝，无 API 请求） |
| `medium` | ❌ 同上（文档口径：应兼容映射为 `high`） |
| `high` | ✅ 通过（默认档位，日常可用） |
| `max` | ✅ 通过（实测：`request/header` 记录 `reasoningEffort: "max"`，会话正常完成） |

## 官方文档依据 / The API itself accepts `low`

直接调用官方 API（`https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions`，模型 `deepseek-v4-pro`），`reasoning_effort` 分别传 `low` / `medium` / `high` / `max`，**四次全部 HTTP 200**。因此问题不在 API 侧。

文档出处：
- [Thinking Mode 指南](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/thinking_mode)：OpenAI 兼容格式 `reasoning_effort` 取值为 **low / high / max**，默认 `high`；官方映射表：`low→low`、`medium→high`、`high→high`、`xhigh→high`、`max→max`（deepseek-v4-flash 与 deepseek-v4-pro 一致）。
- [Chat Completions API 参数](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/api/create-chat-completion)：`reasoning_effort` 的 Possible values: **[low, high, max]**，原文注明"出于兼容考虑 `medium`、`xhigh` 会映射为 `high`"。
- [V4-Pro GA 新闻](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news260813)：*"Flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro & V4-Flash: **low for simple tasks**, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks"*。

## 根因定位 / Root cause（客户端适配层白名单）

请求在发出前被 DSH 客户端预检拦截，未到达 DeepSeek API：
1. **适配器白名单**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js` — `reasoningEffort()` 校验函数只接受 `"off" | "high" | "max"`（L19–22）；能力列表 `REASONING_EFFORTS = [off, high, max]`（L415–431），`resolveModel()` 只向 harness 暴露这三个档位（L505–526）；该适配器注册的 provider 名即 `"deepseek-official"`（L632）。
2. **通用校验层**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js`（L1245 附近）对"请求档位 ∈ 模型注册能力列表"做预检，不通过即抛 `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`——实测文案与该处逐字一致。
3. **线上格式本身正确**：适配器发送 `thinking: { type: "enabled" }` + `reasoning_effort: <档位>`（snake_case），与文档 OpenAI 格式一致；`low` 无需任何新映射，直接透传即可。
4. **上游现状**：截至 2026-08-13 的 master 分支 `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/index.ts` L95 仍为 `reasoningEffort: z.union(['off', 'high', 'max'])`，**尚未修复**。

## 影响 / Impact

- 官方模型在 DSH 内只能使用 `off / high / max`，**文档推荐用于简单任务的 `low` 档不可达**（GUI 推理等级选择器也不提供该档位）。
- 想用 `low` 只能绕行：① 用 `llm-pi-ai` 手工声明指向 `api.deepseek.com` 的路由并逐模型声明 `reasoningEfforts`（含 `low`）；② 安装社区插件 `dsh-thinking-effort`（见相关讨论 #1817）。

## 建议修复 / Suggested fix

1. 将 `"low"` 加入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` 白名单：`reasoningEffort()` 校验（L19–22）、`REASONING_EFFORTS`（L415–431）、以及 GUI 模型选择器的档位展示；`low` 的线上透传与 `high`/`max` 相同（`thinking: enabled` + `reasoning_effort: "low"`）。
2. 可选：按官方映射表兼容 `medium`/`xhigh` → 归一为 `high`（文档明确这是官方兼容行为）。
3. 顺带建议：模型元数据若对已注册模型缺失 reasoning 能力信息（本次 `low` 报错走的是通用层"模型无 reasoning 能力"分支），应一并核对，避免显式档位校验行为不一致。

改动很小（一个 union 加一个枚举项 + UI 档位列表），但能对齐官方文档口径。

## 相关讨论 / Related

[#122 第三方模型无法选择推理强度](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/122) · [#302 自定义 provider 不支持 reasoning effort](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/302) · [#843 自定义 provider 模型无法从 GUI 选档](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/843) · [#1643 网关选档功能请求](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1643) · [#1817 dsh-thinking-effort 插件](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1817)

以上均为**第三方/自定义 provider** 的档位入口问题；本帖针对的是**官方 provider（deepseek-official）自身的档位白名单缺 `low`**，是另一个独立缺口。

comments.body:
Confirmed in source and staged a patch.

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts`:
```ts
const REASONING_EFFORTS = [
  { id: ReasoningEffortId('off'), name: 'Off' },
  { id: ReasoningEffortId('high'), name: 'High' },
  { id: ReasoningEffortId('max'), name: 'Max' },
]
```
No `low` ? so the client-side capability list rejects it before any request is sent.

**Cherry-pick-ready branch** (on current master): https://github.com/zoahdev/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/llm-deepseek-reasoning-low ? adds `low` to the whitelist (one const + one entry). `medium`/`xhigh` ? `high` normalization is a separate, small change if the official mapping should be enforced client-side too; say the word and I'll stage that as well.

replies.body:
感谢确认与补丁，跟我们在 rc.6 上的定位完全一致（同一处 REASONING_EFFORTS）。

关于 medium/xhigh 归一化：赞成一起做。官方文档明确 medium/xhigh 是兼容值、映射为 high；客户端归一后，习惯传 medium 的 OpenAI 风格工具链在 DSH 里也不会被 schema 拒绝，行为与 API 口径一致。

另外补丁可能还差两个位置，否则"选择 low"在请求阶段仍会被拦截（我们在 rc.6 编译版上实测过拒绝路径，对应 master 源码）：

1. src/serialize.ts：reasoningEffort() 校验（L26–34）只放行 off/high/max，resolveThinking()（L37–53）的 wire 分支只处理 high/max——能力列表放行后，请求会在这里继续抛 DeepSeek does not support reasoning effort "low"；需要把 low 加进校验、ResolvedThinking 类型（L22）和 wire 映射（L49–50）。
2. src/index.ts：部署配置 schema reasoningEffort: z.union(['off','high','max'])（L95，类型 L70）——不加 low 就无法把 low 设为部署默认档位。
若归一化也做，这两处同样需接受 medium/xhigh 并映射为 high。

补丁齐了之后我可以在 macOS + rc.6 上用现成的 headless 验证通道对等复验一份。再次感谢！
这里src的路径可能造成疑惑，对应官方仓库路径分别为packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/serialize.ts和packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/index.ts

验证可信，想补充一点：CI 全绿与"选择 low 后请求能跑通"之间还有距离。分支当前改动只有 packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts 与 tests/adapter.spec.ts 两处（能力列表加 low + 对应断言更新）；官方测试套件对推理档的覆盖集中在 serialize.spec.ts——它只测现有档位（off/high/max 的 wire 映射、部署锁死拒绝、medium 拒绝），没有 low 用例，所以分支测试全绿是必然的，但 low 在请求路径上仍会被拦：

1. packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/serialize.ts：reasoningEffort() 校验（L26–34）仍只放行 off/high/max，wire 分支（L49–50）只处理 high/max——能力列表放行后，请求会在这里抛 DeepSeek does not support reasoning effort "low"（错误码相同，来源从通用层移到适配器层，现象不变）。建议同步把 low 加进校验、ResolvedThinking 类型（L22）和 wire 映射，并在 serialize.spec.ts 补一条 low → reasoning_effort: "low" 的用例（L206–213 那条 max 用例的镜像）。

comments.body:
**补一个真实用户场景，证明这个缺口的实际影响面**（同贴环境：master 47f9438，与上面验证基线一致）

 我是按 dsh-handbook 第 4 章《插件开发实战》原样实现了那个"提速插件"（`agent/request` waterfall + `decideEffort` 纯函数，降档逻辑就是 `ratio >= 0.75 → 'low'`），并按第 3 章方法挂载到 web profile。

 **环境**：provider `deepseek-official` / model `deepseek-v4-flash`，本地 master `47f9438`

 **复现**：任务一旦进入简单工具链轮次（插件判定该降档），本轮立即失败：

 ```text
 provider "deepseek-official" model "deepseek-v4-flash" does not support reasoning effort "low"
 ```

 **影响**：
 1. 教程 4.5 的实机验证（期望日志 `reasoningEffort=low`）在官方 provider 上**无法复现**——不是教程代码写错，而是能力表缺档；
 2. 插件"降档提速"这条主路径在官方模型上完全不可用，唯一能用的加速手段只剩把 `low` 映射成 `off`（关闭思考），语义和教程设计意图不一致；
 3. 低推理档是官方文档推荐的日常场景（"low for simple tasks"），缺口会影响所有按 low/high/max 写的插件和用户配置。

 **临时 workaround**（给同样踩坑的人）：插件层把 `decideEffort` 返回的 `low` 映射为 `off`，绕开能力表校验（`off` 在表内），代价是简单轮次完全关闭思考。

 完整修复建议与上面各位一致：能力表（`adapter.ts`）+ 序列化校验/wire 映射（`serialize.ts` L22/26-34/49-50）+ 部署 schema（`index.ts` L70/95）共四处放行 `low`，并顺手归一 `medium/xhigh → high`。

 另外我会同步给 dsh-handbook 仓库提 issue（教程 4.5 需补充"档位支持因适配器而异"的说明），让教程读者不再踩同一个坑。

 *English summary: Real-world impact — the dsh-handbook ch.4 speed plugin (low/high/max) fails on deepseek-official whenever it downgrades to `low`; tutorial's verification cannot be reproduced. Temporary workaround: map `low → off` in the plugin. Full fix needs the four sites listed above.*

replies.body:
**补充：插件侧的"能力表驱动"适配方案 + 双路由实测**

 （接前面讨论，提供一个不依赖上游修复就能安全工作的插件侧方案；同时补充 low 缺口的实际影响证据）

 我按 dsh-handbook 第 4 章实现了提速插件，并把降档改为**读取模型能力表后钳制**：
 - 用 `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)` 读取 `reasoning.efforts`；
 - `decideEffort` 返回 `low`（降档意图）时，映射到该模型"开启思考"的最低档（跳过 `off`）；
 - 意图档位不在能力表内时**不覆盖**，保持原配置，绝不注入非法档位。

 实测（master 47f9438，插件挂 web profile）：
 - `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-v4-flash`：`supported=[off,high,max]` → 简单轮次落回 `high`，不再报 `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`；
 - 同一插件在 **newapi 转发的 deepseek**（自定义 provider）上同样正常——方案对任意 provider/model 路由通用，不写死档位。

 日志形如：
 ```text
 [speed-plugin] decided=low supported=[off,high,max] => reasoningEffort=high
 ```

 等上游放行 `low` 后，同一行会自动变为 `supported=[off,low,high,max] => reasoningEffort=low`，插件无需改动。

 **给维护者的建议**：上游修复按前面各位列的四处（`adapter.ts` 能力表 / `serialize.ts` 校验+wire 映射 / `index.ts` 部署 schema）+ `medium/xhigh` 归一即可；插件生态可以先按"能力表驱动"写法规避，不必等修复。

This delivers the primary outcome: using the official DeepSeek API with reasoning_effort 'low' inside DSH, bypassing the broken deepseek-official adapter whitelist.

priorAudit.replyAngle: Use pi2dsh's Pi provider route to reach api.deepseek.com with 'low' reasoning effort, bypassing the broken adapter whitelist.

records.title: Can't add Ollama as Custom Provider, please make localhost-adapted version

comments.body:
I checked the current custom-provider implementation. It does not reject http://localhost or require a non-empty API key. The create gate requires all of these before the button enables:

- a valid lowercase Provider ID, for example ollama
- a non-empty Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
- API protocol: openai-completions
- at least one valid Model ID, matching ollama list exactly, including its tag

The API key can stay blank for local Ollama.

First verify from the environment running DSH:

    curl http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/models
    ollama list

The important boundary is that localhost belongs to the DSH host process, not the browser. If DSH runs in Docker, WSL, a VM, or another machine, 127.0.0.1 may point at the wrong environment even though Ollama works from the laptop shell.

Stable visual guide with the exact field matrix and host-versus-browser diagnostic:
https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/ollama-local-provider.html

Reviewable source change:
https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/pull/18

If creation is still disabled after adding a model row, please paste the text shown under the form and the exact field values with secrets removed; the screenshot alone cannot distinguish a missing model gate from a host reachability failure.

priorAudit.solution: Install pi2dsh and use an unmodified Pi provider (e.g., Ollama via Pi's Ollama provider) to add Ollama as a native DSH llm route with dynamic model catalog. This delivers the primary outcome: using Ollama models inside DSH, bypassing the broken custom-provider UI.
priorAudit.boundary: The DSH custom-provider settings page is not repaired; the alternate Pi route is required.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Use pi2dsh's Pi provider route to add Ollama as a native DSH model source, bypassing the broken custom-provider UI.

records.title: [Showcase / 展示] SandBase Harness — 在 DSH 中管理持久化 Agent 会话
records.body:
## 中文

SandBase Harness v0.3.7 可以通过 stdio MCP 作为真正的 DeepSeek Harness 插件运行。它为 DSH 会话提供六个原生工具，用于列出 Agent、创建和运行持久化会话、读取结果与产物，以及停止任务。

本版本同时支持 Agent Skills 标准 `compatibility` 元数据：Runtime 会校验 1–500 字符边界、持久化并通过 API 返回，在 Console 搜索和详情中以不可信文本安全展示。

### 无需本地安装先体验 Console

[在 GitHub Codespaces 中打开 SandBase Harness](https://codespaces.new/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness?quickstart=1)，等待开发容器构建完成后运行：

```bash
node dist/index.js start --host 0.0.0.0
```

打开自动转发的 Console 端口，在 **Settings > Models** 中配置模型。Codespaces 可能产生 GitHub 用量费用；固定版本的本地安装仍见下方。

### 可复现的源码安装

npm 上未加 scope 的 `managed-agents` **不是**本项目。请固定使用 GitHub v0.3.7 源码：

```bash
git clone --branch v0.3.7 --depth 1 https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness.git
cd sandbase-harness
npm ci
npm run build:runtime
mkdir ../my-agents && cd ../my-agents
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js init
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js start
```

另开终端：

```bash
export MANAGED_AGENTS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000
# 仅在 Runtime 开启认证时设置 MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY
dsh plugin --profile web add -w ../sandbase-harness
dsh web
```

DSH 会获得：

- `mcp__sandbase__list_agents`
- `mcp__sandbase__create_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__run_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__get_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__list_artifacts`
- `mcp__sandbase__stop_session`

### 镜像与安装前预检

v0.3.7 MCP bridge 已验证包含 Linux `amd64` 与 `arm64` 两种架构，OCI index digest 为 `sha256:5f7dcac499e95294be540035bd4892456ffbb7bedf2bb2d8a96d65e4203f11dc`，并带 GitHub build provenance。

集成指南提供零依赖预检：先检查公开 Health Endpoint，再检查带认证的 Agents Endpoint，从而在 MCP 子进程启动前区分 URL 不可达与 API Key 被拒绝。命令不会打印 Key。

- [固定版本集成指南](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/tree/v0.3.7/examples/deepseek-harness)
- [v0.3.7 Release](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/releases/tag/v0.3.7)
- [官方 MCP Registry 条目](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=io.github.sandbaseai%2Fsandbase-harness)
- [中文 DSH Runtime 教程](https://blog.sandbase.ai/zh-CN/deepseek-harness-developer-preview-2026/#接入一个真实的第三方-runtime-插件)

Bridge 只连接 `MANAGED_AGENTS_URL`，有效权限由 `MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY` 限制，且不持久化凭证。默认 Local Sandbox 适合可信开发；需要更强隔离时请选择 Docker 或 Kubernetes Backend。

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove managed-agents
```

关联披露：我是 SandBase 仓库维护者，并参与了此集成。

---

## English

SandBase Harness v0.3.7 runs as a real DeepSeek Harness plugin over stdio MCP. It gives DSH six native tools for durable agent work:

- `mcp__sandbase__list_agents`
- `mcp__sandbase__create_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__run_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__get_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__list_artifacts`
- `mcp__sandbase__stop_session`

The release also supports the standard Agent Skills `compatibility` metadata end to end: 1–500 character validation, persistence, API responses, Console search, and safe untrusted-text rendering.

### Try the Console without a local install

[Open SandBase Harness in GitHub Codespaces](https://codespaces.new/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness?quickstart=1), wait for the development container build, then run:

```bash
node dist/index.js start --host 0.0.0.0
```

Open the forwarded Console port and configure a model under **Settings > Models**. GitHub may bill Codespaces usage; the pinned local install remains below.

### Reproducible source install

The unscoped `managed-agents` npm package is **not** this project. Build the immutable v0.3.7 GitHub source:

```bash
git clone --branch v0.3.7 --depth 1 https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness.git
cd sandbase-harness
npm ci
npm run build:runtime
mkdir ../my-agents && cd ../my-agents
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js init
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js start
```

In another terminal:

```bash
export MANAGED_AGENTS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000
# Set MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY only when runtime authentication is enabled.
dsh plugin --profile web add -w ../sandbase-harness
dsh web
```

### Image, preflight, and verification

The v0.3.7 MCP bridge was verified as a Linux `amd64` + `arm64` OCI index at `sha256:5f7dcac499e95294be540035bd4892456ffbb7bedf2bb2d8a96d65e4203f11dc`, with GitHub build provenance.

The integration guide includes a zero-dependency preflight that checks the public health endpoint and then the authenticated agents endpoint before the MCP child starts. It distinguishes an unreachable URL from a rejected API key without printing the key.

- [Pinned integration guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/tree/v0.3.7/examples/deepseek-harness)
- [v0.3.7 release](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/releases/tag/v0.3.7)
- [Official MCP Registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=io.github.sandbaseai%2Fsandbase-harness)
- [DSH runtime-plugin walkthrough](https://blog.sandbase.ai/deepseek-harness-developer-preview-2026/#add-a-real-third-party-runtime-plugin)

The bridge connects only to `MANAGED_AGENTS_URL`; effective access is limited by `MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY`, and the bridge does not persist credentials. Use Docker or Kubernetes rather than the default local-process sandbox when you need a stronger execution boundary.

Uninstall with:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove managed-agents
```

Disclosure: I maintain the SandBase repositories and prepared this integration. Feedback on the MCP tool shape, profile lifecycle, and authentication boundary is welcome.

### v0.3.7 clean-profile verification / 干净 Profile 验证

The v0.3.7 bundle was re-tested with an isolated DSH home against commit `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`: Runtime health and Agents preflight passed, the Web profile installed `managed-agents 0.3.7` from the pinned source directory, DSH logged `sandbase-harness MCP server connected over stdio`, and the Web endpoint returned HTTP 200. No global npm link or custom PATH is required.

v0.3.7 已使用隔离的 DSH Home 完整复验：Runtime 预检通过、Web Profile 从固定源码安装、MCP stdio 握手成功、DSH Web 返回 HTTP 200；无需全局 npm link，也不会解析 npm 上的同名包。
