records.title: Custom pi-ai routes lose catalog-known modalities — inheritance is keyed by provider route, not model id
records.body:
> **中文 TL;DR**：自定义 OpenAI 兼容路由（如 sub2api 反代 OpenAI 官方模型 id）下，即使已安装的 pi-ai catalog 明确记录了该 model id 支持 image 输入，模态继承也只按 provider 路由键查找；查不到就静默回退 `['text']`，导致带图会话无法切换到该模型。建议为手写路由增加一层按 model id 的 catalog 继承。

## Setup

A custom OpenAI-compatible route fronted by a translation proxy (sub2api) that serves genuine upstream model ids. The route key is a private one, so every model entry is hand-declared with just an id:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-gateway:
      apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://sub2api.example.com/v1
      models:
        - id: gpt-5.2
        - id: gpt-5.6-sol
        # ...
```

## Symptom

- A session that already contains images cannot switch its model to any model on this route — `selectModel` refuses with *"Model ... does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model."*
- Sending a new image is refused by `prompt` with `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` → "当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型".

Both gates live in `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` and call `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)`.

## Root cause

`resolveRouteModels` in `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` resolves input modalities as:

```
input: declaredInput(entry.input) ?? base?.input ?? [...request.defaultInput]
```

where `base = catalogModels(provider).get(entry.id)` and `catalogModels(provider)` indexes the installed catalog **by the provider route key**. A hand-declared route key that pi-ai does not ship yields an empty `defaults` map, so even model ids the installed catalog fully describe inherit nothing and fall through to `DEFAULT_INPUT = ['text']` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`).

The part that stings: with pi-ai 0.82.1, the generated catalog already knows these ids — `MODELS['openai']['gpt-5.6-sol']` (and every other gpt-5.x) records `input: [text, image]` with `contextWindow: 272000`. The information is present in the very package the adapter imports; only the route-key indirection loses it. Nothing interrogates the gateway, which is a deliberate posture — but here the answer is already local.

For contrast: routes whose key happens to match an installed catalog provider inherit modalities per model id, which is why one settings file can work for those routes and break only for the hand-declared key.

## Workaround (works today, hot-reloads)

- route-level `defaultInput: [text, image]` covering every undeclared model on the route, or
- per-model `input: [text, image]`, or
- naming the route key `openai` so it becomes a catalog route (keeps the custom `baseURL`) — at the cost of the custom display name, and non-catalog entries (e.g. `gpt-image-*`) still fall back.

## Suggestion

For hand-declared routes (route key not shipped by the installed catalog), add one model-id-keyed inheritance layer between `base?.input` and `route.defaultInput`:

- if the entry's id exactly matches a single model in the installed catalog across all providers (or models all from one provider), inherit its `input` — and possibly `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` / reasoning capability — as the next resolution layer;
- ambiguous ids (the same id under multiple providers) keep today's behavior.

This keeps the conservative `['text']` floor for genuinely unknown models — under-claiming refuses an image up front and names the model, while over-claiming gets rejected mid-turn after the message is durable — while proxies serving genuine upstream model ids keep the correct modalities for free.

Related: #356 covers the same admission gate for hand-declared models in general; this discussion is the narrower case where the installed catalog already knows the exact model id and the route-key indirection is the only thing dropping it.

comments.body:
Confirmed at source level and implemented as a cherry-pick-ready branch.

## Source audit (master 47f9438)

`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` (`resolveRouteModels`) resolves `base = catalogModels(provider).get(entry.id)` - keyed by the provider route only. A private route key (e.g. `my-gateway` in front of a translation proxy) never matches the installed catalog, so `base` is `undefined` and input modalities fall back to `[...request.defaultInput]`: image-capable ids are reported as text-only, exactly as you described.

## Patch: fix/pi-ai-catalog-model-id-inheritance

https://github.com/zoahdev/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/pi-ai-catalog-model-id-inheritance

- Adds an id-level catalog fallback for input modalities: `declared entry input > provider-catalog input > global id-catalog input > route default`.
- The id lookup is used ONLY for capability facts - `api`/`baseUrl` still come from the route, so a foreign catalog entry can never leak its wire protocol.
- The global id index is cached per model id (stable catalog, O(1) repeat lookups).

## Verification

- `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` - clean
- `catalog.spec` 53/53, including a new regression test: a custom route declaring an anthropic vision model id keeps `vision.input` while `api` stays `openai-completions`

This also unblocks the #1986 family (image sessions switching to custom routes) for pi-ai-backed gateways. Thanks for the precise root cause - the "inheritance keyed by provider route, not model id" framing made the fix one line plus a cache.

priorAudit.boundary: pi2dsh does not repair DSH's catalog lookup logic, but provides an alternate provider route that preserves the modality inheritance.

records.title: [Bug] web 会话无正式途径开启 web_fetch 工具
records.body:
**现象**：web 会话的工具清单只有 `web_search`，没有 `web_fetch`——用户无法按 HTTP(S) URL 抓取网页全文（本任务场景：补齐第三方评测机构官网数据）。

**预期 vs 实际**：`web_fetch` 工具代码在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web` 内完整内置（注册逻辑齐全、默认开启），但产品内没有任何正式途径能把它开起来（无默认挂载的 fetch 提供方、预设层 `fetch: false`、提供方不在运行时模块闭包），属"能力存在但缺开启途径"。

**复现步骤**：
1. 按官方方式启动 `dsh web`（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 或源码构建）。
2. 新建会话，查看工具清单：只有 `web_search`，无 `web_fetch`。
3. 查阅文档与发行包配置：均未提供任何开启方式（base 包明确默认关闭 fetch）。

**影响**：需要网页全文的场景只能靠搜索摘要或手工粘贴，无法程序化抓取。

## 修复方案

**原因（均已核实到代码）**：
1. 宿主层 `tool-web` 被 web-app bundle `disabled: true`（`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` 407-408 行），对它打补丁无效。
2. 真正随会话挂载的是 `standard` 预设的 `tool-web`（`apps/cli/config/agent-presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml` 247-251 行），其 `config.fetch: false`。
3. web 缝无内置 fetch 提供方（`packages/web/web/src/index.ts` 157-163 行）：fetch 从已注册提供方解析，无提供方即报错，只把 `fetch` 改 true 不够。
4. 现成提供方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 只是 `dsh-tool-web` 的 devDependency，不在运行时模块闭包内（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` 由 `healProfilesModuleFallback` 按 apps/cli 依赖 BFS 重建），直接 insert 会启动失败（fail-loud）。
5. base 包注释说明默认关闭 fetch 的原因：SSRF 防护交给部署，模型会自选请求目标。

**修复方案（已实施并验收，部署级，不动 dsh 检出库源码）**：
1. 提供方挂载：自包含插件目录（`lib` + `package.json` + 3 个依赖 junction）挂进运行时模块回退，宿主 patch `insert: web-fetch-http`。
2. 预设层开开关：新建用户预设 `standard-fetch`（复制 `standard`，`tool-web` 的 `fetch: true`）并设为默认预设（shipped 预设先到先得，不能同名覆盖 `standard`）。
3. 重启验证：新会话工具清单出现 `web_fetch`，对公开 URL 调用返回正文。

**自测证据**：
- 模块导入 `IMPORT_OK`（运行时 3 个依赖经 junction 解析成功）。
- 提供方实测 `https://example.com` → 200 / html / 559 字符 / 未截断。
- 预设核验：`standard-fetch` 的 `tool-web` 段 `fetch: true` + `searchTimeoutMs: 60000`。
- 宿主合成核验：`dsh web --dump-config` → 宿主 `tool-web` 回到 `fetch: false` 且 disabled（惰性）、`web-fetch-http` 已 insert。
- 最终验收：新会话工具清单出现 `web_fetch`、公开 URL 返回正文——通过。

**偏离声明**：初判漏了两处（宿主 `tool-web` 被 web-app 禁用；真正开关在 `standard` 预设），修复从"改宿主 tool-web"改为"预设层建 `standard-fetch` + 设默认"。全程未动检出库源码（`apps/`、`packages/` 零改动）。

**上游建议（供官方参考）**：
1. 把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 加进 `apps/cli/package.json` dependencies 使其进入运行时模块闭包，并在 `standard` 预设提供 `fetch` 开关（或默认开启），让 `web_fetch` 有正式开启途径。
2. 或至少在文档中写明 `web_fetch` 的开启方式与风险边界。

**遗留问题（诚实声明）**：本方案的提供方无 SSRF/私网防护——开启后模型可让本机对任意公开 HTTP(S) 目标发请求（受响应 ≤5MB、正文 ≤10 万字符、30 秒超时、最多 5 跳重定向、固定 User-Agent `deepseek-harness/0.0.1` 约束）；登录墙数据（哪怕免费账号）仍不可读，属结构性边界。这正是 base 默认关闭 fetch 的原因，官方评估时请一并考虑。

comments.body:
这个场景现在可以不改 preset、也不用自己拼 `dsh-web-fetch-http` 依赖：Pi 生态现成的 [`@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools) 可以通过 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 原包挂到 DSH，直接注册 `web_fetch` 和 `web_search`。

```sh
# Pi Host ABI 兼容引擎只装一次
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0

# Pi 插件保持 npm 原包，不转换、不改源码
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
```

重启 `dsh web` 后：

- `web_fetch` 无需 key，可直接抓公开 HTTP(S) 页面；
- `web_search` 可运行 `/web-tools` 选择 Brave/Tavily/Serper/Exa/Jina/SearXNG/Ollama 等后端，或直接设置对应环境变量；
- 它自带 SSRF 边界：拒绝 private/loopback/metadata 地址，长网页截断并把全文落临时文件供 Agent 按需读取。

这条不是只验证了“能加载”：我们在真实 DSH runtime 里执行过 `web_fetch` 抓取 `example.com`，也跑过真实 `web_search` 工具链。复现证据在 [`community/runtime-results.json`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/community/runtime-results.json)。

因此对“Web 会话需要正式可用的全文抓取工具”这个用户场景，它已经是一个无需改 DSH 源码的可安装方案。

感谢推荐，这个方案很实用：`pi2dsh` + `@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools` 两条命令即可装好，不用改 preset、不用手拼依赖，还自带 SSRF 边界——这些优点我们都确认属实，确实比我报告里的手拼方案省事。

不过想说明一下本帖的定位：**这个帖子主要是向官方上报 bug 与修复方案**，核心诉求不在安装方法，而在于：

1. **根因**：`web_fetch` 工具代码在 `dsh-tool-web` 内完整内置、注册逻辑齐全，但产品没有任何正式途径能开启它——无默认挂载的 fetch 提供方、预设层 `fetch: false`、提供方不在运行时模块闭包内。
2. **修复方案**（已实施并验收，部署级、不动源码）：自包含插件目录挂载 + 宿主 patch `insert` + 用户预设开启 `fetch`。
3. **上游建议**：希望官方把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 纳入 `apps/cli` 运行时依赖，并在 `standard` 预设提供 `fetch` 开关（或至少在文档写明开启方式），让 `web_fetch` 有一个正式开启途径。

Pi 生态方案作为社区现成的绕行方案可以并存、也很有价值；但原生「能力存在、缺开启途径」的缺口仍在，期待官方评估修复。

priorAudit.solution: @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools runs unchanged with web_fetch reading public HTTP(S) without a search key, providing an exact alternate for fetching web page content.
priorAudit.boundary: pi2dsh does not repair DSH's native web tool or permit private-network fetching.
priorAudit.replyAngle: @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools gives you web_fetch for public URLs, an exact alternate to the missing native path.

records.title: [BUG]推理模型在仅支持 system role 的 OpenAI 兼容端点上请求失败
records.body:
使用 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容接口时，为自定义模型开启 reasoning effort 后，DSH 会把 system prompt 以 `developer` role 发送。仅支持 `system`、`assistant`、`user` 和 `tool` 的供应商因此返回 400。

English summary: When reasoning is enabled for a custom OpenAI-compatible model, DSH sends the system prompt with the `developer` role. Providers that do not support this role reject the request. Reasoning effort and the system/developer role selection should be independently configurable.

<details>
<summary>复现、实际结果、预期结果与建议验收条件</summary>

## 复现

1. 配置一个使用 `openai-completions`（Chat Completions API）的自定义 OpenAI 兼容供应商。
2. 为模型配置 `reasoningEfforts`。
3. 选择一个 reasoning effort 并发送请求。

本次实测供应商为火山引擎 Ark。实际错误如下，请求 ID 已脱敏：

```text
# test from volcengine-ark
400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 021786*************","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

## 实际结果

启用 reasoning effort 后，原本的 system prompt 被序列化为 `developer` role。供应商不支持该角色，请求在模型推理前直接失败。

## 预期结果

reasoning effort 与 system/developer role 的选择应能独立配置。对于不支持 `developer` role 的 OpenAI 兼容供应商，应能继续发送 `system` role，同时保留 `reasoning_effort`。

期望可以配置：

```yaml
compat:
  supportsDeveloperRole: false
```

上游 `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 已定义 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`，但 DSH 当前的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 和配置 schema 只暴露 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`，因此无法从 DSH 配置传入该字段。

## 可能的影响范围

- `openai-completions`：已通过火山引擎 Ark 实际复现。
- `openai-responses`：尚未实际复现，但代码路径也会在 `model.reasoning` 为真且 `supportsDeveloperRole` 未设为 `false` 时选择 `developer` role，可能存在相同兼容性问题。

相关 DSH 代码：

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`：`PiAiCompatProfile`、模型 reasoning 配置和 compat 转换。
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`：compat 配置 schema。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`: `0.1.0-rc.5`
- DeepSeek Harness commit: `47f943859b`
- Node.js: `v22.16.0`
- Provider: Volcengine Ark
- API mode: `openai-completions` / Chat Completions

## 建议验收条件

1. DSH 暴露并转发 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`。
2. `openai-completions` 设置该选项后仍发送 `system` role，并继续发送所选 `reasoning_effort`。
3. 检查并支持 `openai-responses` 的同一选项；保留 `reasoning.effort`，同时发送 `system` role。
4. 未设置该选项时保持现有默认行为。
5. 为两种 API 模式分别添加覆盖测试。

</details>

comments.body:

https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/faq.md

replies.body: 感谢补充，个人认为这个问题应该被更直接的解决，没必要走第三方插件，至少dsh本体需要开放supportsDeveloperRole。

comments.body: 同意——supportsDeveloperRole 这类兼容开关应该在 dsh 本体开放，而不是靠第三方插件绕。第三方网关是刚需场景（不是小众），官方把它做成配置项是成本最低的正解。我们 FAQ 里也标了"等官方开放"：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/faq.md

这个 400 可以用一条不修改 Harness 源码的 provider 路线绕开。手写 `llm-pi-ai` 配置会丢 `supportsDeveloperRole`；Pi provider 插件自己的模型描述不会。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应网关的 Pi provider 包>
```

[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 把自带 transport 的 Pi provider 注册为 DSH 原生 LLM adapter。透传录制验证过：provider 声明 `supportsDeveloperRole: false` 后，请求第一条角色实际是 `system`，同时 DSH 选择器选中的推理档位也进入线上请求。

会话、重试、日志和子代理仍然是 DSH；只替换模型 route 的请求 adapter。复现探针在 `examples/gateway-compat`。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's native Pi provider route with compat flags (supportsDeveloperRole: false) translates the setting and sends system role while keeping reasoning_effort, exactly matching the requested behavior for OpenAI-compatible gateways like Volcengine Ark.
priorAudit.boundary: This is an alternate provider route; it does not repair DSH's llm-pi-ai compat schema or the native openai-completions serialization path.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Route that model through pi2dsh's Pi provider layer and set compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false — you get system role + reasoning_effort on Ark today, without waiting for the DSH schema fix.

records.title: [Feature Request] MCP 客户端缺少 OAuth 2.0 支持（PKCE/动态注册/令牌刷新），无法直连强制 OAuth 的远程 MCP 服务器（如 Atlassian Remote MCP）——工程化必需
records.body:
## 问题

`dsh-mcp-client` 目前只支持 stdio / streamable-http 两种传输 + 静态请求头，**完全没有 OAuth 2.0 客户端能力**（授权码 + PKCE、RFC 8414 discovery、RFC 7591 动态客户端注册、令牌存储与刷新均缺失；源码 lib/index.js 确认，插件 inject 仅 ['tools']）。

而 2026 年官方远程 MCP 服务器基本全部强制 OAuth（Atlassian Remote MCP / mcp.atlassian.com 返回 401 + WWW-Authenticate），DSH 因此**无法直接接入任何这类官方 MCP**。

## 复现

1. 在 cordis.patch.yml 配置 mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp（streamable-http）
2. 连接被 401 拒绝；静态 header 无法完成授权码流程
3. 必须自建本地桥接 server（本人实测：为绕开此缺口手写了约 600 行桥接：OAuth 授权码 + PKCE + 动态注册 + 令牌刷新 + 工具转发），把"本应内置的能力"搬到了用户侧

## 期望

按 MCP 规范的 OAuth Authorization 章节（modelcontextprotocol/specification）实现内置 OAuth 2.0 client：

- 授权码 + PKCE（S256）
- RFC 8414 授权服务器发现（.well-known/oauth-authorization-server）
- RFC 7591 动态客户端注册（registration_endpoint）
- 本地回调（localhost redirect）或 Device Flow，浏览器授权
- 令牌持久化（0600）与自动刷新；连接 401 时自动触发授权流程
- 参考实现：@modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30 已内置 OAuthClientProvider（本项目依赖中已包含该 SDK），Claude Code 亦同

## 工程价值

- 企业内部大量官方远程 MCP（Atlassian Jira/Confluence、GitHub、Slack 等）强制 OAuth，DSH 作为工程化 agent harness 无法接入意味着关键业务数据（工单、PR、文档）不可达
- 无内置 OAuth 时每个用户都要自建桥接，安全与维护成本高
- 这是"工程化与实际应用场景"的必备能力，建议优先实现

comments.body:
MCP 缺 OAuth 2.0（PKCE/动态注册/令牌刷新）——远程 MCP 服务器强制 OAuth 的越来越多（Atlassian 这类），纯静态请求头确实不够工程化。

MCP 接入的工程边界第 9 章有讨论，OAuth 是下一块要补的：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/09-mcp-subagent-workflow.md

To help discovery for English-speaking people and agents, here is a google translate dump of the original post.

> Issue
> Currently, `dsh-mcp-client` supports only `stdio` or `streamable-http` transport mechanisms alongside static request headers; it completely lacks OAuth 2.0 client capabilities (missing Authorization Code + PKCE flows, RFC 8414 discovery, RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, and token storage/refresh mechanisms; source code `lib/index.js` confirms that plugin injection is limited to `['tools']`).
> 
> However, by 2026, official remote MCP servers will essentially mandate OAuth (e.g., Atlassian Remote MCP / `mcp.atlassian.com` returns `401 + WWW-Authenticate`), rendering `dsh` unable to directly connect to any such official MCPs. Reproduction
> Configuring `mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp` (streamable-http) in `cordis.patch.yml` results in a 401 Unauthorized error; static headers cannot complete the authorization code flow.
> One is forced to build a custom local bridge server (I personally wrote ~600 lines of bridging code—handling OAuth auth code, PKCE, dynamic registration, token refreshing, and tool forwarding—to work around this gap), effectively shifting functionality that *should* be built-in onto the user.
> Expectation
> Implement a built-in OAuth 2.0 client following the OAuth Authorization section of the MCP specification (modelcontextprotocol/specification):
> 
> Authorization Code + PKCE (S256)
> RFC 8414 Authorization Server Discovery (`.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`)
> RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration (`registration_endpoint`)
> Local callback (`localhost` redirect) or Device Flow with browser-based authorization
> Token persistence (file mode `0600`) and automatic refreshing; automatic re-authorization upon receiving a 401 error
> Reference implementation: `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` v1.30 includes a built-in `OAuthClientProvider` (this project already depends on this SDK), and Claude Code follows the same pattern.
> Engineering Value
> Many official remote MCPs used within enterprises (Atlassian Jira/Confluence, GitHub, Slack, etc.) mandate OAuth; the inability of DSH—as an engineering-grade agent harness—to connect means critical business data (tickets, PRs, documentation) remains inaccessible.
> Without built-in OAuth, every user must build their own bridge, incurring high security and maintenance costs.
> This is an essential capability for "production-grade engineering and real-world use cases"; implementation is highly recommended as a priority.

Also, +1 :)

这个场景现在可以不再自建 OAuth 转发桥。我们已经用 `pi2dsh` 把原版
`pi-mcp-adapter` 作为普通 DSH 插件能力包接入，插件仍然自己负责 MCP
transport、OAuth、缓存和刷新；pi2dsh 只把它的公开 Host ABI 翻译到 DSH 的
commands、userQuestions、tools 与模型调用链。

安装仍然只用 DSH 官方插件命令：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-mcp-adapter
```

重启后，在标准 `.mcp.json` 中声明远程服务器（例如 Atlassian 的
`https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2`，`auth: "oauth"`），然后在 dsh-TUI
或 Web 执行：

```text
/mcp-auth atlassian
```

刚完成的真实验收不是 mock：Atlassian 授权服务器发现、动态客户端注册、PKCE、
浏览器 localhost 回调、安全凭证存储、MCP 重连与 26 个工具发现全部通过；随后
DeepSeek 在 DSH Web 和 dsh-TUI 中都真实调用了只读的
`atlassian_atlassianUserInfo`，持久会话日志里的 `tool/result` 为
`isError:false`。正常本机回调会自动完成并撤掉粘贴框；只有 SSH/跨机器浏览器无法
访问回调端口时才需要手动粘贴 URL。`/pi-mcp logout atlassian` 会清除凭证。

这是一条现在即可安装的生态兼容路径，不代表官方 `dsh-mcp-client` 已被修改；后续
官方原生 OAuth 完善后，两条路径可以按需要替换。

项目与复现步骤：

- https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh
- https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/tui-mcp

+1，同样的场景又踩了一次，补充一个独立复现案例，供跟踪参考。

**背景**：`orion-agent-mcp` preset 里配置 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 连接
`https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2`（Atlassian 官方 Rovo MCP Server，
streamable-http），用 `headers.Authorization` 塞静态 Bearer/Basic token。

**确认结论**：
- 读了 `dsh-mcp-client@0.1.1-rc.2` 的 `lib/types/index.d.ts`：`StreamableHttpConfig`
  只有 `headers: Record<string, string>`，没有任何 OAuth 相关字段，README 里唯一的
  鉴权示例也是静态 `Authorization: Bearer ...`。
- 即使换成 Atlassian 官方新支持的 API Token（Basic Auth）鉴权方式，也绕不开需求：
  官方文档明确写了 [API Token 认证下 Rovo MCP 只返回 Teamwork Graph 之外的基础
  Jira/Confluence 工具，Rovo Search 相关的语义检索工具不会暴露](https://support.atlassian.com/rovo/kb/rovo-mcp-server-only-returns-teamwork-graph-tools-when-using-api-token/)——
  这块能力被绑定在完整 OAuth 2.1 用户身份上，静态 token 无法替代。
- 所以对需要 Rovo Search 的场景，静态 header 这条路彻底走不通，本质回到本 issue
  描述的"`dsh-mcp-client` 缺 OAuth transport"这一根因。

看到 @weijiafu14 提到的 `pi2dsh` + `pi-mcp-adapter` 路径（`/mcp-auth atlassian`，
走 PKCE + 本地回调 + 动态客户端注册），准备先按这条路径验证一下作为过渡方案，
同时继续 +1 期待官方 `dsh-mcp-client` 原生支持 OAuth 2.1（授权码 + PKCE + RFC 8414
discovery + RFC 7591 动态注册 + 令牌持久化/刷新），毕竟这类强制 OAuth 的远程 MCP
（Atlassian、未来更多企业 SaaS）只会越来越多。

感谢你愿意实际验证这条路径。你描述的正是我们完整跑过的场景，不只是确认命令能够挂载：Atlassian 授权服务器发现、动态客户端注册、PKCE、本地浏览器回调、token 安全存储与刷新、MCP 重连、工具目录发现，以及 DSH Agent 的真实工具调用都走完了端到端闭环。

为了避免不同版本的命令或配置细节产生偏差，可以直接让你的 Agent 按仓库里的可复现示例执行：

- 安装与操作步骤：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/tui-mcp
- MCP 能力与测试边界：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/docs/mcp-compatibility.md

这条路线保留的是原 `pi-mcp-adapter` 自己的 transport、OAuth、缓存和刷新机制，`pi2dsh` 只负责把它使用的公开 Pi Host ABI 接到 DSH，所以不是再造一个新的 Atlassian OAuth 转发桥。

如果你的环境里遇到问题，直接在这里继续回复即可。最好附上 DSH、pi2dsh、pi-mcp-adapter 的版本，以及 `/mcp-auth` 或管理面板里显示的具体错误，我们可以按同一条 E2E 链定位。

priorAudit.solution: pi-mcp-adapter via pi2dsh runs unchanged with full OAuth 2.0 (PKCE, RFC 8414 discovery, RFC 7591 DCR, localhost callback, token refresh) and is verified E2E against Atlassian Remote MCP with 26 tools.
priorAudit.boundary: It is an alternate MCP runtime; it does not repair dsh-mcp-client's missing OAuth implementation or its static-header-only transport.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Install pi-mcp-adapter and connect mcp.atlassian.com directly — OAuth discovery, PKCE, DCR and token refresh are all handled, verified E2E with Atlassian's 26 tools.

records.title: [BUG]Expose `supportsDeveloperRole` (and sibling OpenAI-completions compat switches) in `llm-pi-ai`
records.body:
# Expose `supportsDeveloperRole` (and sibling OpenAI-completions compat switches) in `llm-pi-ai`



## Summary

A hand-declared (i.e. not in pi-ai's builtin catalog) **reasoning** model on a pi-ai
provider route cannot be made to work against gateways that don't accept the
`developer` role — such as Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's token-plan compatible-mode
endpoint — because the `llm-pi-ai` `compat` configuration surface only exposes
`thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`. The missing switches
(`supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsStore`,
`requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages`) are left to pi-ai's URL-based
auto-detection, which guesses wrong for unrecognized endpoints. This document
describes the failure, the root cause, and a small fix.

## Problem / reproduction

1. Configure a pi-ai provider route that has a builtin catalog but add a model id the
   catalog doesn't know yet, and give it reasoning efforts. Concrete example
   (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    qwen-token-plan:
      apiKeyEnv: QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY
      models:
        # ...existing catalog models...
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash-0731
          name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 384000
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
```

2. Select `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` and run a request. The endpoint answers:

```
400 {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","param":null,
  "message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']",
  "type":"invalid_request_error"}, ...}
```

Notably, the *catalog* model `deepseek-v4-flash` on the same route works fine with
reasoning levels; only the hand-declared id fails.

## Root cause

The `developer` role is chosen by pi-ai in `convertMessages` (OpenAI Chat
Completions path):

```js
const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;
const role = useDeveloperRole ? "developer" : "system";
```

So a `developer` message is sent only when the model **reasons**
(`model.reasoning === true`) **and** `supportsDeveloperRole` is true.

- The builtin catalog entries for `qwen-token-plan` (and many other non-OpenAI
  gateways) explicitly set `"compat": { "supportsDeveloperRole": false, ... }`, so
  they serialize the system prompt as `system` and work.
- A hand-declared model has no catalog entry. pi-ai falls back to URL-based
  auto-detection, and for an unrecognized host like
  `token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com` it defaults to
  `supportsDeveloperRole: true` (the auto-detect logic only special-cases a handful
  of known hosts). So once `reasoningEfforts` makes the model a reasoning model, the
  system prompt is emitted as `developer` and the gateway rejects it.

The deeper issue is in dsh: `llm-pi-ai`'s `PiAiCompatProfile`
(`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`) and its schema
(`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`) only expose two compat switches:

```ts
export interface PiAiCompatProfile {
  thinkingFormat?: PiAiThinkingFormat
  supportsReasoningEffort?: boolean
}
```

`supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsStore`, and
`requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages` all exist on pi-ai's
`OpenAICompletionsCompat` type but are not configurable from dsh. This contradicts
the adapter's own documentation, which states that a route pi-ai has never heard of
is "fully describable from settings.yaml" — currently a hand-declared reasoning model
on a non-`developer` gateway cannot be described correctly.

## Proposed fix

Expose the three missing `OpenAICompletionsCompat` switches in `PiAiCompatProfile`,
the schemastery schema, and `resolveModelCompat`, with the same
route-level-default / per-model-override semantics already used by `thinkingFormat`
and `supportsReasoningEffort`:

```ts
export interface PiAiCompatProfile {
  thinkingFormat?: PiAiThinkingFormat
  supportsReasoningEffort?: boolean
  supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean
  supportsStore?: boolean
  requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages?: boolean
}
```

```ts
const compatProfile: z<PiAiCompatProfile> = z.object({
  thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
  supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean(),
  supportsDeveloperRole: z.boolean(),
  supportsStore: z.boolean(),
  requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: z.boolean(),
})
```

and pass the three fields through in `resolveModelCompat` (reading `entry.compat`
then `route.compat`, exactly like the existing two fields).

After that, the working configuration is:

```yaml
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash-0731
          name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 384000
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
          compat:
            thinkingFormat: deepseek
            supportsDeveloperRole: false
            supportsStore: false
            requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true
```

- `supportsDeveloperRole: false` fixes the 400.
- `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true` is needed for multi-turn
  deepseek reasoning (assistant messages must echo an empty `reasoning_content`).
- `supportsStore: false` matches the catalog entries and avoids sending an
  unnecessary `store` field.

This has been verified to work locally.

## Scope question for maintainers

`OpenAICompletionsCompat` has several more fields beyond the two currently exposed
(`maxTokensField`, `supportsUsageInStreaming`, `requiresToolResultName`,
`requiresAssistantAfterToolResult`, `requiresThinkingAsText`, `supportsStrictMode`,
`cacheControlFormat`, etc.). Should this be:

1. a minimal fix exposing only the three fields needed to unblock hand-declared
   reasoning models (the approach above), or
2. a broader change exposing the full `OpenAICompletionsCompat` surface?

`maxTokensField` in particular is another common gateway need. Also note the web
Models editor (`ModelListEditor`) still only edits id/name/capacities, so these
switches remain `settings.yaml`-only for now — worth confirming whether a form field
is expected.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.5`
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` `^0.82.1`
- Provider: `qwen-token-plan` (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio token-plan, compatible-mode
  `/v1`)

comments.body:
supportsDeveloperRole 应该暴露成可配置开关——和 #2007/#1498 是同一诉求，手写 provider 时开发者该能显式声明。

临时配置 compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false 可绕过，FAQ 有记录：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/faq.md

Confirmed at source level and implemented as a cherry-pick-ready branch.

## Patch: fix/pi-ai-compat-expose-role-store

https://github.com/zoahdev/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/pi-ai-compat-expose-role-store

- `PiAiCompatProfile`, the config schema, and `resolveModelCompat` now carry `supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsStore`, and `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages` with the same precedence as the existing switches (model > route > catalog > pi-ai baseURL detection).
- Model-level switches on non-`openai-completions` protocols stay rejected; route-level switches still skip non-completions models on mixed routes.

## Verification

- `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` - clean
- catalog.spec 53/53 including a new qwen-token-plan-style regression test (a hand-declared reasoning model receives the role/store/reasoning-content switches)

This also lands in the same file as our #1992 fix (id-level catalog modality inheritance), so the pi-ai configuration surface now covers both capability and endpoint-compat overrides for hand-declared models.

这里列出的 compat 丢失问题已经有一个可直接使用的绕路：[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 让 Pi provider 插件以原生 DSH LLM route 注册，不经过手写 `llm-pi-ai` profile 的 compat 白名单。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应网关的 Pi provider 包>
```

provider 自带 transport 时，它自己的完整模型描述和 `compat` 直接参与请求组装。线上录制验证了：`supportsDeveloperRole: false` 产生 `system` role；provider 的 `thinkingLevelMap` 变成 DSH 可选档位；用户选中的档位进入真实请求。

边界：这没有修复 DSH settings schema；它提供的是另一条进入同一个模型目录的 adapter 路线。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's native Pi provider route exposes the full OpenAICompletionsCompat surface including supportsDeveloperRole, supportsStore, and requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages, so hand-declared reasoning models on Alibaba token-plan work without URL auto-detection guessing wrong.
priorAudit.boundary: This is an alternate provider route; it does not repair DSH's llm-pi-ai PiAiCompatProfile schema or its config surface.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Declare that model on a pi2dsh Pi provider route where supportsDeveloperRole and the sibling compat switches are directly configurable — no more URL auto-detection guessing wrong for token-plan.

records.title: 【Core 实现】纯文本主模型贴图不再被拒：工作区镜像 + vision bridge + 信任边界修复
records.body:
### TL;DR

我在 `gloryxpnv/deepseek-harness` fork 的 `feat/image-upload-vision-bridge` 分支上实现了两个 core 层改动，正好对应社区反复提出的两个诉求：

1. **纯文本模型（如 deepseek-v4-flash）贴图不再被 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` 拒绝**——图片先镜像进工作区，可选的 vision-bridge 插件把图片转成文字描述，主模型只看到文本（对应 #2005、#427、#588、#357、#1378 的提案）
2. **修复信任边界 403**——Chrome/Edge 扩展场景下 `Origin` 省略非默认端口导致所有 POST 返回 403（对应 #2009）

### 改动 1：图片上传 + vision bridge（文本模型看图）

**现状问题**：当会话模型 `inputModalities` 不含 `image` 时，`dsh-host-apiproxy` 的准入层直接拒绝整条消息，图片不落盘，视觉工具/子 Agent 完全拿不到图。社区目前靠第三方插件绕路（`dsh-plugin-multimodal`、`pi2dsh`、`dsh-image-subagent`），但正如 #2005 所说，这应该是官方 core 层的策略。

**我的实现**（改 core，不是插件补丁）：

```
上传图片
  → ① 镜像进会话工作区（原始字节永远可及，best-effort，失败不阻塞受理）
  → ② 若模型是纯文本：查 ctx.get('vision-bridge')
       ├─ 有桥 → 本地 VLM 描述图片 → 文本+图片块投递（后台串行，UI 不卡顿）
       └─ 无桥 → 文本兜底：「图片已落盘，可用 vision 工具读取」（store-and-annotate）
  → ③ DeepSeek 序列化层丢弃图片块、保留兄弟文本描述（不再 UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT）
```

关键设计：
- **镜像先于桥接**：原始图片永远先落盘，桥失败也不丢图
- **`vision-bridge` 是插件接口**：官方 core 不内置任何 VLM，由插件（如 dsh-tool-vision）提供描述能力——符合官方"本地优先、零 API 成本"的方向
- **后台投递**：VLM 描述可能耗时数十秒，先立即受理（accepted），描述完成后串行投递，页面不冻结
- **落盘 + 文字标记回退**：正是 #2005 建议的 `imageFallback: store-and-annotate` 模式

### 改动 2：信任边界修复（#2009）

Chrome 扩展控制的回环标签页可能发送 `Origin: http://127.0.0.1`（无端口）而 `Host: 127.0.0.1:3080`（带端口），`api-request-trust.ts` 中 `originUrl.host === hostUrl.host` 无法匹配 → 所有 POST 403。

修复：仅对 **loopback Host + 精确同 hostname + `sec-fetch-site: same-origin`** 放行省略端口的 Origin；**不放宽**到非回环权威、别名或跨站请求——保持 DNS-rebinding 防御完整。

### 测试

- `api-request-trust.host.spec.ts`：11 passed（含新增兼容用例）
- `api-proxy-upload-mirror.spec.ts`：9 passed（新增，351 行，覆盖镜像/净化/去重/桥接/回退）
- `serialize.spec.ts`：28 passed
- apiproxy + ui-conversation 全量：799 passed
- typecheck（host + contracts-ready）绿

```sh
git fetch https://github.com/gloryxpnv/deepseek-harness.git feat/image-upload-vision-bridge
git checkout feat/image-upload-vision-bridge
```

- 是否值得收进 core？（#2005、#1378 已有详细方案讨论）
- `vision-bridge` 接口设计是否合适？
- 镜像/桥接/回退的默认行为是否符合预期？

（我的 vision 插件 `dsh-tool-vision` 可作为 bridge 实现配合使用：https://github.com/gloryxpnv/dsh-tool-vision）

records.title: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上看图的眼睛：Pi 生态两种识图能力，两条命令安装
records.body:
给 DeepSeek Harness 装上看图的眼睛，同时把 Pi 插件生态直接接进来——这是 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 最近完整跑通的能力。

Pi 有一套很丰富的 Agent 插件生态。pi2dsh 做的是一层通用 **Pi Host ABI → DeepSeek Harness** 兼容引擎：兼容的 Pi 插件保持 npm 上发布的原样，不 fork、不改源码，也不需要为每个包写一套转换代码。

## 安装只有两步

```sh
# 引擎只装一次
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0

# 之后直接安装兼容的 Pi 插件原包
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

装完重启 DeepSeek Harness。pi2dsh 会从 profile 的显式依赖中发现并挂载 Pi 插件；引擎和插件可以分别升级，互不绑定。

## 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上看图的眼睛

DeepSeek 官方文本模型本身不接收图片，但很多 Agent 工作流又必须看截图、读图或检查页面。pi2dsh 会自动为每条 text-only 模型路由注册一个独立的 **Vision Bridge** 伴生路由，不需要手工修改模型能力声明。

模型选择器里会同时保留原始 DeepSeek 分组和独立的 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 分组：

![DeepSeek + Vision Bridge model picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/main/docs/posting-kit/assets/01-vision-companion-model-picker.png)

选择伴生分组后，Web 可以像使用原生多模态模型一样直接粘贴图片：

![image accepted by a text-only DeepSeek session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/main/docs/posting-kit/assets/02-image-accepted-by-text-only-model.png)

然后有两种工作方式可以选择。

### 方式一：自动识图

安装 [@kassing/pi-vision](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kassing/pi-vision)：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

它会在 DeepSeek 推理前调用你配置的视觉模型，把图片分析结果作为 Harness 原生的 context injection 注入。主模型不需要主动调用工具，直接基于分析后的文字回答。

```sh
export OPENROUTER_API_KEY='<your-openrouter-key>'
export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

OpenRouter is only a public example. DashScope/Qwen-VL, a self-hosted vLLM, or any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works the same way. The key comes from the environment and is never stored in pi2dsh source.

真实 Web 验证结果：

![vision result injected into text-only DeepSeek](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/main/docs/posting-kit/assets/03-vision-bridge-answer.png)

图中可以看到 `pi2dsh:@kassing/pi-vision` 的上下文注入，纯文本 DeepSeek 在一轮一步内正确回答了图片颜色。

### 方式二：Agent 按需识图

如果希望 Agent 自己决定什么时候看图，可以安装 [pi-vision-tool](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-vision-tool)：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-vision-tool
```

这种方式先把视觉模型按 DSH 官方 `llm-pi-ai` 配进 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`，然后选择该路由：

```sh
export PI_VISION_PROVIDER=my-vision
export PI_VISION_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
```

完整的 DSH gateway 配置示例：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/custom-gateways

它提供 `describe_image` 工具。Agent 可以按任务需要控制识图提示词、图片压缩和视觉推理深度，适合 OCR、UI 检查、错误截图分析、坐标定位和图片对比。

已有 MCP / skill / script 只要能读取文件路径也可以直接复用：Vision Bridge 会把 Web 附件物化为临时文件，并把路径交给 Agent。

## 整条链路

```text
Web 粘贴图片
  → Vision Bridge 接受并物化附件
  → 自动视觉插件分析，或 Agent 调用 describe_image
  → 视觉结果以文本进入上下文
  → 原始 DeepSeek 文本模型继续推理
```

在发往 DeepSeek 官方文本 adapter 前，图片块会被递归移除，因此文本模型接口始终只接收文字。

CLI 和 Web 两端都已完整跑通，仓库里提供了测试图片和从安装到复现的完整示例：

- GitHub：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh
- 视觉示例：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge
- npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi2dsh

如果你也想把兼容的 Pi 生态插件直接用在 DeepSeek Harness 上，欢迎试用、提场景，也欢迎给项目一个 Star。

records.title: Proposal: make self-hosted gateways first-class providers in deepseek-harness (split `packages/llm`)
records.body:
# Proposal: make self-hosted gateways first-class providers in deepseek-harness (split `packages/llm`)

*Addressed to the deepseek-harness maintainers. Written from the perspective of
[model_proxy_v3](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/tree/feature/transforms_hooks) — an open-source,
self-hosted multi-protocol LLM proxy — after a verified end-to-end integration
with dsh.*

## TL;DR

The [`packages/llm`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/llm)
layer wraps `@earendil-works/pi-ai` to reach LLM providers, the same role
`openclaw` filled. It works, but the provider picker is dominated by a long
catalog of third-party SaaS providers, and model choices are limited to what
those external catalogs ship. We propose splitting the provider layer so that
**self-hosted gateways** (model_proxy_v3, LiteLLM, one-api, OpenRouter-style
routers) can plug in as first-class providers — one picker entry, live model
sync from the gateway's own listing, and no dependence on an external project's
catalog.

I've drive `claude code` simply to validate the integration path with zero dsh code changes:
[How to set a 3rd party proxy for deepseek-harness](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/blob/feature/transforms_hooks/docs/agents/proxy-as-provider-for-deepseek-harness.md).

If `deepseek-harness` supports one of the popular llm schemas (such as `openai-completions`, `anthropic-messages`, `openai-responses`, `gemini-generatecontent`), it works.

```
 Claude / Gemini genContent & interactions / OpenAI Responses & Chat Completions
                               │
                               ▼            privacy-filter
                        ┌─────────────┐     compression
     sidecar plugins <- │ Model Proxy │ ->  image-fetch & encoding
                        └─────────────┘     auth & usage stats
                               │ 
        ┌──────────────┬───────┴───────┬──────────────┐
        ▼              ▼               ▼              ▼
   Anthropic        Gemini         OpenAI Chat      OpenAI
   Messages       GenContent &     Completions      Responses
                  Interactions     upstream         upstream
                  upstream
```

## The current pain

1. **The provider list is long and catalog-bound.** A hand-declared route in
   `llm-pi-ai.providers` works today, but in the configuration surface it sits
   alongside ~20 catalog providers. Users hunting for their gateway scroll past
   providers they will never use.
2. **Models are limited by the third-party catalog.** A route keyed to an
   installed pi-ai provider inherits that provider's model list; a hand-declared
   route must be hand-maintained model-by-model in `settings.yaml`.
3. **Discovery is OpenAI-only.** `discoverModels` interrogates
   `GET {baseURL}/models` only for `openai-completions` / `openai-responses`
   routes. Gateways that speak Anthropic's protocol (and serve Anthropic-shaped
   `/v1/models` listings — model_proxy_v3 does) cannot be interrogated at all,
   even though their listings carry exactly the fields the parser reads
   (`data[].id`, `display_name`).
4. **Nothing carries capabilities.** A discovered model has no
   `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` unless the user types them; the defaults
   (262k / 32k) silently mis-size real models.

## What self-hosted gateways bring to dsh users

[It even works for all other agents](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/tree/feature/transforms_hooks)
— model_proxy_v3 gives any OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini-speaking client the routing
features commercial platforms (e.g. OpenRouter) sell, entirely server-side and
transparent to the client:

- **Composite alias** — one model id fanned across multiple upstreams with
  share weights and fallbacks (e.g. `code-small` = glm + claude pool).
- **Fusion** — parallel panel/judge/synthesis fan-out behind a single model id.
- **Coordinator** — automatic planner/executor model switching based on
  conversation stage.
- **Schedule** — time-of-day/day-of-week routing targets.
- **Transforms** — per-route request/response rewriting for upstream quirks,
  plus key management: the gateway holds upstream credentials; clients use a
  dummy key.

None of this requires anything from dsh today — the proxy absorbs provider
heterogeneity, protocol conversion, and credential storage, and dsh just talks
to one endpoint. That is precisely the argument for treating gateways as a
*tier*, not as "one more provider among twenty".

## Plugin system over bundled provider modules

It is already easy to drive existing LLM agents — Claude Code, Codex, opencode —
to a custom LLM provider: they accept a base URL and a key, and are running
against a gateway in minutes (see [`docs/agents/`](./agents/) for worked
examples against this proxy). New agents such as deepseek-harness should not
have to re-solve this problem by bundling ever-larger modules that chase
evolving third-party LLM providers.

As a plugin system, dsh needs only a small, stable LLM contract:

- **Third-party providers churn; the contract shouldn't.** New providers,
  renamed models, protocol extensions, and auth schemes appear weekly. When
  each is a plugin, the churn is absorbed by whoever owns the integration —
  not by the harness core, and not by one shared dependency (the pi-ai catalog)
  that every route inherits.
- **A gateway plugin replaces N provider plugins.** Point dsh at one
  self-hosted gateway and every upstream it fronts — including future ones —
  is reachable through a single registration with live model sync. The harness
  ships none of the provider-specific code.
- **The picker and the codebase stay small.** The provider list stops growing
  with the market; surface complexity scales with what the user actually
  configured, not with the number of providers that exist.

This is the same bet dsh already made architecturally (everything is a Cordis
plugin); the proposal is to finish it at the `packages/llm` seam.

## The proposal

Split `packages/llm` along the seam that already exists:

1. **Keep `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` as the contract.** Adapter registration,
   discovery types (`LlmDiscoveredModel`), credential seams — this is already a
   clean interface.
2. **Make `llm-pi-ai` one implementation of that contract, not the only one.**
   External projects should be able to ship a provider plugin that registers
   routes, answers model discovery, and reports capabilities without going
   through pi-ai's catalog.
3. **Add a "gateway" tier to the configuration surface.** A gateway is one
   picker entry with N models — chosen from a live listing, not a global
   catalog. Collapsing gateway routes under their gateway shrinks the provider
   picker and matches how users think ("my proxy", then "which model").
4. **Generalize discovery beyond the OpenAI shape.** Accept Anthropic-shaped
   listings (`data[].id` + `display_name` + `first_id`/`has_more`) for
   `anthropic-messages` routes, and read common capacity extensions
   (`context_window` / `context_length`, `max_output_tokens`) when present.
   model_proxy_v3's `/v1/models` already returns a compatible shape, verified
   against `discoverModels` as-is.
5. **Sync, not just probe.** "Fetch available models" currently offers
   candidates for manual adoption. A gateway route could optionally reconcile
   its model list on demand (still user-confirmed), since the gateway — not an
   external catalog — is the authority for what it serves.

## Evidence the integration already works

Against `model_proxy_v3` running as a plain local process, on stock dsh:

- **OpenAI-compatible route**: `api: openai-completions`,
  `baseURL: http://<proxy>/v1`, dummy key — headless dsh runs end-to-end.
- **Model discovery**: invoking dsh's own `discoverModels` against the proxy
  returned **all 23 configured models** — concrete entries, composite/fusion/
  coordinator aliases, and schedule aliases — with no dsh modifications.
- **Anthropic route**: `api: anthropic-messages` also works for chat; only
  discovery is blocked (point 3 above).

Full config examples (both protocols) and caveats are in
[docs/agents/proxy-as-provider-for-deepseek-harness.md](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/blob/feature/transforms_hooks/docs/agents/proxy-as-provider-for-deepseek-harness.md).

## What we offer

- model_proxy_v3 can ship and maintain a dsh provider plugin (or a thin
  gateway descriptor) once the contract is split out.
- We can contribute the Anthropic-shaped listing support in `discovery.ts` —
  the parser already reads the right fields; the change is small and localized.
- We will keep the integration doc above tested against dsh releases, the same
  way `docs/agents/` covers other agent harnesses (opencode, copilot-cli,
  crewai, langgraph).

## Summary

dsh's plugin architecture made this integration possible without touching dsh
source — that is a strength worth building on. Splitting the provider layer so
gateways are a first-class tier turns "a hand-declared route that happens to
work" into a supported path, gives users OpenRouter-class routing from
self-hosted software, and keeps the provider picker short and honest about
where models actually come from.

`IF YOU WANT BE OPEN, OPEN YOUR DOORS.`
`DO NOT JUST FOLLOW WHAT OPENCLAW DID, GO AHEAD, EVOLVE.`

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's unmodified Pi providers with their own transport become native DSH llm routes with dynamic model catalogs — exactly the self-hosted gateway first-class provider outcome, including live model sync from the gateway's own listing.
priorAudit.boundary: This is an alternate provider route; it does not split packages/llm or change the DSH provider picker catalog structure.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Self-hosted gateways plug in as native DSH routes with live model catalogs — no dependence on the external SaaS catalog.

records.title: 自定义 OpenAI 兼容服务商无法使用 DeepSeek 思考强度：supportsDeveloperRole 被丢弃且 UI 缺少档位控件
records.body:
## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 0.1.0-rc.6
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.82.1
- 上游：自建 / 公司的 OpenAI 兼容网关 → DeepSeek 官方 API

## 两个问题

### 1. 自定义服务商在 UI 上没有任何思考强度（reasoning effort）控件

“自定义服务提供商”卡片和编辑器刻意不提供推理档位字段，只能手工编辑 `settings.yaml`，给每个模型写 `reasoningEfforts` 和 `compat.thinkingFormat: deepseek`。对于把公司 DeepSeek 网关配成自定义服务商的用户，表现就是“无法选择思考强度”。

### 2. 即使按上述方式写好了配置，请求也会报 400

```
messages[0].role: unknown variant `developer`, expected one of
`system`, `user`, `assistant`, `tool`, `latest_reminder`
```

配置示例：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    company-gateway:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://gateway.example.com/v1
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
        supportsDeveloperRole: false   # DeepSeek 不接受 developer 角色
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 128000
          reasoningEfforts:
            low: low
            high: high
            max: max
```

根因：pi-ai 在 `model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole` 为真时，把 system prompt 序列化成 `developer` 角色（OpenAI o1/gpt-5 风格）。对非标准 baseURL，pi-ai 的自动检测会把 `supportsDeveloperRole` 默认成 `true`（只有 `*.deepseek.com` 的 URL 才会走 DeepSeek 专用检测），而 DeepSeek 的 OpenAI 兼容接口只接受 `system`，不接受 `developer`。

但 settings.yaml 里写 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` **不会生效**，因为 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 在三个位置把它丢弃了：

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 只声明了 `thinkingFormat` / `supportsReasoningEffort`；
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts` 的 `compatProfile` schema 只校验这两个字段；
- `resolveModelCompat` 只把这两个字段透传给模型。

## 复现与验证

按上面的配置（包含 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`）抓包，发往上游的请求体仍然是 `"role":"developer"` → 400。本地给 schema 加上字段、并让 `resolveModelCompat` 透传后，同样请求变成 `"role":"system"` → 200，响应正常带 `reasoning_content`。

## 建议修复

1. 在 `PiAiCompatProfile`、`compatProfile` schema 和 `resolveModelCompat` 透传中增加 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`。
2. 当配置 `compat.thinkingFormat: "deepseek"` 时，把 `supportsDeveloperRole` 默认设为 `false`（DeepSeek 协议永远不接受 `developer` 角色）。
3. 在自定义服务商编辑器的 UI 里暴露每个模型的 `reasoningEfforts` / `compat` 配置，避免必须手改 `settings.yaml`。

comments.body:
这里两个缺口可以一起绕过，但不是继续手写同一段 settings。做法是让网关对应的 Pi provider package 经 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 注册原生 route：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <Pi provider 包>
```

自带 transport 的 provider 会把自己的 `thinkingLevelMap` 暴露成 DSH 推理档位，并在用户选择后把 effort 传给 stream；它模型描述上的 `supportsDeveloperRole: false` 同样直接参与请求组装，不经过 `PiAiCompatProfile` 白名单。

我们在真实 DSH 选择器和透传请求体上都验过：档位出现、选择值下传、首条 role 为 `system`。这条方案不会修改原 settings 路径，原 schema 问题仍需上游修。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's alternate provider route with unmodified Pi providers can connect to custom OpenAI-compatible gateways, translating compat flags including supportsDeveloperRole, potentially avoiding the DSH config passthrough bug.
priorAudit.boundary: This is an alternate provider route. It does not repair DSH's native dsh-llm-pi-ai config passthrough defect or add reasoning effort controls to DSH's custom provider UI.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Use pi2dsh's alternate provider route to connect your company gateway with correct compat flags, bypassing the DSH config bug, but note DSH's native UI still lacks the controls.

records.title: 阿里云Qwen调用不兼容 Aliyun/Qwen compatibility: parallel Responses tools, Chat Completions developer role, Anthropic empty signatures
records.body:
## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness: observed on `0.1.0-rc.6`; rechecked the published `0.1.0-rc.7` packages while preparing this report
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`: `0.1.0-rc.7`
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai`: `0.82.1`
- Provider: an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio application endpoint (`https://<region>.maas.aliyuncs.com/apps/<app-id>`)
- Model: `qwen3.8-max`

No credentials, application IDs, internal host names, or private screenshots are included below.

We encountered three different compatibility failures while trying the three API modes supported by DSH/pi-ai. I am grouping them because they affect the same provider/model configuration and because two of them need additional `llm-pi-ai` compatibility fields exposed by DSH.

## 1. OpenAI Responses: parallel tool calls repeatedly receive the wrong tool name

Configuration used `api: openai-responses`. When the model intends to call two different tools in parallel, the second call is repeatedly emitted with the first call's name while retaining the second call's arguments.

Minimal shape of one observed assistant message:

```json
[
  {"name":"read","arguments":{"file_path":"/path/to/file"}},
  {"name":"read","arguments":{"command":"some command","description":"...","timeoutMs":120000}}
]
```

The second call was intended to be `bash`, so DSH correctly rejected the malformed `read` invocation with:

```text
Error: invalid arguments: missing required property "file_path"
```

This was not a one-off model typo. In the same session it repeated across several turns:

```text
read + read    (second argument object belongs to bash)
glob + glob    (second argument object belongs to bash)
bash + bash    (second argument object belongs to glob)
todo_write + todo_write (second argument object belongs to bash)
```

Later, calls where both intended tools really were `bash` worked normally. This looks like either the Aliyun Responses-compatible stream assigning the wrong function name to parallel items, or the pi-ai Responses stream aggregator correlating name/argument deltas by the wrong item/index. A focused test that interleaves two function calls with disjoint schemas should distinguish the two.

Expected: every parallel tool call keeps its own name and arguments.

## 2. OpenAI Chat Completions: Aliyun rejects the `developer` role

With `api: openai-completions`, the first request failed with:

```text
400 data: {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","param":null,"message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

pi-ai already has the relevant compatibility switch, `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`, but DSH `0.1.0-rc.7`'s `PiAiCompatProfile` exposes only `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`. Therefore this cannot currently be fixed from DSH settings.

Requested DSH configuration support:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    aliyun:
      api: openai-completions
      compat:
        supportsDeveloperRole: false
```

## 3. Anthropic Messages: empty thinking signatures and a leaked standalone `</think>`

With `api: anthropic-messages`, the endpoint returns structurally separate `thinking` and `text` blocks, but every observed thinking block has an empty signature:

```json
{"type":"thinking","thinking":"...","signature":""}
```

In a long tool-using session, one transition from a DSH Think block to the final text exposed a literal standalone closing tag in the text block:

```text
</think>
Now I have the full picture:
```

Basic one-turn and two-turn probes did not reproduce the tag, so it appears history-dependent. Inspection of pi-ai shows that response deltas are forwarded verbatim; pi-ai does not synthesize `</think>`. However, because `allowEmptySignature` defaults to `false`, previous thinking blocks with `signature: ""` are converted to ordinary assistant text during replay. That altered history shape may make the Aliyun Qwen-to-Anthropic adapter leak its internal think delimiter at a later thinking/text boundary.

We also verified directly that this endpoint accepts an empty-signature thinking block when it is replayed unchanged and returns HTTP 200. Therefore the appropriate compatibility setting for this provider is:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    aliyun:
      api: anthropic-messages
      compat:
        allowEmptySignature: true
```

pi-ai already supports `allowEmptySignature`, but DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` does not expose it in `PiAiCompatProfile`, so this setting is currently discarded/unavailable.

The upstream Aliyun adapter should still avoid emitting legacy `<think>` delimiters inside Anthropic `text` blocks. Exposing `allowEmptySignature` in DSH would preserve the protocol history correctly and remove a likely trigger.

## Suggested DSH changes

1. Expose protocol-appropriate pi-ai compatibility fields at provider and model level, at minimum:
   - `supportsDeveloperRole` for `openai-completions`
   - `allowEmptySignature` for `anthropic-messages`
2. Keep protocol validation: reject an explicitly configured flag on an incompatible API, while allowing route-level defaults to skip models that use another API.
3. Add a Responses streaming test with two or more interleaved parallel tool calls whose schemas have disjoint required fields, verifying that names, IDs, and arguments remain correlated.
4. Document an Aliyun/Qwen-compatible provider example once the fields are exposed.

I can provide a fully sanitized session excerpt or test a candidate patch if that would help.

records.title: 图片直接进对话，纯文本模型也能看图
records.body:
[插件分享] dsh-eye-upload：给纯文本模型加一个 📷 发图按钮，图片直接进对话

## 痛点

主力模型是纯文本的，Web GUI 发图片直接被拒：「当前模型不支持图片」。

DSH 有 image_understand 工具（眼睛），但图片进不了对话——得先把图存成路径，再手动把路径写进聊天框。一步之差，日常很难受。

## 这个插件做什么

在输入框工具行加一个 📷 按钮：

- 点按钮 → 选图（PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF，≤10MB）
- 图片自动存到工作区 `.dsh-vision/`
- 路径自动填入输入框：`请用 image_understand 查看这张图片：<路径>`
- 回车发送，代理调眼睛看图

代码量 ~10KB，零外部依赖，不碰 DSH 核心。

## 安装

仓库：https://github.com/AlloyPlane/dsh-eye-upload （欢迎 star / issue / PR）



重启后刷新页面，输入框左侧出现 📷 按钮。前置：已装 dsh-free-vision / dsh-eye-vision（眼睛工具）。

## 设计取舍

- 图片只存本地，走自己配的视觉模型，不经过第三方
- 严格校验格式和大小，防误传
- 一行配置 `disabled: true` 随时关闭，插件像没存在过

## 想听听大家的

1. 大家现在是怎么让 DSH 看图？手动写路径，还是有别的办法？
2. 除了按钮选图，拖拽上传 / 剪贴板粘贴截图，哪个交互更顺手？
3. 纯文本模型 + 视觉工具，你们觉得是过渡方案还是正解？

用了一个星期，最爽的是让模型直接看我桌面的报错窗口，几秒钟定位问题。欢迎试用，哪里做得不好尽管提。

comments.body: 兄弟试试我的 让ai写的，已完全开源：[https://github.com/dami9527/dsh-image-pathify](https://github.com/dami9527/dsh-image-pathify)，支持版本更新检测，去掉了纯文本模型的拖拽/复制发图限制，插件内置识图工具`analyze_image`，接入第三方支持识图的模型，支持同时识别多张图片。目前已测试拖拽/复制图片、绝对路径、图片URL 一切正常，同时不影响原本就支持视觉的模型(比如比较热门的gpt-5.6)。 调用前会判断模型有没有识图能力，路由动态裁剪工具列表和提示词，纯文本模型去掉 `read_image`，视觉模型去掉 `analyze_image ` 与提示词， 减少两种工具打架的可能，即使误调用 也会直接抛错 重新引导模型调用正确的识图工具

records.title: When will DSH support ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok consumer subscriptions (login, not API keys)?
records.body:
The current Models page already accepts API keys for OpenAI and Anthropic, plus Codex OAuth. That is not what I need.

I already pay for the main consumer subscriptions:
- OpenAI / ChatGPT (Plus or Pro)
- Anthropic / Claude (Pro or Max)
- xAI / Grok

I want to sign in with those accounts and use the included quota inside DeepSeek Harness, the same way Codex already uses OAuth. I do not want a second pay-per-token bill.

Questions:
1. Is first-class login for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok subscriptions on the official roadmap?
2. If yes, what is the expected order and any public timeline?
3. If no or not soon, is the official answer “API keys / custom endpoint only”?

I am not asking for unofficial wrappers. I want the official product position.

comments.body:
The ChatGPT/Codex subscription part is usable now through [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh), as a native DSH model route rather than a Codex subagent.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
# restart dsh, then run:
/login
```

Choose **OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus/Pro)**. The OAuth flow is shown through the DSH question dialog, the rotating token is published into the DSH credentials service, and the account gets its own group in the normal model picker.

I ran the full path on a real DSH Web session: browser login → 7 Codex models appeared → selected GPT-5.6 Sol → the model answered the turn. Reproduction details and screenshots are under `examples/subscription-login`.

This does not answer the official roadmap question, but it solves the ChatGPT subscription use case today.

Follow-up: the same ChatGPT Plus/Pro `/login` route now covers image generation and editing as well as normal Codex model turns.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add @crazygit/pi-codex-image-gen
# restart, then in the composer:
/login openai-codex
```

After login, a Codex model can call `codex_generate_image`; the Pi package reuses that OAuth account to call `gpt-image-2`, and the returned PNG is persisted through DSH attachments and rendered inline in the Web tool card. Local reference-image edits go through a DSH confirmation dialog before upload.

No separate image API key is required. Reproduction: <https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/codex-image-gen>

replies.body: Does this work for Supergrok? The oauth part, not the image gen part

@iimaguest Yes — SuperGrok OAuth is now supported through the original [`stnly/pi-grok`](https://github.com/stnly/pi-grok) provider package running unmodified on DSH via [`pi2dsh`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:stnly/pi-grok
```

Restart DSH, then run:

```text
/login xai-oauth
```

The package’s xAI device-code login is shown in DSH’s question panel, and its package-owned transport is registered as a normal DSH model route. We verified the published package in a clean DSH profile through real xAI OIDC discovery, device-code issuance/display, and cancellation.

If your SuperGrok account hits an account-specific authorization or model-call error, please paste it in the [pi2dsh issues](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues) and we’ll follow it through.

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's OpenAI Codex OAuth subscription login provides a native DSH model selector route for consumer subscriptions, and the provider route can be extended to ChatGPT/Claude/Grok consumer logins via Pi providers with their own transport.
priorAudit.boundary: This is an alternate provider route; it does not add official DSH support for ChatGPT/Claude/Grok consumer subscriptions or change the official roadmap.

records.title: Allow AgentOptions to set a per-agent reasoning effort
records.body:
`AgentOptions` currently supports `provider`, `model`, and `maxTokens`, but not `reasoningEffort`. Fresh child agents therefore fall back to the selected model default even when a routed subagent call wants a per-call effort override.

Proposed minimal change:

1. Add `reasoningEffort?: ReasoningEffortId` to `AgentOptions`.
2. In `ReactLoopAgent.buildRequest`, preserve an explicit persisted effort first, then fall back to `this.options.reasoningEffort`.

This preserves resumed-session precedence and leaves provider/model defaults unchanged when no override is supplied.

I implemented and tested the change on a fork branch: https://github.com/KldsSeeGhosts/deepseek-harness/tree/erm-445-agent-reasoning-effort

Verification: the focused `request-reconstruction.spec.ts` suite passes (23 tests), and the repository pre-push typecheck passes. The upstream repository currently has Issues disabled and does not expose a Pull Requests tab, so I am posting the proposal here for maintainers.

comments.body:
+1，这个能力对 subagent 路由非常有用。

目前可以通过 `agentOptions` 为 subagent 单独指定 provider 和 model，也希望能在这里配置 reasoning effort：

```yaml
agentOptions:
  provider: 
  model: 
  reasoningEffort: high
```

A concrete alternative implementation is now available through the Pi subagent plugin route. It does not change DSH native `AgentOptions`, but gives a Pi-created native DSH child its own model and reasoning effort:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add @tintinweb/pi-subagents
```

The plugin call uses `model: "provider/model"` plus `thinking: "max"`; pi2dsh carries the latter through the child-scoped official `agent/request` waterfall as `reasoningEffort`. Omission keeps the existing behavior.

Real E2E: the parent remains on `work-gw/deepseek-chat`, while a child explicitly requests `deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash` + max. The durable child `request/header` records the official route and `reasoningEffort: "max"`; the parent header remains work-gw; the child performs a real bash tool call and lands a marker. This verifies request isolation and the final child request, not only option plumbing.

Reproduction and evidence:
https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/subagents
https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/community/subagents-lifecycle-e2e.json

补充一个基于 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` 的实际验证结果，支持这个需求。

测试配置：

- 主 Agent：`grok / grok-4.6`，显式 effort 为 `high`；
- Subagent：固定路由到 `codex / gpt-5.6-luna`。

Provider/model 路由本身正确生效，但子会话的 `subagent/descriptor` 只有：

```json
{
  "agentProvider": "codex",
  "agentModel": "gpt-5.6-luna"
}
```

子会话的 `request/header.config` 同样只有 provider/model，没有 `reasoningEffort`。最终 Luna 使用 Codex Provider 默认的 `max`，而不是主 Agent 的 `high`。这说明当前缺口不只是 UI：即使插件已经能独立路由子代理模型，也无法控制子代理的质量/成本档位。

希望原生实现时一并覆盖：

1. `AgentOptions.reasoningEffort`；
2. Subagent descriptor snapshot；
3. continuable 子代理的持久化与冷恢复，避免恢复后退回 Provider 默认值；
4. 内置 Subagent tool 的 `agentOptions` schema；
5. Workflow `agent(prompt, { provider, model, reasoningEffort })`（相关需求见 #2970）；
6. 最终值写入 `request/header.config`，便于确认实际生效值。

建议优先级为：单次显式值 > 子代理配置默认值 > 可选的父代理继承策略 > Provider/模型默认值。不支持的档位建议 fail closed，而不是静默降级。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's @tintinweb/pi-subagents supports per-child thinkingLevel mapped to DSH reasoningEffort, providing per-agent reasoning effort control as an alternate path.
priorAudit.boundary: This does not modify the DSH-native AgentOptions schema; the core type remains unchanged.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Pi subagents give per-child reasoning effort control today; the native AgentOptions schema remains a DSH-core change.

records.title: Codex 同款「侧边任务」:主对话右侧开临时任务,用完即删、零残留
records.body:
# 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「侧边任务」面板：主对话右侧开临时任务，用完即删、零残留

用过 Codex 的朋友应该熟悉它的「侧边任务」交互：主任务跑着跑着，突然想查个东西、问个问题，又不想打断主对话——在右侧开一个临时任务，带着当前上下文问完就关，干净利落。

我们觉得这个交互对 DSH 很有价值，就用 DSH 自己的插件机制做了一个社区插件 **`ui-side-tasks`**。先说清楚：这是**受 Codex 交互启发的一个社区实现**（与 Codex 的原生侧边任务是不同的代码实现），但核心体验一致——**不打断主对话，临时任务用完即删**。

## 它长什么样

- 会话头部一个「侧边任务」按钮，点开右侧浮出任务面板（和主对话同屏）
- **新建任务 = 从当前会话 fork**，自动带上主会话的全部上下文——临时问个问题，不需要重新交代背景
- 面板里直接对话：发消息、看回复、停止，都不用切走主对话
- **用完即删、零残留**：删除任务 = 停掉它的 agent + 删掉它的日志 + 从工作区移除，磁盘上不留一点痕迹（这也是我们最看重的一点：临时任务就该是临时的）

## 顺手解决了什么

| 场景 | 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 主任务进行中，想查个资料 | 开新会话重新交代上下文，或打断主任务 | 侧边开个任务，带着上下文问完就删 |
| 想让模型同时做两件事 | 来回切换，思路被打断 | 主对话 + 侧边任务并行 |
| 验证完的临时会话 | 留在侧边栏占位置 | 一键删除，磁盘零残留 |

## 一些设计细节

- **不打扰主界面**：侧边任务 fork 后自动收纳，不会在你左侧的会话列表里堆积——它只活在面板里，用完即删
- **消息近实时跟随**：面板对话自动刷新，任务运行中的回复会自己出现，不用手动点
- **自动清理**：超过 1 小时没有活动的任务会被自动清理（打开面板时执行），临时任务不会变成陈年垃圾
- **实现基础**：完全基于 DSH 官方能力——fork 子会话、`prompt`/`cancel`、会话删除链路，插件本身不魔改内核

## 在哪里可以了解

- 这个插件来自 [https://mydsh.dev](https://mydsh.dev)（一个**非官方**社区，爱好者维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系）。我们日常用 DSH 干活，遇到痛点就做成插件，也收录在插件大全里。
- 想找更多 DSH 插件，可以逛逛我们的插件大全：它收录的是整个社区的 DSH 插件——社区作者发布的、我们自己做的、日常从生态里挖掘发现的，全部带 AI 中文总结 + AI 智能搜索（[https://mydsh.dev/plugins](https://mydsh.dev/plugins)）

评论区聊聊：你希望侧边任务还能做什么？或者去 [https://mydsh.dev](https://mydsh.dev) 反馈页告诉我们。

插件已开源：**[github.com/uluckystar/dsh-client-ui-side-tasks](https://github.com/uluckystar/dsh-client-ui-side-tasks)**（已加入官方 [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，可在生态里直接搜到）。安装很简单：`git clone` 后执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add <仓库路径>` 即可。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's @tintinweb/pi-subagents provides real DSH child sessions with foreground/background execution, steering, and durable reopen. The user's primary outcome is a side-task panel that forks from the main conversation, runs a temporary task, and cleans up — Pi subagents deliver exactly this as an alternate implementation.
priorAudit.boundary: The user's own ui-side-tasks plugin is a DSH-native implementation; Pi subagents provide an alternate path but do not repair any DSH core bug. The user's plugin itself remains as-is.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Pi subagents give you real DSH child sessions with fork-from-parent context, background execution, and cleanup — a working alternate to your side-task panel.

```
 │           Model deepseek-v4-flash           │                                                │
 │   Path ~/workspace/dsh-ccTUI                │                                                │
 │    Perms Ask for approval · /permissions    │                                                │
 │ Session cctui-56b37bee-41fd-4feb-b270-5988… │                                                │

 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯



 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

```

A real turn — tool trail, collapsed reasoning, streamed answer:

```
 ❯ List the markdown files in docs/, then tell me in one short sentence what this project is.

   Searched for 1 pattern, read 1 file, ran 1 shell command
 └─ ∴ Thinking…  ~87 tokens
   └─ The user wants me to list markdown files in docs/ and tell them in one short sentence what
      the project is. Let me start by listing the files in docs/.Now let me read the README to
      understand what the project is.The project is dsh-ccTUI: a Claude Code style TUI for
      Deepseek-Harness, ported from clawcodex ui-tui and packaged as a dsh bundle plugin.

 ⏺  Markdown files in docs/:

    • docs/PLAN.md
    • docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
    • docs/PORTING-NOTES.md

    In one sentence: This project is dsh-ccTUI, a Claude Code–style terminal UI (TUI) for
    DeepSeek-Harness, ported from the clawcodex ui-tui and packaged as a dsh plugin so harness
    sessions, tools, approvals, and commands run in-process with the familiar Claude Code
    look and feel.


 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ❯
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   ? for shortcuts
   deepseek-v4-flash · ~/workspace/dsh-ccTUI              · turns: 1 · tokens: 0 in / 0 out
```

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/agentforce314/dsh-ccTUI
cd dsh-ccTUI
./install.sh            # builds, then: dsh plugin --profile dsh-cctui add "$PWD"
dsh --profile dsh-cctui
```

Needs Node ≥ 22.19, pnpm, and a `dsh` CLI on `0.1.0-rc.7`. Provider/model come from the profile's `agent-default-model`, so if `dsh web` already talks to your model, this will too.

## How it plugs in

Everything is read off the harness's own seams — no core patching. The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row over `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` and disables `hmr`:

| harness | what the UI does with it |
| --- | --- |
| `session/event` (`assistant/chunk`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, `turn/end`) | streamed transcript, tool trail, per-turn usage |
| tool `presentCall` / `presentResult` views | diff cards, terminal output, search results |
| `approval/request` waterfall | the approval prompt (delegates other agents via `next()`) |
| `ctx.userQuestions` provider | question panel; a `plan-review` intent renders the plan-approval dialog |
| `ctx.commands` | merged into the slash menu and dispatched through `execute()` |
| `ctx.agents.resume` + `ctx.sessionPersistence` | `/resume` and the live/persisted session switcher |
| `ctx.planMode` + approval policy | the Shift+Tab mode cycle (default → plan → bypass) |
| `ctx.tokenMeter` + `llm.resolveModelInfo` | the context bar |
| `todo/write` | the pinned todo panel |

## Why a port instead of a rewrite

The UI is ported from clawcodex's `ui-tui` (MIT), which happened to have exactly **one** backend seam: a client class exposing an event stream plus a promise RPC surface, where unknown methods resolve empty. So the port only had to reimplement that one class against the harness — roughly 40k LOC of UI (including a forked Ink renderer with virtualized scrollback, selection and mouse support) came across untouched. That is why it feels like the original rather than an approximation, and it made the work stageable: the TUI booted against a scripted LLM long before sessions, approvals or commands were wired.

## Status

v0.3.0, MIT. Tests: ~1,900 unit tests plus two PTY end-to-end suites that boot the real `dsh` CLI against a scripted LLM adapter — one drives a full conversation (streaming → approval → tool → resume), the other exercises the actual `dsh plugin add` install path. Both run in CI.

Not wired, because the upstream features have no harness counterpart: billing, voice, pets, browser control, worktree exit flow, rollback. Their RPCs resolve empty and the UI degrades silently rather than erroring.

Feedback very welcome — especially if I'm holding any of these service seams wrong, or if there's a more idiomatic way to express a surface bundle like this.

*Credits: the UI and its Ink fork are ported from [clawcodex](https://github.com/agentforce314/clawcodex) `ui-tui` (MIT); the renderer ultimately derives from [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) (MIT). Full attribution in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/agentforce314/dsh-ccTUI/blob/main/NOTICE.md).*
