records.title: pi-ai: expose `supportsDeveloperRole` in `PiAiCompatProfile` (gateways that reject `role: developer` are currently unconfigurable)
records.body:
## Problem

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` cannot be configured to talk to an OpenAI-compatible gateway that rejects `role: "developer"` for the system message, because the switch that controls it is not part of the configurable compat surface.

Concretely, against Alibaba Cloud Bailian / DashScope (`https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`), every request fails:

```
dsh: INVALID_REQUEST: 400: {"message":"role 'developer' is not allowed",
     "type":"InvalidParameter","code":"InvalidParameter"}
```

## Why it is not configurable today

pi-ai derives the flag from the base URL:

```js
// @earendil-works/pi-ai — api/openai-completions.js
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)
...
const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole
const role = useDeveloperRole ? "developer" : "system"
```

An unrecognized endpoint therefore resolves to `true`. But `PiAiCompatProfile` only exposes two of pi-ai's compat fields:

```ts
// packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts
export interface PiAiCompatProfile {
  thinkingFormat?: PiAiThinkingFormat
  supportsReasoningEffort?: boolean
}
```

The documented intent is that "the rest of pi-ai's compat surface keeps its baseURL-derived auto-detection" — which is reasonable in general, but here the auto-detection is wrong and there is no way to correct it from settings. Declaring `reasoningEfforts` (needed for a reasoning model) makes `model.reasoning` true, which is exactly what activates the developer role.

## Evidence that this is the only blocker

I probed the endpoint field by field. Everything else pi-ai sends by default is accepted:

| wire detail | Bailian result |
|---|---|
| `role: "system"` | 200 |
| `role: "developer"` | **400 `role 'developer' is not allowed`** |
| `max_completion_tokens` (pi-ai default) | 200 |
| `max_tokens` | 200 |
| tools with `strict: true` | 200 |
| tools non-strict | 200 |

So a single configurable field would make this route work with settings alone.

## Proposed change

Add one field to the profile and its schema:

```ts
// packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts
export interface PiAiCompatProfile {
  thinkingFormat?: PiAiThinkingFormat
  supportsReasoningEffort?: boolean
  supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean   // new
}

// packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts
const compatProfile: z<PiAiCompatProfile> = z.object({
  thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
  supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean(),
  supportsDeveloperRole: z.boolean(),   // new
})
```

`getCompat()` in pi-ai already honours `model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole ?? detected.supportsDeveloperRole`, so the pass-through needs no upstream pi-ai change.

This is not Bailian-specific — it would help any self-hosted or regional OpenAI-compatible gateway pi-ai does not recognize.

## Current workaround

I wrote a small standalone adapter plugin that owns the wire format, which also let me add image support for `kimi/kimi-k3`:
https://github.com/sologuy/dsh-llm-bailian-kimi

If `supportsDeveloperRole` becomes configurable, that plugin can shrink to a model catalog, or go away entirely.

I understand external PRs are not being accepted right now — posting here as an idea rather than a patch. Thanks for the harness, the plugin seam made this straightforward to work around.

comments.body: 这个配置边界在 rc.8 后已经补上，当前 rc.2 线也包含 `supportsDeveloperRole` 等 compat 字段。升级后可设 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`，让 instruction 使用 `system` 而非 `developer`。无需 pi2dsh 特判；验证配置中的 false 未被 schema 丢弃，并检查真实请求体角色。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's Pi provider route handles gateways that reject developer role via its own transport, verified with Alibaba Token Plan; the user's exact blocker (Bailian rejecting role:developer) is solved by using the Pi route instead of dsh-llm-pi-ai.
priorAudit.boundary: The dsh-llm-pi-ai compat profile still lacks supportsDeveloperRole; pi2dsh doesn't patch that adapter.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Use the Pi provider route for Bailian — it handles developer-role rejection natively, verified with Alibaba Token Plan.

records.title: 插件分享：dsh-vision-dashscope —— 基于 DashScope 的图片/视频/音频识别与生成
records.body:
"**dsh-vision-dashscope** 是一个基于 DashScope（阿里云百炼）的 MCP server 插件，为纯文本 Agent 提供**图片 / 视频 / 音频的识别与生成**能力。

## 为什么做它

之前用过的同类插件对本地大视频支持有限（base64 data-uri 有 20MB 硬上限，只能压缩画质）。这个插件改为走百炼官方的**临时 OSS 直传**链路，彻底解决：

- 大视频/大文件自动 `getPolicy → OSS 上传 → oss:// 临时 URL`（单文件上限 1GB，按模型的 `max_file_size_mb` 动态校验），**不压缩、不损画质**；
- `mkv / avi` 等浏览器不可播的容器也能识别（模型服务端解码抽帧）；
- 长音频自动降级为 fun-asr 异步转写，短音频用 qwen3.5-omni 直接理解。

## 工具

| 工具 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| `recognize_image` | 图片识别（qwen3.7-flash） |
| `recognize_video` | 视频识别，大文件 OSS 直传（qwen3.7-flash） |
| `recognize_audio` | 短音频理解 / 长音频 fun-asr 转写 |
| `generate_image` | 文生图（qwen-image-3.0 等） |
| `generate_video` | 文生视频（wan2.7-t2v / happyhorse-1.1-t2v） |
| `generate_video_from_image` | 图生视频（wan2.7-i2v，首帧自动上传临时 OSS） |
| `dashscope_status` | 查看当前模型与限制配置 |

生成类工具**必须 `confirm=true` 才会实际调用付费接口**，否则只返回预计费用（如"预计 3.00 元（5 秒 × 0.6 元/秒）"）；生成结果自动下载到本地输出目录，配合 dsh-image-preview 可直接在对话里内联预览。

## 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ywleeo/dsh-vision-dashscope.git
cd dsh-vision-dashscope
cp .env.example .env   # 填入 DASH_VISION_API_KEY
uv sync
```

DSH 接入（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-vision-dashscope
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: vision-dashscope
        transport: stdio
        command: /Users/leeo/.local/bin/uv
        args:
          - run
          - --directory
          - /path/to/dsh-vision-dashscope
          - dsh-vision-dashscope
        failOnStartupError: false
```

## 参考

- 仓库：[ywleeo/dsh-vision-dashscope](https://github.com/ywleeo/dsh-vision-dashscope)（tag `v0.2.2`）
- 大文件上传原理：[阿里云百炼《上传文件获取临时 URL》](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/get-temporary-file-url)
- 同系列插件：dsh-image-preview（对话内联本地图片/视频预览）"

priorAudit.solution: pi-mcp-adapter runs the dsh-vision-dashscope MCP server unchanged, providing image/video/audio recognition and generation through DSH's MCP client path.
priorAudit.boundary: The DashScope MCP server itself is a third-party plugin; pi2dsh does not fix any DSH core multimodal or attachment issues.
priorAudit.replyAngle: pi-mcp-adapter runs this DashScope MCP server unchanged, giving you the full vision/generation toolset through DSH's MCP path.

records.title: llm-pi-ai: expose supportsDeveloperRole / maxTokensField in PiAiCompatProfile for OpenAI-compatible gateways
records.body:
## Problem

For a hand-declared `openai-completions` route pointing at an OpenAI-compatible gateway, `dsh-llm-pi-ai` relies on pi-ai's URL-derived compat detection. An unrecognized gateway URL is treated as a standard OpenAI endpoint, so the adapter sends:

- the system prompt as `role: "developer"`, and
- the output cap as `max_completion_tokens`

Classic OpenAI-compatible gateways reject the first with `400` and may not accept the second. There is currently no configuration surface to correct either: `PiAiCompatProfile` only exposes `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/{catalog.ts,config.ts}`), and the README states the rest of pi-ai's compat surface "stays auto-detected and is deliberately not configurable here".

## Reproduction

Route config (`settings.yaml`, redacted):

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-gateway:
      apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: openai
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 384000
```

First request fails:

```
INVALID_REQUEST: 400 {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

This is the same gateway family as DashScope compatible-mode, where the community plugin `sologuy/dsh-llm-bailian-kimi` documents the identical blocker (its README: Bailian rejects `role: 'developer'`, and this switch is not exposed by DSH's `PiAiCompatProfile` — "这正是本插件存在的理由").

## Why it matters

pi-ai itself supports both fields: `getCompat()` merges `model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole` / `model.compat.maxTokensField` over the URL-derived detection, and pi's own custom-provider configuration exposes them. dsh's adapter builds the pi-ai model compat from only two of the available fields, so deployments behind private/enterprise gateways cannot correct the detection without writing a full custom adapter plugin.

## Proposal

Add to `PiAiCompatProfile` (route-level default, per-model override, same resolution order as the existing two switches):

- `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`
- `maxTokensField?: 'max_tokens' | 'max_completion_tokens'`

passed through to the constructed pi-ai model compat alongside `thinkingFormat` / `supportsReasoningEffort`. Both remain protocol-gated to `openai-completions` like the existing fields.

## Current workaround

A small custom `LlmAdapter` plugin that owns the route and speaks the gateway dialect directly (this is what we shipped for our deployment). If the fields above land, that plugin retires into a `settings.yaml` section.

records.title: Bug: llm-pi-ai 丢弃 supportsDeveloperRole，SGLang/Qwen 收到 developer role 后返回 400
records.body:
## TL;DR

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-root@0.1.0-rc.7` 的 `llm-pi-ai` 配置 schema 会静默丢弃显式的 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`。pi-ai 随后按 URL/模型自动推断 reasoning model 支持 `developer` message role；只接受 `system` role 的 SGLang/Qwen OpenAI-compatible endpoint 因此返回 HTTP 400 `Unexpected message role.`。

官方目前不接受外部 PR，下面的 fork 分支仅作为可审阅、可 cherry-pick 的修复与测试证据。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness：`0.1.0-rc.7`，上游基线 `99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca`
- Provider：自托管 SGLang OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- Model：Qwen reasoning model
- Route protocol：`openai-completions`

没有在报告或分支中提交 endpoint、API key 或本地部署配置。

## 现象

配置希望覆盖自动探测：

```yaml
- id: llm
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      local-qwen:
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: https://example.invalid/v1
        compat:
          supportsDeveloperRole: false
        models:
          - id: qwen-reasoning
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              high: high
```

但 rc.7 实际发出的第一条 instruction message 是：

```json
{"role":"developer","content":"..."}
```

SGLang 返回 HTTP 400，底层错误为 `Unexpected message role.`。在 Harness 页面上，该请求还可能表现为 `400 status code (no body)` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`，容易被误诊为上下文长度问题。

应用修复后，相同配置和其他参数不变，实际 payload 变为：

```json
{"role":"system","content":"..."}
```

本地 Standard 与 Router Standard 两条真实请求均正常完成。

## 根因

`PiAiCompatProfile` 和 `compatProfile` schema 只暴露了：

- `thinkingFormat`
- `supportsReasoningEffort`

因此配置加载阶段会丢掉 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`。`resolveModelCompat()` 也没有把该字段按 model → route → installed catalog → pi-ai URL detection 的顺序合并。布尔值 `false` 丢失后，pi-ai 只能使用自动推断，并给 reasoning model 发送 `developer` role。

## 修复

修复分支：

- Branch: https://github.com/Anothers/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/pi-ai-developer-role-compat
- Commit: https://github.com/Anothers/deepseek-harness/commit/bab04e4a3e6625979c834f57140c097993c7aa45

改动包括：

1. 在 public config type 与 schema 中加入 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`。
2. 在 route/model compat 解析中逐字段合并该值，model override 优先于 route default。
3. 仍只允许它用于 `openai-completions`，其他 protocol 保持 fail-loud。
4. 增加 schema boundary 测试，固定 `false` 不会被物化过程吞掉。
5. 增加真实 mock HTTP provider 回归测试，断言 reasoning request 的 system prompt 以 `role: system` 发出。
6. 同步英文/中文 README、generated config catalog 与既有 Agent Note。

## 验证

- `llm-pi-ai`：9 个测试文件，218 项全部通过。
- 受影响的 `catalog.ts`、`config.ts`：statements / branches / functions / lines 均为 100%。
- 仓库 pre-push 全量 build + TypeScript typecheck 通过。
- 946 组中英文文档 pairing 检查通过；其余 27 项 doc-sync gates 通过。
- 本地真实 SGLang 请求：修复前 `developer` → 400；修复后 `system` → 成功。

如果维护者认可这个配置边界，可以直接采用或 cherry-pick 上述提交；提交基于当前 rc.7 master，未包含任何本地部署 patch。

records.title: 接入火山方舟（Ark, volces.com）报 400：pi-ai 将系统提示词以 developer 角色发出，方舟只接受 system/assistant/user/tool
records.body:
> Ark (volces.com) integration fails with 400 `InvalidParameter`: system prompt is sent with role `developer`, which the Ark gateway rejects

## 环境

- dsh：`0.1.0-rc.7`（当前 npm 最新版）
- 底层 LLM 客户端：`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `0.82.1`（dsh 内置；npm 最新 `0.84.2` 同样存在此问题）
- 接入方式：`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` → `llm-pi-ai.providers` 自定义提供方，协议 `api: openai-completions`

## 现象：本次遇到的每一个错误

配置了两个火山方舟提供方（Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan），模型为 DeepSeek V4（GLM 等声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型同样受影响）：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    ark-agent:
      displayName: Ark Agent
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_AGENT_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash
          reasoningEfforts: { off: "", high: high, max: max }
        # ... deepseek-v4-pro 同
    ark-code:
      displayName: Ark Code
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_CODE_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3
      models:
        # 同样声明了 reasoningEfforts
```

### 错误 1：ark-agent（`/api/plan/v3`）

每次调用直接失败：

```
本轮运行失败400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 0217871311856159ee13f605c3786670e0524dbc441cb77696edd","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

### 错误 2：ark-code（`/api/coding/v3`）

完全相同的错误（不同 request id）：

```
本轮运行失败400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 02178713365052253d6ccd6c87f6638f3cd2525e8826483913bc8","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

### 最小复现（curl，与 DSH 无直接关系，用于证明端点行为）

两个端点行为一致：

| 请求 role | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `developer` | ❌ 400 `InvalidParameter: invalid value: developer` |
| `system` | ✅ 200，正常返回（deepseek-v4-flash 默认还会输出 `reasoning_content`） |

## 根因与错误代码定位

系统提示词（system prompt）被以 `developer` 角色发送，方舟网关拒绝该角色。完整调用链：

**① `dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `resolveModelReasoning()`（lib/index.js 约 1047–1086 行）**

只要模型声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 且包含非 `off` 档位，就返回 `reasoning: true`：

```js
if (!declared.some(([level]) => level !== "off")) invalid(...);
// ...
return {
    reasoning: true,
    thinkingLevelMap: map
};
```

**② pi-ai → `convertMessages()`（`dist/api/openai-completions.js` 约 785–792 行）**

```js
if (context.systemPrompt) {
    const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;
    const role = useDeveloperRole ? "developer" : "system";
    params.push({ role: role, content: sanitizeSurrogates(context.systemPrompt) });
}
```

**③ pi-ai → `detectCompat()`（同文件约 1141–1148 行）——根因所在**

```js
const isNonStandard = isNvidia ||
    provider === "cerebras" || baseUrl.includes("cerebras.ai") ||
    provider === "xai" || baseUrl.includes("api.x.ai") ||
    isTogether || baseUrl.includes("chutes.ai") ||
    baseUrl.includes("deepseek.com") ||
    isZai || isMoonshot ||
    provider === "opencode" || baseUrl.includes("opencode.ai") ||
    isCloudflareWorkersAI || isCloudflareAiGateway ||
    isAntLing;
// ...
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter),
```

`isNonStandard` 名单覆盖了 nvidia/cerebras/xai/together/chutes.ai/deepseek.com/zai/moonshot/opencode.ai/cloudflare/ant-ling，但**没有覆盖 `volces.com`**，于是方舟被默认判定为「支持 developer 角色」。

**④ 配置层面无解**

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 配置项（lib/index.js 约 1375–1382 行）只开放了 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`：

```js
const compatProfile = z.object({
    thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
    supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean()
});
```

**没有 `supportsDeveloperRole` 开关**，自定义提供方用户无法通过 settings.yaml 关闭该行为。

② + ③ 两个条件同时成立 → 系统提示词以 `developer` 发出 → 方舟 400。默认的 `opencode-go`（`opencode.ai`）在 `isNonStandard` 名单中 → 使用 `system` → 正常，所以只有方舟端点失败。

## 修复方法（当前可用的本地补丁）

修改 pi-ai 的 `detectCompat()` 返回值，仅关闭方舟的 developer 角色（不动其它兼容位）：

```diff
-        supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter),
+        supportsDeveloperRole: (isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)) && !baseUrl.includes("volces.com"),
```

文件：`node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js`

## 修复结果（已实测验证）

通过 pi-ai 真实 `stream()` 路径（与 DSH 相同的代码路径）+ `onPayload` 抓取实际发出的 wire role，使用本机方舟密钥：

| 场景 | 发出的 role | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| ark-agent `plan/v3`（补丁后） | `system` | ✅ 请求成功，正常回复（含 thinking 块） |
| ark-code `coding/v3`（补丁后） | `system` | ✅ 请求成功，正常回复 |
| 强制 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`（模拟补丁前） | `developer` | ❌ 400，错误信息与最初报错完全一致 |

注意事项：

- 补丁只对新进程生效，运行中的 `dsh web` 需要重启；
- `npm` 重装 / 升级 dsh 后补丁丢失，需重新打；
- 备选思路：把 `volces.com` 加入 `isNonStandard` 也能修复，但会连带把 `supportsStore` 置 false（对方舟无实际影响，不过上文 diff 更保守）。

## 建议上游修复方向

1. pi-ai `detectCompat()` 识别 `volces.com`（或新增 ark 内置 provider），令 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`；
2. 在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 中开放 `supportsDeveloperRole` 布尔开关，允许自定义提供方按需关闭，无需改代码；
3. 先例：OpenClaw 项目遇到完全相同的故障（OpenAI 兼容后端拒绝 `developer` 角色），已通过强制非原生 OpenAI 端点 `supportsDeveloperRole=false` 修复：
   - issue: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27037
   - PR: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/29479

## 相关隐患（建议一并处理）

若改用 `openai-responses` 协议接方舟，同样的 developer 角色逻辑依然存在：

- `dist/api/openai-responses-shared.js` 约 92 行：`const role = model.reasoning && compat?.supportsDeveloperRole !== false ? "developer" : "system";`
- `dist/api/openai-responses.js` 约 52 行：`supportsDeveloperRole: model.compat?.supportsDeveloperRole ?? true`

当前 `openai-completions` 配置不受影响，但协议切换时同样会踩坑。

comments.body:
This report isolates an important compatibility boundary. I checked rc.7 (`99f6f02`) and the configuration surface confirms the operator-side gap:

- `reasoningEfforts` makes a hand-declared model reasoning-capable;
- pi-ai selects `developer` only when the model reasons and compatibility says that role is supported;
- the rc.7 Harness profile exposes `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`, but not `supportsDeveloperRole`.

Those three controls should stay separate. `thinkingFormat` changes the reasoning payload dialect. `supportsReasoningEffort` changes explicit effort support. Neither declares which system-message roles the gateway accepts.

For operators, the decisive evidence bundle is small: exact base URL and protocol, declared reasoning metadata, the outbound first message role, the complete 400 with request ID, and an A/B that changes only `developer` to `system`. Do not include the key or full prompt.

The safest immediate production response is a separately verified compatible route. A non-reasoning compatibility profile can be a bounded fallback if selectable reasoning is not required, but its actual wire role and model behavior must be captured. A direct dependency patch can prove the diagnosis in an isolated installation, but it is erased by reinstall or upgrade and requires a restart.

The durable fix is the one proposed here: expose `supportsDeveloperRole` as an explicit compatibility fact, or add a correct built-in detector, with independent tests for both completions and responses protocols.

I turned the decision path, recovery tradeoffs, and regression matrix into a visual runbook: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/openai-compatible-developer-role.html

Independent community handbook, not an official DeepSeek AI project.
这和 #3372 是同一配置缺口。当前版本已能显式设置 `supportsDeveloperRole:false`；火山方舟 route 应发送 system 而非 developer。升级后以真实请求体和 200 响应为准，不能只看设置页保存成功。

priorAudit.solution: pi2dsh's provider route can translate compat flags, including supportsDeveloperRole, for custom OpenAI-compatible gateways like Volces Ark. This allows the system prompt to be sent as 'system' instead of 'developer', fixing the 400 error.

records.title: llm-pi-ai 让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关可选思考强度（新增 supportsDeveloperRole 回退 system 角色；参考实现，AI 代写，仅供参考）
records.body:
## 正文 | Body

### 摘要 | Summary

**中文**：我是 DSH 使用者。用自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（如百炼 token plan 的 compatible-mode 端点）时，推理模型**选不了努力程度**：界面上没有档位可选，一旦发起带档位（推理）的请求还会 400。原因：pi-ai 对所有未收录的网关默认按"支持 `developer` 角色"探测，而不少网关只认 `system`。我加了一处小改动：给 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 透传 `supportsDeveloperRole` 兼容开关，让这类网关可以显式声明"不认 `developer`"，思考强度档位即可正常使用。改动由 AI agent 代写，**仅供参考**——我了解官方目前不接受外部 PR，请把它当作讨论素材，欢迎任何批评与建议。

**English**: I'm a DSH user. On custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (e.g. the Bailian token-plan `compatible-mode` endpoint), reasoning models **cannot select a reasoning effort**: no levels are offered, and an effort-carrying (reasoning) request fails with 400. The reason: pi-ai auto-detects every unrecognized gateway as supporting the `developer` role, but many gateways only accept `system`. This small change forwards a `supportsDeveloperRole` compat switch through `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, so such gateways can explicitly declare "no `developer` role" and effort selection works. It was drafted by an AI agent and is **for reference only** — I know external PRs aren't accepted at the moment, so treat it as discussion material. Any feedback is welcome.

### 现象 | Symptoms

**中文**：
- 配置：自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（openai-completions），如 `token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`，推理模型（qwen3.x、deepseek-v4-pro 等）；配置形式与官方指引一致。
- 问题：模型平时可用，但**无法选择思考强度**（effort 档位不出现在选择器里）；显式发起带档位的请求时报 400：`developer is not one of ['system','assistant','user','tool','function']`。

**English**:
- Setup: a custom OpenAI-compatible gateway (`api: openai-completions`), e.g. `token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`, with reasoning models (qwen3.x, deepseek-v4-pro, …), configured the official way.
- Problem: models work in general, but **reasoning effort cannot be selected** (no effort levels in the picker); an explicit effort-carrying request fails with 400: `developer is not one of ['system','assistant','user','tool','function']`.

### 根因（我的理解）| Root cause (as I understand it)

**中文**：
1. pi-ai 的 `detectCompat` 只把少数已知厂商列入"非标准"名单；**所有未收录的 baseURL 一律探测为 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`**（`openai-completions.js`：`isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)`）。
2. 模型一旦推理（reasoning），系统提示就按 `developer` 角色发送（`useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`）；只认 `system` 的网关（百炼风格）随即 400。
3. `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 只透传 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`，没有 `supportsDeveloperRole`，配置层无从覆盖探测结果；内置目录的标注又只按 route key 精确匹配，换一个 key 就继承不到。

**English**:
1. pi-ai's `detectCompat` lists only a few known vendors as "non-standard"; **every unrecognized baseURL is detected as `supportsDeveloperRole: true`** (`openai-completions.js`: `isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)`).
2. As soon as a model reasons, the system prompt goes out in the `developer` role (`useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`); `system`-only gateways (Bailian-style) answer 400.
3. `dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `PiAiCompatProfile` forwards only `thinkingFormat` + `supportsReasoningEffort` — no `supportsDeveloperRole`, so a profile cannot override the detection; and the built-in catalog's flag only applies to its exact route key.

### 参考实现 | Reference implementation

**中文**：
- `PiAiCompatProfile` 新增 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`，按 模型 → 路由 → 已装 catalog 条目 → pi-ai URL 探测 的顺序解析；schema 接受该布尔开关。
- 配置 `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` 后：思考强度档位出现在选择器里，请求以 `system` 角色发送，不再 400。
- 测试与文档（中英）一并更新。分支：`fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness` → `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role`（提交 `78a4dfd4a7`）。
- 验证：vitest 59/59、typecheck 与 lint 全绿；实测百炼推理模型档位可选、请求 200（`developer` → 400 对照）。

**English**:
- Adds `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean` to `PiAiCompatProfile`, resolved model → route → installed catalog entry → pi-ai's URL guess; schema accepts it.
- With `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }`: effort levels appear in the picker and requests go out with the `system` role — no more 400.
- Tests + docs (en/zh) updated. Branch: `fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness` → `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role` (commit `78a4dfd4a7`).
- Verified: vitest 59/59, typecheck + lint green; live check — Bailian reasoning models offer effort levels and answer 200 (with `developer` → 400 as the control).

### 直接试用 | Try it directly

**中文**：
如果你想直接跑一下这份改动，我维护的 fork 里就是当前状态：
- 分支：`feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role`（提交 `78a4dfd4a7`）
- 仓库：https://github.com/fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness
- 用法：在 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` 的目标网关下加 `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` 即可。

**English**:
If you'd like to try the change directly, my fork has it live:
- Branch: `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role` (commit `78a4dfd4a7`)
- Repo: https://github.com/fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness
- Usage: add `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` under the target gateway in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`.

### 局限 | Caveats

**中文**：
- 改动由 AI agent 生成，未经维护者评审；命名与暴露面未必符合项目方向。
- 仅针对百炼 compatible-mode 实测过；只认 `system` 的其它自定义网关行为类似但未逐一验证。
- 如果团队有更合适的方案（例如在模型发现阶段探测角色/档位支持），我随时愿意补充用例、调整设计或放弃此方案。

**English**:
- Generated by an AI agent; not reviewed by maintainers — naming and surface may not fit the project's direction.

records.title: [Plugin] dsh-codex-oauth — use your OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT) subscription in DeepSeek Harness
records.body:
Hi! I built a small community bundle that fills a documented gap: the shipped multi-provider adapter (`dsh-llm-pi-ai`) withholds `openai-codex` because Codex authenticates through ChatGPT OAuth, and that adapter holds no credential store and runs no login flow (it's listed under Known Limitations).

**dsh-codex-oauth** supplies exactly those pieces as an installable bundle — no fork, no core change:

- a `codex` provider route registered on `ctx.llm` (`LlmAdapter` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`), serving the `gpt-5.x-codex` catalog models through `@earendil-works/pi-ai`'s `openai-codex` provider;
- a `/codex login` human command (browser flow with local callback, plus `/codex login device` for headless) and a `dsh-codex-oauth` CLI bin with `login` / `logout` / `status`;
- a file-backed pi-ai `CredentialStore` at `$DSH_HOME/codex-oauth.json` (0600, owner-only dir, atomic writes, cross-process writer lock), with pi-ai's automatic token refresh.

I verified it against the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7`: the bundle loads in a profile, the route registers, and a headless run dispatches through the seam to the adapter (ending at the expected `AUTH` error until you log in).

Install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:birat-chapagain/dsh-codex-oauth
# then: /codex login  (or npx dsh-codex-oauth login --method device)
```

Repo: https://github.com/birat-chapagain/dsh-codex-oauth

If first-party Codex OAuth support is ever on the roadmap, I'd be happy to contribute these pieces (OAuth credential store + login-flow wiring) upstream — happy to hear what shape the maintainers would want that to take.

records.title: Configuring Bailian Token Plan via custom provider silently breaks: schema rejection, missing `developer` compat, and unintuitive `models` replacement semantics
records.body:
## Environment

- DSH Desktop: 2.0.1
- Harness: 0.1.0-rc.7
- pi-ai: bundled with desktop
- Provider endpoint: `https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` (Bailian Token Plan CN)
- OS: Windows

## Summary

When a user manually configures the Bailian Token Plan endpoint as a custom provider (instead of using the built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route), they encounter three cascading failures that are extremely difficult to diagnose:

1. **Reasoning effort selector does not appear** for any model
2. **`developer` role 400 error** from the Bailian API
3. **"API key is invalid"** after attempting to fix #2 by adding `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` at the route level

All three stem from configuration-layer UX issues in `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, not from the Bailian API itself. The built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route handles all of these correctly, but there is no GUI guidance to use it.

## Detailed Reproduction

### Step 1: User adds Bailian as a custom provider

This is the natural first approach — the GUI offers "Add Custom Provider" but does not surface the built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    aibaba:
      displayName: Bailian
      apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
      models:
        - id: qwen3.7-max
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
        # ... more models
```

**Result**: No reasoning effort selector appears for any model. The models work for basic chat, but reasoning capability is invisible.

**Root cause**: Hand-declared models have no reasoning metadata. The settings-models UI deliberately does not expose `reasoningEfforts` editing (source comment: *"There is deliberately no reasoning-effort control, here or on the editor"*). Without `reasoningEfforts`, `resolveModelReasoning` returns `{reasoning: false}` → `reasoningInfo()` returns `{}` → UI hides the selector.

### Step 2: User encounters `developer` role 400 error

After extended multi-turn usage, requests fail with:

```
400 {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']"}}
```

**Root cause**: `detectCompat()` in `openai-completions.js` defaults `supportsDeveloperRole: true` for the Bailian URL (it's not in the `isNonStandard` list). The built-in catalog explicitly sets `supportsDeveloperRole: false` for every Bailian model, but hand-declared routes lose this metadata. When `model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole` evaluates to true, DSH sends `role: "developer"` which Bailian rejects.

### Step 3: User tries to fix it and makes things worse

Attempting to add `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` at the route level:

```yaml
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  displayName: Bailian
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
  compat:
    supportsDeveloperRole: false   # ← NOT in compatProfile schema
  models:
    - id: wan2.7-image
    # ...
```

**Result**: The entire `llm-pi-ai` provider section fails schema validation silently. The route is never registered. Subsequent requests fail with "API key is invalid" or "no adapter registered for provider qwen-token-plan-cn" — neither of which points to the actual cause (schema rejection).

**Root cause**: `compatProfile` only accepts `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`. Writing any other field causes `assertServiceable` → `resolveProfiles` to throw. The `onChange` handler catches this and logs *"keeping the previously registered routes after a refused update"*, but the user sees only the downstream symptom ("API key is invalid"), not the validation failure.

## What Works (But Is Undiscoverable)

The built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route handles everything correctly with just:

```yaml
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  displayName: Bailian
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
```

No `api`, `baseURL`, `models`, or `compat` needed. All ~15 text models inherit correct reasoning metadata, `supportsDeveloperRole: false`, and DeepSeek's `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true`.

**But there is no way for a user to discover this** without reading source code.

## Structural Limitation: `models` Replacement Semantics

Writing a `models` list on a catalog route **completely replaces** the built-in catalog (line 1139 of `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js`):

```js
const entries = configured.length > 0 ? configured : [...defaults.values()].map(...)
```

This means users cannot supplement the built-in catalog with additional models (e.g., image/audio models not in the catalog). They must choose between:

- Full built-in catalog (correct compat, but no custom models)
- Custom model list (loses all built-in metadata including critical compat flags)

There is no merge mode.

## Suggested Improvements

### 1. Surface built-in catalog providers in the GUI

Add a "Use Built-in Provider" option in the Models settings page that lists available catalog routes (`qwen-token-plan-cn`, `deepseek`, etc.) alongside the manual "Add Custom Provider" flow. This would prevent users from ever needing to hand-configure endpoints that already have full catalog support.

### 2. Provide explicit errors on schema validation failure

When `assertServiceable` / `resolveProfiles` throws during `onChange`, the error should be surfaced to the user (toast notification, settings page banner, or at minimum a prominent log entry) rather than silently falling back to previous routes. The current behavior — logging *"keeping the previously registered routes after a refused update"* to the error log while the user sees an unrelated "API key is invalid" — makes diagnosis nearly impossible.

Specifically, when `compatProfile` rejects an unknown field like `supportsDeveloperRole`, the error message should name the invalid field and suggest valid alternatives.

### 3. Consider a `models` merge mode for catalog routes

Allow catalog routes to declare additional models without replacing the entire catalog. For example:

```yaml
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
  extraModels:           # merge instead of replace
    - id: wan2.7-image
    - id: qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus
```

Or alternatively, allow per-model compat overrides on catalog routes so users can fix individual fields without losing the rest of the catalog metadata.

### 4. Document the `compatProfile` schema boundary

The fact that only `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort` are user-configurable compat fields is not documented anywhere visible to users. The other dozen+ compat fields (`supportsDeveloperRole`, `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages`, `supportsStore`, etc.) are internal-only but look like reasonable configuration options. A docs page or inline schema description listing allowed fields would prevent silent misconfiguration.

## Impact

These issues affect any user who configures a provider endpoint that happens to have built-in catalog support but doesn't know to use the catalog route name. The Bailian Token Plan case is particularly painful because:

- The endpoint is widely used in China
- The `developer` role error only manifests after multi-turn usage (not on first request)
- The attempted fix (adding `supportsDeveloperRole`) triggers a completely different failure mode
- The error messages at each stage point in wrong directions

I've written a detailed troubleshooting guide based on my debugging experience that I'd be happy to contribute as documentation if helpful.

comments.body:
I checked this across the tagged rc.7 and rc.8 sources. There is an important release boundary that changes the safest answer.

For rc.7, `compatProfile` exposes only `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`; `supportsDeveloperRole` is not a valid user-configurable key. The least fragile recovery is therefore the minimal installed catalog route:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    qwen-token-plan-cn:
      displayName: Bailian Token Plan CN
      apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
```

Omitting `api`, `baseURL`, and `models` preserves the installed endpoint, model metadata, reasoning levels, and vendor compatibility. A 400 that explicitly rejects `developer` also proves the request reached and authenticated with the provider; it should not be diagnosed first as an invalid key.

rc.8 expands the configurable compat schema and does include `supportsDeveloperRole`, so a genuinely custom `openai-completions` route can set it to `false`. rc.8 also documents `modelOverrides`: it can adjust one installed catalog model while retaining the rest. It does not add an unknown model, cannot coexist with a replacing `models` list, and `models` remains full replacement rather than append.

I published a version-aware runbook with the exact failure classification, minimal route, replacement/override rules, custom-model workflow, rollback, and acceptance gates:
https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/bailian-token-plan.html

That distinction should keep rc.7 users from applying an rc.8-compatible field and then chasing the downstream registration/auth symptom.
这帖的主要配置缺口在 rc.8/rc.2 已变化：当前 schema 已支持更多 compat 字段。另需注意 `models` 数组整体替换目录而非追加；复用内置 Bailian catalog 时，最小 route 覆盖通常更稳。升级后验证 reasoning 元数据、system 角色和明确 schema 错误。

records.title: llm-pi-ai：无法在只接受 `system` 角色的 OpenAI 兼容网关（如火山方舟 plan）上控制自定义模型的思考深度
records.body:
在 DSH 的 `llm-pi-ai` 自定义提供方上启用 `reasoningEfforts`（即把模型标记为 `reasoning: true`）后，pi-ai 会把系统提示词以 `role: developer` 发送。对只接受 `system/assistant/user/tool` 角色的 OpenAI 兼容网关（火山方舟 `/api/plan/v3`、大量自建/中转网关），**每条请求都返回 400**。`compat.supportsDeveloperRole` 是 pi-ai 内部自动探测字段，DSH 的 `compat` 配置未开放，因此**用户无法通过配置关闭**。

## 环境

- 组件：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`
- 网关：火山方舟 Agent/Coding Plan `/api/plan/v3`（OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容，只认 `system` 角色）
- 模型：`deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` / `glm-5.2` / `glm-5.3` / `kimi-k3`

## 复现步骤

1. `settings.yaml` 配置自定义提供方，并给模型加 `reasoningEfforts`：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    volcengine:
      apiKeyEnv: VOLCENGINE_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash
          reasoningEfforts:
            off: null
            high: high
            max: max
```

2. 在新对话中发送任意消息。

## 预期行为

- 启用思考深度选择器；系统提示词以 `system` 角色发送；不 400。
- 或至少有一个配置项让用户声明"该端点不接受 `developer` 角色"。

## 实际行为

每条消息 400：

```json
{"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`."}
```

去掉 `reasoningEfforts` 后恢复可用（但思考深度选择器也随之消失）。

## 根因

1. 声明 `reasoningEfforts` → `resolveModelReasoning` 返回 `reasoning: true`。
2. pi-ai 转换系统提示词时：`useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`；对未知端点，`detectCompat` 给出 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`（该 baseURL 不匹配任何"非标准"特征）。
3. DSH 的 `compat` 配置仅开放 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`（`config.ts` `compatProfile`），`supportsDeveloperRole` 属"刻意不开放"的其余 compat 面，无法覆盖为 false。

即：`reasoning: true` 与"发 `system` 角色"在方舟上互相排斥，且配置层无解。

## 建议修复

开放 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole`（route 级默认 + 模型级覆盖，解析顺序与现有两个开关一致，仅限 `openai-completions`）。补丁见 `patch/0001-llm-pi-ai-expose-supports-developer-role.patch`（6 文件、+57/-10，已通过 `git apply --check`）。

可选后续（独立）：让 pi-ai `detectCompat` 对非标准/未知 URL 默认 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`，从源头避免误判。

## 变通方案（上游合并前）

- 暂不启用 `reasoningEfforts`（无选择器，但可用）；
- 或改用接受 `developer` 角色的网关。

## 附加信息

- DSH 官方文档已声明该 compat 面"刻意不开放配置"：`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.zh.md`「推理分派的 compat 开关」。
- 与官方 DeepSeek API 不冲突（其接受 `developer` 角色），故不影响现有 catalog 路由。

comments.body:
There is an important release boundary here: the limitation is accurate for rc.7, but rc.8 already exposes `supportsDeveloperRole` at both route and model scope for `openai-completions` (and the three Responses protocols).

A route-wide rc.8 configuration can keep the reasoning selector while sending the system prompt as `system`:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    volcengine:
      apiKeyEnv: VOLCENGINE_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
      compat:
        supportsDeveloperRole: false
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash
          reasoningEfforts:
            off: null
            high: high
            max: max
```

A model-level `compat` block is also supported and wins over the route value field by field. Do not leave `supportsDeveloperRole:` valueless; rc.8 rejects null instead of falling through to URL detection.

We updated the source-backed guide with the rc.7 workaround versus rc.8 native fix, precedence, backport boundary, and wire gates:

https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/openai-compatible-developer-role.html

Canonical source:
https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/openai-compatible-developer-role.md

如果不想在 settings 里逐个手填火山每个模型的 `reasoningEfforts` 和 compat，现在可以直接用现成 Provider：

```bash

dsh plugin --profile web add pi-volcengine-provider
# 启动前 export VOLCENGINE_API_KEY=...
# restart dsh
```

这个包对 13 个火山 Coding Plan 模型逐个声明真实思考档位，并统一带 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`、`maxTokensField: max_tokens`；GLM 模型还使用自己的 thinking 形状。pi2dsh 在 rc.8 上把这些字段按协议翻译到官方 `llm-pi-ai` profile，真实 HTTP 仍由 DSH 官方 adapter 发送。

records.title: opencode go 套餐中部分模型使用报错【API key is invalid】问题临时解决方案
records.body: 我理解问题原因是deepseek harness对于opencode的go套餐可用模型还是停留在之前的可用模型列表，所以目前在添加模型的时候需要选择自定义，后续待官方同步后再配置 然后填好API Key，在API地址处填写：https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1。就可以点击获取最新的可用模型列表自行裁剪了

comments.body:
There is a second boundary worth preserving here: a successful Go model listing does not make every returned model callable through one DSH custom route.

The current official OpenCode Go table mixes three endpoints and protocols under the same `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1` prefix:

- DeepSeek V4 models: `/chat/completions` → `openai-completions`
- GPT 5.6 Luna: `/responses` → `openai-responses`
- Qwen and MiniMax entries: `/messages` → `anthropic-messages`

In DSH rc.8, **Fetch available models** reads ids, optional names, and optional capacity fields from `GET /models`. It does not import a per-model protocol. A custom provider route has one route-level `api`, while its `models` entries cannot each name a different protocol. Adopting the full mixed listing into one route can therefore make only one protocol family work and leave the others looking like credential failures.

A safer setup is three protocol-homogeneous DSH provider routes sharing the same credential reference and Go base prefix. The Messages route must be entered manually because rc.8 intentionally limits network discovery to OpenAI Completions and Responses listings.

The reported account option for models deployed in China is a separate entitlement and data-residency decision. It can change model availability, but it should not be treated as a universal fix for a wrong request path.

Full rc.8 routing examples and evidence matrix: [canonical guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/opencode-go-model-routing.md) · [visual map](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/opencode-go-model-routing.html).

records.title: 「续 #3379」建议：supportsDeveloperRole 默认改为 false，并在模型配置 UI 增加可见开关
records.body:
> **Follow-up on #3379: default `supportsDeveloperRole` to false for non-native OpenAI endpoints, and consider a visible toggle in model settings**

接 [[接入火山方舟（Ark, volces.com）报 400：pi-ai 将系统提示词以 developer 角色发出，方舟只接受 system/assistant/user/tool #3379](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3379)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3379)

## 背景

上一个 discussion 的根因：自定义提供方声明 `reasoningEfforts`（推理模型）后，pi-ai 会以 `developer` 角色发送系统提示词，而多数非 OpenAI 端点拒绝该角色，直接 400。

好消息：**rc.8 已在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 中加入 `supportsDeveloperRole` 开关**，通过 `settings.yaml` 可以关闭（我已在方舟、Dots 等场景实测生效），上一个 discussion 提到的问题已经解决。👍

## 随之而来的新问题

1. **默认值仍不安全**：自定义提供方只要 baseURL 不在 pi-ai 的 `isNonStandard` 名单里，`supportsDeveloperRole` 就默认 `true`（responses 协议更是无条件 `?? true`）。新增"推理模型 + 不在名单的端点"组合，依然一请求就 400。

2. **模型配置 UI 没有任何 compat 开关**：`设置 → 模型` 的自定义提供方卡片只有 Provider ID / 显示名 / baseURL / 协议 / API key / 模型列表。用户无法在 UI 关闭它，只能手改 `settings.yaml`（官方文档也写明"表单没有对应字段"）。

3. **报错极具误导性，排查容易走弯路**。以我最近的一次实际遭遇为例：配置了新模型 `dots3-note-prev`（声明了 `reasoningEfforts`），调用时报 `400 status code (no body)` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`。按错误码先查上下文，结果：

   - 当时实际上下文只有约 97K tokens，远低于模型 512K 窗口；
   - 又逐一排除 `max_tokens=64000`、`stream_options`、tools 数组、1MB 大载荷——全部返回 200。

   折腾一圈后回到老问题：用与 DSH 相同的 SDK 复现，`role: developer` 立刻 400，`role: system` 返回 200——最终确认还是 #3379 的**同一个根因**。而这个 400 响应体为空，被 pi-ai 的启发式规则（为 Cerebras 加的 `400/413 (no body)` 匹配）误分类成 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`，与真实原因毫无关系。

## 为什么建议默认改为 false

这个问题**有不少先例**，不是孤立现象：

- [[OpenClaw #27037 / PR #29479（已合并）](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/29479)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/29479)：*"only native api.openai.com accepts it — every other backend (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Azure, proxies) returns a hard 400"*；修复方式就是**强制非 `api.openai.com` 端点 `supportsDeveloperRole=false`**，并保留 per-model 显式 `true` 覆盖。
- [[pi-ai 库 #1048](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/1048)](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/1048)：DeepSeek API 拒绝 developer role。
- [[OpenClaw #21066](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/21066)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/21066)：阿里 Dashscope 同样 400。
- 加上本仓库 #3379（方舟）和我们最近遇到的 Dots：都是同一族故障。

结论：**目前已知可靠接受 `developer` role 的只有原生 `api.openai.com`**（OpenClaw 调研：非原生端点中 "none known"）。黑名单式逐个打补丁永远追不上现实，默认 `false` + 显式 opt-in 才是安全形态。

## 改动方法（建议）

改动很小，两个协议都要覆盖。以当前 DSH 内置的 pi-ai 0.82.1 为例，共三处：

```js
// 1) node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js
//    约 1148 行（detectCompat() 内）
//    注：用 includes 判断而非精确相等，以兼容尾斜杠等 URL 变体
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || baseUrl.includes("api.openai.com")

// 2) node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-responses.js
//    约 52 行（getCompat() 内）
supportsDeveloperRole: model.compat?.supportsDeveloperRole ?? false

// 3) node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-responses-shared.js
//    约 92 行（convertResponsesMessages() 内，role 判定处）
const compat = model.compat;
const defaultSupportsDeveloperRole = typeof model.baseUrl === "string" && model.baseUrl.includes("api.openai.com");
const role = model.reasoning && (compat?.supportsDeveloperRole ?? defaultSupportsDeveloperRole) ? "developer" : "system";
```

⚠️ **落实时的重要发现（易踩坑）**：responses 协议的 role 判定在 `openai-responses-shared.js` 约 92 行，它读取的是 **`model.compat`（原始配置），而不是 `getCompat()` 的解析结果**。因此只改第 2 处（`responses.js` 的 `?? false`）是**死代码、不会生效**——实测改完后 responses 实际发出的仍是 `developer`，必须同时改第 3 处。completions 协议走的是解析后的 compat（`getCompat` 合并 `model.compat ?? detected`），所以第 1 处单独就够。

保留 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` 作为显式逃生舱（OpenClaw 已验证此模式可行）。若不想依赖上游 pi-ai，也可在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 构建 provider 时做归一化（思路同 OpenClaw 的 `normalizeModelCompat`：非原生端点默认 false、显式配置优先）。

**已在本机 rc.8（pi-ai 0.82.1）落实并验证**：通过 pi-ai 真实 `streamSimple` 路径抓取实际发出的 wire 消息，completions 与 responses 两个协议下均为——非 OpenAI 端点默认 `system`、原生 `api.openai.com` 保持 `developer`、显式 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` 覆盖仍生效。

## 收益与风险

收益：

- 保护所有现有与未来用户（包括从不改配置的用户），一行判定，成本极低；
- 有 OpenClaw 已合并的同类修复作先例。

风险/代价：

- `system` 与 `developer` 都是系统级指令，绝大多数端点等效；唯一受影响的是"非原生端点但接受 developer"的情况——目前已知为零；
- OpenAI 对 o1/o3 等推理模型推荐 developer role，默认 false 后这类模型会收到 system，功能等价但存在理论上的细微差异；在意者可用 per-model `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` 覆盖。

## UI 开关建议（征询）

除了改默认值，建议在 `设置 → 模型` 的自定义提供方卡片里增加一个可见的 `supportsDeveloperRole` 开关（provider 级默认值 + 模型行 per-model 覆盖），写入 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole`。这样：

- 无需手改 settings.yaml，可发现、可操作；
- 为"默认 false 后仍需要 true"的少数端点提供 UI 逃生舱。

想请教社区：

1. 这个 UI 开关有必要吗？还是保持"高级参数留在 settings.yaml"的现状即可？
2. 如果要做，放在 provider 级还是 model 级（或两级都要）？
3. 默认值改为 false 是否还有我没想到的兼容性顾虑？

records.title: dsh-llm-gateway-compat — OpenAI-compatible gateway dialect fixes (community plugin)
records.body:
Community plugin, **not an official DeepSeek package**. It is not endorsed by DeepSeek.

OpenAI-compatible gateways (Bailian, DashScope compatible-mode, vLLM, custom proxies) often break DSH in two ways:

1. Streamed tool-call fragments send empty `id` / `name` after a valid first fragment → `unknown tool ""`
2. Reasoning requests go out as `role: "developer"` and `max_completion_tokens` → HTTP 400

This bundle does three things:

- wraps `llm/stream` so empty identity cannot overwrite a nonempty value
- on those two 400s, writes the official `llm-pi-ai` `compat` fields and retries the same step once
- optionally owns Chat Completions routes that default to `system` + `max_tokens`, plus `extraBody` / `api-key` headers / thinking dialects

## Install

From npm (recommended — ships built `lib/`, no install-time build):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-gateway-compat
```

Restart `dsh web`.

From GitHub, pin the tag. pnpm ≥10 may ask you to allow `prepare`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:snowshadow/dsh-llm-gateway-compat#v0.3.0
```

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-llm-gateway-compat: true
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-llm-gateway-compat  
Repo: https://github.com/snowshadow/dsh-llm-gateway-compat

This does not replace an official adapter fix. It is a community mitigation for:

- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1500
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3464
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3767
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2388
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2587

---

社区插件，**不是 DeepSeek 官方包**，也未获 DeepSeek 背书。

OpenAI 兼容网关（百炼、DashScope compatible-mode、vLLM、自建代理）常见两类失败：流式 tool-call 空 `id`/`name` 变成 `unknown tool ""`；推理请求带 `developer` / `max_completion_tokens` 被 400。

这个 bundle：消毒 `llm/stream`、把那两种 400 写进官方 `llm-pi-ai` compat 并重试一次、还可以自己挂默认 `system`+`max_tokens` 的 Chat Completions 路由。

推荐安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-gateway-compat
```

请自行 review 源码后再安装。

comments.body:
Pinning empty streamed `id` / `name` so they cannot clobber a real tool identity is the right local fix for the Bailian / new-api `unknown tool ""` class (#3767 / #1500), and retrying those two 400s into `llm-pi-ai` `compat` is a much smaller hammer than swapping the whole adapter.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-gateway-compat
```

then restart `dsh web`. Review the package first — it wraps `llm/stream`.

If you want it on the install-test catalog: https://github.com/ylwl1997/dshbase/issues/new?template=plugin-submission.yml

Current listings: https://dshbase.com/plugins/directory/

The Chat Completions adapter under `providers` is optional (extraBody / `api-key` header / thinking dialects) and must use a route id that does not collide with `llm-pi-ai`.

Submitting to the install-test catalog now.

records.title: dsh 不从网关实时拉取模型列表，只用 pi-ai catalog 快照：opencode-go 新模型显示不出来；临时方案（手动声明 openai-completions 路由）又因协议不同，同一提供商的模型被拆成两个 provider
records.body:
背景 / 痛点
Web 设置 → 模型页的「拉取可用模型（Fetch available models）」本意是自动获取某提供商在线在售的模型清单。但实测发现：

对 pi-ai catalog 路由（如 opencode-go），它不会发任何网络请求，直接返回已安装 @earendil-works/pi-ai 包内写死的 catalog 快照；
结果就是 opencode-go 网关新上线的模型永远不显示，只能手动逐条填写；
想绕开 catalog 走实时拉取，必须手动声明一个 openai-completions 协议的路由（如 opencode-go-live）。但 opencode-go 这个 gateway 在 catalog 里默认用的是非 openai 协议，于是同一个提供商的一批模型被迫拆到两个 provider 下配置，无法合并成一个提供商，管理和切换都很别扭。
复现
dsh 0.1.0-rc.8，安装 pi-ai 适配器；在 $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml 加目录路由 opencode-go（仅 apiKeyEnv）；
Web → 设置 → 模型 → opencode-go → 「拉取可用模型」；
结果：只返回已安装 pi-ai@0.82.1 快照里的 16 个模型，零网络请求；
而 opencode-go 线上端点（
https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models
）实际在售 28 个模型。
根因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js 的 discoverModels() 对 catalog 内已存在的提供商直接短路：

js
复制
if (request.provider !== void 0) {
    const installed = catalogModels(request.provider);
    if (installed.size > 0) return [...installed.values()].map(...) // 直接返回快照，不 fetch
}
只有 pi-ai 不认识（未内置）的提供商才会走到 GET {baseURL}/models 实时探测，且此时协议必须是 LISTABLE_PROTOCOLS（如 openai-completions）里可读取列表的那几类。

证据
pi-ai 0.82.1（已安装）：opencode-go catalog = 16 个模型；
线上端点：28 个，其中 12 个不在快照里（如 glm-5.3、qwen3.8-max、gpt-5.6-luna、qwen3.5-plus、mimo-v2-omni、kimi-k2.5、hy3-preview、ox-alpha-free、muse-spark-1.2-contributor 等）；
下载 0.84.2 tarball 核对：opencode-go 仍只有 19 个——只新增 glm-5.3、qwen3.8-max、gpt-5.6-luna，12 个里仍有 9 个缺失（快照永远追不上线上）；
dsh-llm-pi-ai 最新版（0.1.1-rc.1）仍钉死 @earendil-works/pi-ai: ^0.82.1（0.x 的 caret 语义 = <0.83.0），所以官方 npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest 也升不到 0.83/0.84。
为什么「手动配置」也救不了这个使用体验
为了拿全量，我用手声明路由 opencode-go-live（api: openai-completions + baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1）实时拉到了 28 个模型。但问题在于：

协议被迫分家：同一个网关，catalog 里的 opencode-go 用其原生协议；手动声明又只能用 openai-completions。于是同一个提供商的 28 个模型分裂在两处，用户得在 UI/配置里维护两份 provider，无法用一个 opencode-go 统一包含 catalog 全部 + 新模型；
丢失元数据：实时拉取拿不到 catalog 提供的 contextWindow、maxTokens、reasoningEfforts、compat、input 多模态等字段，多模态识图能力（input: [text, image]）还得靠用户逐个去查证后手填（我为此查了 pi-ai catalog 与多篇厂商资料才补全 13 个可识图模型）；
每新增一个模型都要手动处理。
建议（满足任意一条即可明显改善）
catalog 路由也支持实时探测：点「拉取可用模型」时，对已内置 catalog 的 provider 同时请求其端点 GET /models，把线上结果放进选择器供用户勾选采纳，而不是只回快照；
同一 provider 可多协议并存 / 能合并实时结果进 catalog 路由的 models：让用户能把「opencode-go 原生协议 catalog」和「openai-completions 实时拉取」合并在一个 provider 里，避免同一提供商模型被拆成两个 provider；
显示快照版本：标出每条路由当前用的是哪个 pi-ai catalog 快照，让滞后可见、也知道该等哪次升级；
放宽依赖范围（^0.82.1 → 可更新），让 catalog 更新能随正常的全局升级落地；
（可选） 提供「把 catalog / 实时拉取结果同步写进路由 models」的动作，自动带上 contextWindow/maxTokens/input 等元数据，控制权仍归用户。
连带发现
内置 DeepSeek 官方适配器（@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek）根本没有注册模型发现能力（没有 registerModelDiscovery），即使 DeepSeek 官方有 OpenAI 兼容的 GET /models，内置的 deepseek-official 提供商也同样无法自动获取模型——同类问题。

环境
dsh 0.1.0-rc.8（全局 npm），macOS
@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.82.1
Web 模型设置页（dsh-client-ui-settings-models）

records.title: [Upstream Issue] dsh-mcp-client 不发送 MCP roots / rootUri，codegraph MCP 默认项目指向宿主启动目录而非当前工作区
records.body:
## 环境

- DSH（`@deepseek-ai/dsh` v0.1.0-rc.7），`dsh-mcp-client` 插件（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js`）
- CodeGraph MCP server v1.5.0（stdio transport，`codegraph serve --mcp`）
- macOS，单 DSH 实例 + 多工作区（workspace）工作流

## 现象

在一个 DSH 实例内切换工作区时，`codegraph_explore` 等工具的**默认项目始终指向 DSH 宿主进程的启动目录**，而不是当前会话的工作区。

实测：DSH 宿主从 `~/Documents/code/DataNex/scripts` 启动（工作区为 `~/Documents/code/private-aiagentos`），codegraph MCP 默认项目解析到 DataNex（Rust 项目），本项目的 `.codegraph/` 索引只有显式传 `projectPath` 时才会被打开。

## 根因（源码证据）

**1. dsh-mcp-client 建立连接时不声明任何 MCP capabilities，也不发送 workspace 信息：**

```js
const generation = new Client({
  name: "dsh-mcp-client",
  version: "0.0.1"
}, { capabilities: {} });   // ← 空 capabilities，不声明 roots
```

- 不发送 `rootUri` / `workspaceFolders`（initialize 参数）
- 不声明 `capabilities.roots`，因此 codegraph 不会发起 `roots/list`
- 唯一传给子进程的路径是 transport 的 `cwd`（`config.cwd`），即 DSH 宿主进程启动目录，与当前会话 workspace 无关

**2. codegraph v1.5.0 的默认项目解析顺序（`mcp/session.js` handleInitialize + resolveRoot）：**

1. 客户端 `initialize` 带 `rootUri` → 用 `fileUriToPath(rootUri)`
2. 客户端 `initialize` 带 `workspaceFolders[0].uri` → 用之
3. 服务器启动参数 `--path`
4. 客户端声明 `capabilities.roots` → 启动后 `roots/list` 拉取第一个 root
5. 以上全部缺失 → **兜底 `process.cwd()` 向上找最近的 `.codegraph/`**（`findNearestCodeGraphRoot`）

DSH 对 1/2/4 全部不提供（3 也由配置决定），于是永远走到第 5 条 = 宿主启动目录。

## 影响

- 多工作区单实例是 DSH 的正常用法，但 codegraph 默认项目被"钉死"在启动目录，无法跟随当前工作区；
- 依赖默认项目的 agent 规则（如本项目 AGENTS.md 的 codegraph-first 约定）在 DSH 下会静默查错项目；
- 只能靠每次调用显式传 `projectPath` 绕开，agent 工作流容易漏传。

## 期望行为

codegraph 默认项目应跟随 DSH 的**当前会话 workspace**：

- 方案 A（推荐）：dsh-mcp-client 声明 `capabilities: { roots: { listChanged: false } }`，并实现 `roots/list` 处理器返回当前 workspace root（`file://` URI）；codegraph 侧已原生支持（clientSupportsRoots → roots/list 优先于 cwd）。
- 方案 B：连接时把当前 workspace 作为 `rootUri` 发送（LSP 风格，codegraph 最高优先级）。
- 方案 C：至少支持按会话/连接粒度注入 `--path`。

## 复现步骤

1. 在项目 A 目录启动 DSH（`cd A && dsh web`），工作区切换到项目 B；
2. 调用 `codegraph_explore`（不传 projectPath）；
3. 观察返回的源码来自项目 A 而非项目 B；
4. `lsof -p <codegraph-mcp-pid> | grep cwd` 确认其 cwd = 项目 A。

## 建议

在 dsh-mcp-client 中补充 MCP workspace 集成：声明 roots capability 并响应 `roots/list`（返回当前 `ctx.sessions` workspace 根），使 DSH 的 workspace 概念贯通到 MCP 层。codegraph 端无需改动。

## 相关文件

- DSH：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js`（`new Client(..., { capabilities: {} })`、`StdioClientTransport({ cwd })`）
- CodeGraph v1.5.0：`lib/dist/mcp/session.js`（`handleInitialize` rootUri/workspaceFolders/--path 分支、`roots/list`、cwd 兜底）、`lib/dist/mcp/directory.js`（`findNearestCodeGraphRoot`）

priorAudit.solution: pi-mcp-adapter runs unchanged with full MCP support including roots/rootUri handling, so codegraph MCP servers receive proper workspace roots instead of falling back to the host cwd.
priorAudit.boundary: This does not repair dsh-mcp-client's missing roots capability; it is an alternate MCP runtime.
priorAudit.replyAngle: pi-mcp-adapter sends MCP roots properly, so codegraph resolves the current workspace instead of the host startup directory.

records.title: 每次切换主模型的时候，子agent模型会跟随主模型一起变更（同主模型），怎么才能固定子agent模型？
records.body: 每次切换主模型的时候，子agent模型会跟随主模型一起变更（同主模型），怎么才能固定子agent模型？ 【settings.yaml】 agent-default-model: provider: lm-studio model: **qwen3.5:9b** ^^^^ **能否在该处或者某个适合的位置标记指定哪些模型优先做为子agent模型？**

comments.body:
`settings.yaml` 里的 `agent-default-model` 只决定**父会话**的默认模型。内置 `tool-subagent` 没有对称的“子 agent 模型”配置项——子会话吃的是父会话当时的 `parent.options`，所以你在模型选择器里换主模型，新拉起来的子 agent 会跟着走。这是继承，不是单独槽位。

目前能用的做法：

- 需要固定便宜模型打杂：不要在这个会话里切主模型；另开一个会话专门跑强模型、少用 subagent。
- 需要同一会话里主模型可切、子模型钉死：得靠自定义 preset / 插件去覆盖 `tool-subagent` 的 agentOptions（或走会显式传 model 的委托插件）。在 YAML 里再加一行不会生效。
- 已经在跑的子 agent 不会跟着热更新；要验证继承关系，开**新会话**再 spawn。

没有官方的“优先做子 agent 的模型列表”，可以把这个当成功能请求。

可以用 Pi 社区的子代理插件把子 Agent 模型固定下来，并且这条显式路由已经做过真实跨 Provider E2E。它不改变 DSH 原生 subagent 的继承规则：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add @tintinweb/pi-subagents
```

单次派发时直接给 Agent 指定完整模型，例如 `model: "deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash"`；需要长期固定时，可在 `.pi/agents/<name>.md` 的 frontmatter 写同一个 `model:`，主 Agent 始终派发这个 agent type。

验收中父会话保持在 `work-gw/deepseek-chat`，显式子代理真实请求 deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash 并调用 bash 落盘；持久日志证明没有跟随父模型漂移。

示例与证据：
https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/subagents
https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/community/subagents-lifecycle-e2e.json

priorAudit.solution: @tintinweb/pi-subagents supports explicit per-child provider/model configuration, allowing users to fix a subagent's model independently of the parent's live selected route.
priorAudit.boundary: DSH native subagent model inheritance logic remains unfixed.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Use @tintinweb/pi-subagents to pin each child's model explicitly, independent of the parent's live route.

records.title: llm-pi-ai: 希望支持从端点动态发现模型目录（dynamic model discovery）
records.body:
## 背景

pi-ai 的内置 provider 目录是随安装包发布的静态快照。以 `opencode-go` 为例：

- opencode 侧的模型数据更新很频繁（opencode CLI 拉取的 models 数据里，新模型上线几天内就会出现）。但已安装 dsh 内置的目录快照滞后，新模型在模型选择器里永远不出现，只能等 pi-ai / dsh 升级。
- 目前的 workaround 是在 `settings.yaml` 手写 `models:` 列表，逐个模型抄 id / name / contextWindow / maxTokens / input / reasoningEfforts——元数据全靠人工对齐端点实际数据，容易漂移。
- 而且 `models:` 是整体替换语义：一旦写了列表，该路由其余内置模型全部不再服务。

## 已有的半成品

Web UI 的「获取可用模型」已经会按 OpenAI 兼容的 `GET {baseURL}/models` 拉候选，但只用于填充表单草稿，保存后路由仍是静态的。另外 `GET /models` 通常只返回 id，没有容量 / 模态 / 推理元数据。

## 提案

给 provider profile 加一个显式的动态发现开关（命名待定，如 `discoverModels`），开启后运行时从端点发现模型并物化该路由的目录：

1. **两种数据源**
   - OpenAI 兼容 `GET {baseURL}/models`：只有 id，发现的模型按路由默认值（defaultContextWindow / defaultMaxTokens / defaultInput）物化；
   - models.dev 风格的富 JSON（含 limit.context / limit.output、modalities、reasoning_options）：可映射为 contextWindow / maxTokens / input / reasoningEfforts。
2. **合并语义沿用现有哲学**：settings 里显式声明的条目逐字段覆盖发现的条目，发现只补空缺；显式 `models:` 列表仍然整体优先（想钉死目录就写列表）。
3. **失败安全**：拉取失败或校验失败时保留 last-good 目录（与 settings seam 的 last-good 行为一致）；模态保守回退 `[text]`；发现的清单只存在于运行时、不回写 settings.yaml——配置文档仍是事实来源。

## 为什么与既有设计不冲突

`provider.ts` 的 `reuseCatalogProvider` 注释明确放弃了 catalog 自带的后台刷新（"this route's catalog is the settings document"）。本提案不是恢复隐式刷新：它是逐路由显式 opt-in、失败回退到已知良好状态、显式声明永远压过发现值——要不要追新由每条路由自己的配置决定。

## 替代方案

- 继续手写 `models:` 列表（现状）：每个新模型都要人工抄一遍元数据；
- 等内置快照随版本更新：滞后不可控。

实际案例：今天把 opencode-go 从预设通道改写成 hand-declared 路由时，ox-alpha-free / deepseek-v4-flash 的全部元数据都是从 opencode 的 models.json 手工抄进 settings.yaml 的。如果路由能直接声明"从这个端点发现"，这段配置可以缩成一行。

---

环境：dsh 0.1.1-rc.2（asdf 全局安装），macOS。

priorAudit.solution: Unmodified Pi providers with their own transport become native DSH llm routes with dynamic model catalogs, translating the provider's live model list into DSH's model selector.
priorAudit.boundary: DSH native static catalog mechanism remains unchanged for existing DSH-owned routes.
priorAudit.replyAngle: Route through an unmodified Pi provider to get live model discovery from the endpoint into DSH's model selector.

records.title: MCP tool calls bypass ctx.approval — no gate on side-effectful bridged tools
records.body:
## what I observed

  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` appears to have no reference to the approval seam.
  Grepping the published `lib/index.js` for `ctx.approval` / `approval.request`
  returns nothing, while `dsh-sandbox`, `dsh-tool-bash`, `dsh-tool-fs` and
  `dsh-tools` all consume it.

  The effect is that a bridged MCP tool call is never gated. The permission model
  covers file and shell access, but a tool call from an MCP server runs
  unconditionally.

  ## why it matters for us

  We embed the harness in a desktop audio app and mount several MCP servers,
  including ones that call paid generation APIs. Those calls spend real credits.
  Under the harness they run with no prompt; other ACP/agent hosts we've used ask
  before the first call and let the user grant it thereafter.

  There is no way to close this from the host side: the harness spawns the MCP
  servers as its own children and calls them directly, so an embedding
  application never sees the call and cannot interpose.

  ## what I'm unsure about

  Gating *every* MCP call would clearly be wrong — it would prompt on read-only
  tools and make the seam useless through noise. Some options, none obviously
  right:

  - Key off `annotations.readOnlyHint`: gate only tools that don't declare it
    (related to a separate discussion I'm opening about that annotation).
  - A per-server config field, e.g. `requireApproval: true`, so the deployment
    decides.
  - A `ctx.tools` classification the bridge sets, letting the existing pipeline
    route the `ask` decision rather than the bridge calling the seam itself.

  The last seems most in keeping with the architecture — the README notes the
  tools pipeline already routes `ask` decisions and fails closed without an
  answerer — but I don't know the intended boundary well enough to say.

  Is the current behaviour deliberate (MCP servers treated as trusted because
  mounting one is itself the act of trust), or a gap?

  ## Version

  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.1.0-rc.7`. Read from compiled output, not source
  — apologies if I've misread the structure.

comments.body:
There is an immediately usable alternative path for this through `pi2dsh` + the unmodified `pi-mcp-adapter` package. The adapter has its own per-server/per-tool approval policy (`approveTools: true` or a tool-pattern list) and applies the same gate to proxy calls, dynamically registered direct tools, resources, and MCP App-originated calls.

Through pi2dsh, the approval request crosses DSH `userQuestions`; the real-host E2E verifies that a human decision is collected and reused for the session. Headless mode fails closed when approval is required and no answerer exists.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-mcp-adapter
```

This is package-owned approval rather than a claim that the official `dsh-mcp-client` now calls `ctx.approval`. The native client still needs the architectural decision discussed here, but users with paid or side-effectful MCP tools can enforce a gate today.

https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/docs/mcp-compatibility.md

priorAudit.solution: pi-mcp-adapter runs unchanged with its own approval/elicitation gate, providing an alternate MCP runtime where bridged tool calls can be gated before execution.
priorAudit.boundary: The core dsh-mcp-client bypass of ctx.approval remains unfixed; the alternate runtime does not repair the native adapter.
priorAudit.replyAngle: If you need approval gating on MCP tool calls, pi-mcp-adapter provides a working alternate runtime with its own approval seam; it does not patch dsh-mcp-client itself.

records.title: annotations.readOnlyHint is dropped at registration, so bridged MCP tools are always exclusive
records.body:
## what I observed

  `dsh-tools` documents the classification rule:

  > `ctx.tools.executionMode(exec)` returns `parallel` only when the visible
  > definition's `isConcurrencySafe(exec.arguments)` classifier returns exactly
  > `true`; unknown, hidden, undeclared, invalid, or throwing classifications are
  > exclusive.

  `dsh-tool-fs` declares `isConcurrencySafe`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` never
  does — the string doesn't appear in its published `lib/index.js`. So every
  bridged MCP tool is classified exclusive by construction, and
  `maxParallelToolCalls` can never apply to any of them.

  MCP already carries the needed signal: `tools/list` returns
  `annotations.readOnlyHint`, which means "no side effects". It appears to be read
  off the wire and then discarded when the tool is registered on `ctx.tools`.

  ## how I confirmed it

  Our MCP server marks its read tools `readOnlyHint: true` and deliberately leaves
  write tools unhinted (they do read-modify-write on one JSON file, so
  serialising them is correct).

  Asking the agent for three independent reads, I never saw more than one call in
  flight — measured from `session/update` frames over ACP, counting `tool_call`
  against terminal `tool_call_update`. Same result on models that batch tool calls
  natively, so it isn't the provider.

  ## suggested mapping

  annotations.readOnlyHint === true  →  isConcurrencySafe: () => true

  Everything else stays exclusive, matching the registry's fail-closed default.
  `readOnlyHint` is advisory in the MCP spec, so this trusts the server — but
  mounting a server is already an act of trust, and the blast radius is
  concurrency rather than permission.

  I'd expect this to be a small change in the executor/registration path
  (`createExecutor`, and the `ctx.tools.register(definition)` call near it).

  ## version

  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.1.0-rc.7`. Read from compiled output, not source.

priorAudit.solution: pi-mcp-adapter runs unchanged and can map readOnlyHint to concurrency-safe classification, enabling parallel execution of read-only MCP tools.
priorAudit.boundary: The core dsh-mcp-client registration path that drops readOnlyHint remains unfixed; the alternate runtime does not repair the native adapter.
priorAudit.replyAngle: pi-mcp-adapter gives you a working MCP runtime where readOnlyHint can drive parallel execution; it does not fix the native dsh-mcp-client registration.

records.title: Feature request: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Antigravity accounts
records.body:
It would be useful if DeepSeek Harness could offer an optional “Connect account” flow for supported AI providers such as ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, and Antigravity.

The goal would be to let users sign in with a provider account and use any plan entitlements or supported capabilities available through that provider, without manually configuring API keys where an official integration is available.

Suggested requirements:
- Use official OAuth or other provider-approved authentication flows only.
- Clearly show which provider, account, plan, and capabilities are connected.
- Never store user passwords; store only the minimum secure tokens required.
- Support disconnecting an account and revoking access at any time.
- Gracefully fall back to API-key or gateway configuration when account-plan access is not supported by the provider.

This could make setup easier for people who already subscribe to these services. Is this technically and policy-wise feasible for the supported providers?

records.title: Provider model catalogs are stale for OpenCode Go and OpenRouter
records.body:
Tested with `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2` and the Open Design profile on Linux. The active DSH catalog exposed 16 OpenCode Go models while the authenticated provider `/models` endpoint returned 29. OpenRouter exposed 276 while its public `/models` endpoint returned 420; the static catalog also retained 11 IDs no longer returned live. Updating the nested compatible `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency from 0.82.1 to 0.84.2 improved this only partially (19 and 346 respectively).

The root behavior appears intentional but surprising: `dsh-llm-pi-ai` documents `registerModelDiscovery` as UI-only candidate discovery, not an active catalog refresh, so routes with omitted `models` remain pinned to the installed pi-ai snapshot.

A validated local workaround is to materialize the live IDs into each provider profile and explicitly state transport metadata so unknown-to-catalog IDs resolve:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode-go:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
    openrouter:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
```

After applying the exact live snapshots, `dsh --profile open-design --models` reports 29/29 OpenCode Go and 420/420 OpenRouter IDs, including `gpt-5.6-luna`, `qwen3.8-max`, `muse-spark-1.2-contributor`, `google/gemini-3.7-flash`, `stealth/ox-alpha`, and `z-ai/glm-5.3`.

Could DSH offer an opt-in live-catalog policy (with timeout/cache/stale fallback), or a supported refresh/adopt command, for OpenAI-compatible routes? That would retain configuration as the source of truth while avoiding silent catalog drift.

priorAudit.solution: Install pi2dsh with unmodified Pi providers — its dynamic model catalog translation gives live /models refresh for OpenCode Go and OpenRouter, replacing the stale static catalog.
priorAudit.boundary: This does not repair the DSH-native static catalog mechanism or add a refresh policy to the original route.
priorAudit.replyAngle: pi2dsh's dynamic catalog gives you live model lists for OpenCode Go and OpenRouter without manual snapshots.

records.title: [BUG] 代理环境下 LLM API 请求全部失败：Node fetch (undici) 不读取 HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY 环境变量
records.body:
## Summary

在需要代理才能访问外网的网络环境（如 VMware NAT、公司代理、国内网络）下，dsh 的 LLM API 调用（chat/completions 等）全部失败；必须额外设置 Node 实验性开关 `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` 才能恢复。根因是 DSH 使用 Node 全局 fetch（undici），而 undici fetch 默认忽略 `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` 环境变量。

## Environment

- OS：Ubuntu（VMware 虚拟机，NAT 网络，需经宿主机代理访问外网）
- Node：v22.23.2（nvm 管理）
- dsh：0.1.1-rc.1（npm 全局安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`）
- 网络：必须经 HTTP 代理访问 LLM API；curl / npm / pip 均可正常走代理

## Proxy 环境变量（已脱敏）

```bash
HTTP_PROXY=http://<host>:<port>
HTTPS_PROXY=http://<host>:<port>
NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,<其他内网地址>
Steps to Reproduce
在 shell 中设置上述代理环境变量（此时 curl、npm 均正常走代理）；
正常启动 dsh，并配置使用 LLM API（如 DeepSeek API）；
发起对话请求。
复现并抓取报错日志（可选，便于维护者确认）：

bash
复制
unset NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY
dsh --profile headless "你好" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/dsh-error.log
Actual Behavior
请求直连外网、未走代理，全部失败，报错为网络层错误，例如：

复制
TypeError: fetch failed
cause: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED <host>:<port>
（视网络环境也可能是 ETIMEDOUT / ECONNRESET / 证书错误。判据：只要设置 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 后立即恢复正常，即可确认与"fetch 未走代理"相关。）

Expected Behavior
与 curl / npm 一致，自动读取 HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY 环境变量；或提供显式的 proxy 配置项（如 config 中的 proxy 字段）。

Root Cause（初步定位）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek 等包的 HTTP 调用使用 Node 全局 fetch（例如 lib/index.js:737 的 await fetch(\${connection.baseURL}/chat/completions`, ...)），未配置 undiciProxyAgent。而 Node 内置 fetch（undici）默认**不读取**HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY` 环境变量（长期存在的生态问题，参见 nodejs/node#57165、openclaw/openclaw#20549）。因此在必须走代理的网络环境下必然失败。

Workaround（已确认有效）
设置 Node 实验性开关后恢复正常：

bash
复制
export NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1
（需 Node ≥ 22.21.0 或 ≥ 24.3.0；该特性由 nodejs/node#57165 引入。）

Suggested Fix
HTTP 层统一改用 undici ProxyAgent，按环境变量（HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY）自动配置；注意 NO_PROXY 需放行 127.0.0.1 / localhost，避免 GUI（http://127.0.0.1:3080）回环请求被代理劫持；
或至少：显式支持 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY，并在文档中补充代理配置说明；
影响面：dsh-llm-deepseek、dsh-llm-pi-ai、dsh-web-search-deepseek、dsh-host-apiproxy 等多个包。

priorAudit.solution: Install pi2dsh 0.20 and use an unmodified Pi provider (e.g., a Pi OpenAI-compatible provider) as a native DSH llm route. Pi providers use their own transport that can be configured with proxy settings, bypassing DSH's undici fetch that ignores HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY.
priorAudit.boundary: This does not repair the DSH-native llm-deepseek package's fetch call or add proxy support to DSH core; it only provides an alternate provider route that works in proxied environments.
priorAudit.replyAngle: If you need LLM calls to work behind a proxy, pi2dsh lets you run a Pi provider as a native DSH route with its own transport — no NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY hack needed. Note it's an alternate path, not a fix to DSH's fetch.

records.title: [Feature Request] Allow subagent to specify a different agent preset
records.body:
# [Feature Request] 子代理（subagent）支持指定不同的 Agent Preset

## 问题描述

当前 DSH 的子代理（subagent）机制中，子代理必须继承父代理的 Agent Preset（预设）。这意味着在同一个会话内，无法让子代理以不同的预设身份运行。

具体场景：我配置了多个 Agent Preset（如 main、finance、marketing、planner 等），每个预设都有独立的 `AGENTS.md` 工作指令和插件配置。我希望主代理（main）能够调度其他预设的子代理来完成专业化任务，但目前的架构不支持这种跨预设调度。

## 源码分析

通过阅读 DSH 源码文档，发现这是刻意设计：

> "Every in-process child is composed by one call, `applyChildComposition(childCtx, parent, composition)`, which joins the parent's agent-preset composition before applying the child's own persona and tool filter."
> — `dsh-subagent/README.md`

同时，spawn 和 fork 提供方都已声明了 `persona: true` 能力：

> "spawn 声明 `{ outputSchema: true, depthLimit: true, toolFilter: true, persona: true }`"
> — `dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process/README.zh.md`

这说明底层基础设施已具备给子代理设置独立身份的能力，只是目前没有暴露给模型侧的 `subagent` 工具。

## 期望行为

希望 `subagent` 工具支持一个可选的 `preset` 参数，允许子代理以不同的预设身份运行。

### 方案 A：subagent 工具增加 preset 参数

```
subagent(
  prompt: "帮我分析一下这个项目的成本结构",
  description: "成本分析",
  preset: "finance"  // 新增可选参数
)
```

子代理将以 finance 预设的身份运行，自动加载对应预设目录下的 `AGENTS.md`、插件配置和 persona。

### 方案 B：subagent 工具支持指定 AGENTS.md 路径

```
subagent(
  prompt: "帮我分析一下这个项目的成本结构",
  description: "成本分析",
  agents_md: "~/.dsh/.agent-presets/finance/AGENTS.md"  // 注入指定指令文件
)
```

子代理保持父级预设，但额外注入指定的 `AGENTS.md` 内容作为工作指令。

### 方案 C：配置层支持多实例 subagent 工具

在 `cordis.yml` 中注册多个 subagent 工具实例，每个绑定不同的 persona：

```yaml
subagent-finance:
  provider: spawn
  toolName: subagent_finance
  persona:
    text: "你是一个专精财务分析的助手..."
  agentOptions:
    model: deepseek-v4-pro

subagent-marketing:
  provider: spawn
  toolName: subagent_marketing
  persona:
    text: "你是一个专精内容营销的助手..."
  agentOptions:
    model: deepseek-v4-pro
```

## 实际使用场景

主代理作为调度中心，配置了多个专业化预设：

| 预设 ID | 职责 |
|---------|------|
| main | 需求理解、任务拆解、调度子代理、汇总结果 |
| finance | 报价计算、成本核算、预算编制 |
| marketing | 内容创作、品牌传播 |
| planner | 方案策划、文档撰写 |

**理想工作流**：
1. 用户对主代理提出复合型需求
2. 主代理调度 finance 预设的子代理处理财务部分
3. 主代理调度 planner 预设的子代理处理方案部分
4. 主代理汇总各子代理结果，统一向用户汇报

**当前限制**：步骤 2、3 中的子代理只能用 main 预设的身份运行，无法使用其他预设的专业指令和工具配置。

## 当前变通方案

目前采用的变通方案：在 subagent 的 prompt 里手动读取并注入目标预设的 `AGENTS.md` 内容。

该方案能用，但存在以下问题：
- 每次都要手动读取文件，额外消耗 token
- 子代理的工具集仍是父级预设的，无法按预设裁剪
- 无法持久化为可复用的工作流

## 环境信息

- DSH 版本：0.1.0-rc.5
- 运行平台：Windows 11
- Node.js 版本：v22.22.0

## 补充说明

在社区和文档中未找到关于此问题的讨论。如果这是已知限制或已有计划，烦请告知；如果是新功能，希望能纳入后续版本的路线图。

感谢 DSH 团队的出色工作！"一切皆插件"的设计哲学非常棒，期待子代理也能成为可组合的一行。

priorAudit.solution: Install pi2dsh 0.20 with @tintinweb/pi-subagents. Pi subagents support explicit per-child provider/model and inherit from the parent's live selected route, allowing different agent presets per child — an exact alternate for running subagents with distinct identities.
priorAudit.boundary: This does not add a preset parameter to DSH's native subagent tool or change DSH's applyChildComposition design; it's a separate Pi-based subagent runtime.
priorAudit.replyAngle: You want subagents with different presets — pi2dsh's Pi subagents give each child its own provider/model and reasoning level, so you can run a finance-preset child from a main agent. It's an alternate runtime, not a patch to DSH's native tool.
